headline: Ronaldo retires from Portugal duty after row with coach Jorge Jesus
facts: Ronaldo, 41, announced he has played his last game for Portugal, leaving with a men's record 146 international goals.
The trigger was a row with coach Jorge Jesus: Ronaldo was an unused sub against Norway in September and accused Jesus of breaking two promises; he then walked out of camp before the Denmark match.
He apologized to teammates for leaving and said the federation should decide his punishment; ESPN lists a long history of past clashes with managers.
Ronaldo, 41, announced on 5 November that he has ended his international career, with record totals of 146 goals and 243 caps.
He walked out of camp in late September after being an unused substitute in a 2-1 win over Norway on 27 September.
He said Jesus broke two promises; Jesus said the same rules apply to everyone and later admitted he mishandled the situation.
Ronaldo apologised to teammates and said the federation should decide any consequences; Portugal won their next two games without him.
On 5 November he confirmed his final Portugal match had been played, and said the federation should decide his punishment.
background: Ronaldo is a five-time Ballon d'Or winner and won Euro 2016 with Portugal; ESPN lists a long history of rows with coaches from Ferguson-era Manchester United to Juventus and Mourinho's Real Madrid.

A separate ESPN piece (19 Nov) recalls that Frank was photographed in January drinking from an Arsenal-branded cup before Spurs lost to Bournemouth, and that Spurs sacked him in February after under eight months.
His first game in charge is away at Coventry on Saturday 21 November.
Frank joked that he hopes not to be caught with similar drinkware again and said he still finds the January Arsenal cup episode amusing.
In January he was photographed with an Arsenal-branded cup before Spurs lost to Bournemouth, and said at the time drinking from a rival's cup deliberately would be absolutely stupid.
Palace are bottom of the Premier League with the worst goals-against record, and his first game is at Coventry on Saturday.
Frank, 53, took over bottom-of-the-table Crystal Palace on a contract to June 2029, with a first game away at Coventry.
In January, as Spurs manager, he was photographed with an Arsenal-branded cup before a loss to Bournemouth; he now says he hopes not to be pictured with another rival's cup.

Napoli first said they would appeal, but Allegri then chose not to, joked the ban could grow to four matches, and said he wanted to focus on Napoli's poor Serie A run.
Allegri got a two-match touchline ban and a 10,000 euro fine after being sent off late in the 3-3 home draw with Roma.

headline: Maignan sent off for shoving Tyler Adams as Bournemouth rout Milan 3-0 in Europa League
facts: Milan keeper Maignan got a straight red in the 27th minute for pushing Tyler Adams in the face during a corner; Tavernier scored the resulting penalty (Kluivert had scored an earlier penalty for handball).
Bournemouth won 3-0 and are three wins from three in the Europa League, the first English club since 1973 to win their first three games in a major European competition.
It was Ruben Amorim's first competitive game back in England since Manchester United sacked him in January; Milan later condemned racist abuse of Maignan on social media after the match.

Justin Kluivert scored a penalty in the 8th minute after Koni De Winter handled; Mike Maignan was sent off in the 27th minute for shoving Tyler Adams in the face, and Marcus Tavernier added a penalty.
Amine Adli completed the scoring with an 84th-minute free kick; it was Milan's first defeat of the season in all competitions.
Bournemouth became the first English club since 1973 to win their first three matches in a major continental competition.
Kluivert and Tavernier scored penalties and Amine Adli added a free kick after Maignan was sent off in the 27th minute for shoving Tyler Adams.
It was Amorim's first job since being sacked by Manchester United in January; Milan had been undefeated in Serie A.

facts: PSG beat Le Havre 5-1 after trailing to an early Josh Maja goal; Hakimi was involved in all five PSG goals.

ESPN says he finished 13th in the 2026 Ballon d'Or, 16 places ahead of the next African player, Sadio Mané, and is the favourite for the CAF award in Lagos on 7 December.
Hakimi scored his first career hat-trick and added two assists as PSG came from behind to win 5-1 at Le Havre on 30 October.

Brazil's sports tribunal banned him for three matches in total (one for yellow cards and two for the mouth-covering), and he is not expected back until late November.

headline: Harry Kane wins the 2026 Ballon d'Or at the London ceremony
facts: Kane won the men's Ballon d'Or on 26 October 2026 at a ceremony held in London, ahead of Kylian Mbappé (2nd) and Lamine Yamal (3rd).
UEFA credits him with 73 goals for club and country in 2025/26, top scorer in the Bundesliga for the third season running and 14 Champions League goals as Bayern reached the semi-finals.
He is the first Englishman to win the award in 25 years, and he also took the Men's Striker of the Year award.
Kane, 33, won the 2026 Ballon d'Or, the first Englishman to win it since Michael Owen in 2001 and only the fifth English winner.
He scored 73 goals in all competitions last season, 61 of them for Bayern.
About ten days later he signed a new three-year deal with Bayern running to 2029.
ESPN reports he beat Kylian Mbappe and Lamine Yamal and is Bayern's fourth Ballon d'Or winner after Beckenbauer, Muller and Rummenigge.
The Ballon d'Or website briefly published articles naming other winners before the ceremony.
background: Kane began his senior career with loans at Leyton Orient, Millwall, Norwich and Leicester, became Tottenham's all-time top scorer and joined Bayern in 2023 for about 100 million pounds.

headline: West Ham sack Nuno after 13 months and bring back Scott Parker
facts: West Ham dismissed Nuno on 3 November after just over 13 months and named Scott Parker, 46, on a 30-month contract.
Parker's first match was at Cardiff; West Ham were eighth, six points behind leaders Middlesbrough.
Parker had been out of work since leaving Burnley by mutual consent in April, and Mark Noble will work closely with him.

The FA charged Eckert with three breaches of Rule E3.1; in September he got a suspended six-week ban and a fine, and owner Dragan Solak says the club is confident he has learned from it.
Southampton were thrown out of the 2026 Championship play-off final after admitting that a staff member spied on Middlesbrough's training; they were also docked four points this season.

On 20 November 2026 Eckert signed a new contract to 2029; owner Dragan Solak had backed him throughout.

headline: Thomas Muller says MLS has no relegation fear and plays 'careless' style
facts: The 37-year-old Vancouver forward told Canadian outlet Global News that no promotion or relegation makes MLS defending less disciplined.
He said players face less pressure than in Europe, where bottom teams fight to survive, and that this hurts focus over 90 minutes.
He credited MLS with attractive attacking play and strong individual moments but said quality is less consistent.
Muller told Global News that without promotion and relegation players feel less pressure, so MLS teams can be careless defensively.
He described a laissez-faire approach that produces attacking highlights but less consistency, with players struggling to stay focused for 90 minutes.
He contrasted this with Europe, where relegation threatens budgets, staff and fans.
Muller says the lack of relegation makes MLS play more careless defensively, and that players are less focused for the full 90 minutes.
He calls the league more open and attacking, with good individual moments but less consistency.
background: Muller won the World Cup and Champions League with Bayern Munich and joined the Whitecaps in August 2025; he renewed his contract through next year.

headline: Infantino apologises to FIFA Council over abandoned World Cup stake sale
facts: At a three-hour Council meeting in Zurich on 15 October, Infantino apologised for not telling the Council sooner about a plan to sell a 20 percent stake in future FIFA tournaments to private investors.
The plan was dropped after strong opposition; the FA and UEFA still want him to resign, and UEFA wants all documents on the plan.
A FIFA Peace Prize given to Donald Trump in December 2025 is under review, with a decision due at the December 2026 Council meeting.
Infantino is seeking a fourth term at the March 2027 election in Morocco.
FIFA had planned to sell a 20% stake in future tournaments to private investors via a new company, FIFA Forward Enterprise, valued at $20bn.
At a FIFA Council meeting in Zurich Infantino apologised for not informing the council earlier; the plan was dropped after pushback from UEFA, CONCACAF and the AFC.
FA chair Debbie Hewitt said he is not fit to be president without answering the council's questions, and the FIFA Peace Prize given to Trump in December 2025 is likely to be scrapped.

headline: IFAB approves time-wasting countdowns, substitution limits and new VAR areas in February package
facts: After its AGM in Wales, IFAB introduced a five-second visual countdown for delayed throw-ins and goal kicks, a 10-second exit for substituted players and a one-minute wait off the pitch after treatment.
VAR may intervene on a clearly wrong second yellow, mistaken identity and, as an option, a clearly wrongly awarded corner.
The 2026/27 Laws take effect on 1 July 2026 and include referee body cameras as a competition option and a new dropped-ball rule.
background: This package set up the rules that leagues, including the Premier League and UEFA, have now been applying this season.

headline: IFAB unanimously approves red card for covering the mouth in confrontations and for walking off in protest
facts: After a special meeting in Vancouver, IFAB unanimously approved two FIFA-proposed amendments, both at the competition organiser's discretion.

A player who covers his mouth during a confrontation may be shown a red card, and a player who leaves the field in protest of a referee decision may be sent off; a team that causes abandonment will in principle forfeit.
The measures were to be implemented at the 2026 World Cup, with the 48 teams informed in the following weeks.
background: The mouth-covering rule followed the Vinicius Junior and Prestianni controversy at a Champions League tie and is the rule Neymar fell foul of this autumn.

football rule change covering mouth explained
member_headlines: IFAB unanimously approves red card for covering the mouth in confrontations and for walking off in protest

headline: IFAB clarifies VAR protocol for attacking-team offences before the ball is in play
facts: VAR may recommend an on-field review for clear attacking-team offences before a corner or free kick is taken if the offence directly affects a goal, penalty or disciplinary sanction.
If the referee confirms the offence, the right sanction is applied and the corner or free kick is retaken.
It was approved for the 2026 World Cup and will be reviewed after the tournament before any wider use.
background: The clarification is related to disputes over players pushing or blocking at set pieces, a recurring complaint about VAR.
footage_terms: IFAB VAR protocol set piece offence

headline: Brazil court bans Internacional defender until injured Cruzeiro forward Gabriel Pec returns
facts: On 28 July 2026 Brazil's Superior Court of Sports Justice suspended Victor Gabriel until Pec is back in training, capped at 180 days.
His tackle on 22 July fractured Pec's left tibia, and he was charged with violent play under Article 254.
The ruling was split: one judge wanted a standard six-match ban, but three others backed the longer penalty.
Gabriel said he did not mean to injure Pec and apologised; the decision can be appealed.
background: Pec had just joined Cruzeiro from LA Galaxy in a club-record deal of at least 12 million dollars.
member_headlines: Brazil court bans Internacional defender until injured Cruzeiro forward Gabriel Pec returns

headline: UEFA tells referee chiefs VAR is for clear and obvious errors only, not to re-referee matches
facts: UEFA's refereeing chief chaired a meeting of referee heads from all 55 member associations and stated that VAR should step in only for clear and obvious errors.
Delegates unanimously backed faster restarts; UEFA does not plan to adopt other optional World Cup measures such as red cards for covering the mouth or VAR checks on corners.
UEFA cited the World Cup incident where Switzerland's Breel Embolo was sent off for a second yellow against Argentina after a caution for Leandro Paredes was overturned on review.
background: This is the background statement before the 2026/27 season; the mistaken-identity check was one of the newly approved VAR areas.
footage_terms: Embolo second yellow Argentina Switzerland World Cup
UEFA VAR clear and obvious error
World Cup 2026 VAR controversy Paredes yellow

headline: Premier League adopts World Cup time-wasting limits and some VAR checks, rejects the mouth-covering red card
facts: For 2026-27 players treated on the pitch must leave for at least one minute, throw-ins and goal kicks get a five-second countdown, and substituted players have 10 seconds to leave.
VAR can now review a second yellow card given in error and card mistaken identity within the same incident, factual errors only.
The Premier League did not adopt VAR checks on wrongly awarded corners, red cards for covering the mouth, or mandatory hydration breaks.
background: Many of these measures were approved by IFAB after trials, and several were first used at the 2026 World Cup.

headline: UEFA referee chief Rosetti explains faster restarts, new VAR areas and the Clear Line video library
facts: Referees will be strict on time-wasting: substituted players have 10 seconds to leave, treated players leave for a minute, and delayed throw-ins or goal kicks can cost a corner after a five-second countdown.

VAR can now correct a sanction given to the wrong player and cancel a clearly wrong second yellow; UEFA chose not to adopt the mouth-covering red card and leaving the field in protest as red-card offences.
UEFA's Clear Line library has over 100 videos showing when VAR should and should not intervene, and referee numbers across Europe have grown by 90,000 since the Be a Referee campaign began in 2023.
background: Rosetti, a former top referee, has run UEFA refereeing since 2010 and has pushed the idea of minimal VAR interference.
footage_terms: Rosetti UEFA referees briefing Champions League
member_headlines: UEFA referee chief Rosetti explains faster restarts, new VAR areas and the Clear Line video library

headline: How Balogun's 40 million pound Everton move collapsed on deadline day and left Monaco frustrated

Everton renegotiated the club fee into performance-related terms, and Balogun walked away after feeling Everton were also pursuing Manchester United's Joshua Zirkzee.
Monaco had already pulled the sale of Lamine Camara to Chelsea, expecting Balogun's fee, and so ended up with neither deal.
background: Monaco's chief Thiago Scuro said Balogun had complained about his treatment, and Sky Sports considered a January revival unlikely.
footage_terms: Balogun Everton transfer collapse deadline day

headline: Stuttgart's Demirovic scores a Champions League hat-trick in 12 minutes against Viking
facts: Demirovic scored in the 20th, 26th and 32nd minutes for a 12-minute hat-trick in Stuttgart's Champions League game against Viking.
It was the first Champions League hat-trick of 2026-27, the first by a Stuttgart player and the fifth-earliest in competition history at 31 minutes 21 seconds.
Salah's treble for Liverpool against Rangers in October 2022 remains the fastest.
background: It was the first Bosnian hat-trick in the competition since Edin Dzeko for Roma in 2018, and Viking were making their first main-phase Champions League appearance. Older story, kept for background.
footage_terms: Demirovic hat-trick Stuttgart Viking Champions League
member_headlines: Stuttgart's Demirovic scores a Champions League hat-trick in 12 minutes against Viking

headline: Haaland says Porto player grabbed his backside in ill-tempered Champions League clash
facts: Haaland scored both goals in City's 2-0 win at Porto on 8 September and says Rosario grabbed his backside in stoppage time; Haaland was booked after a scuffle.
Porto complained that Marc Guehi should have been sent off for arm-to-head contact on Gabri Veiga, and players clashed in the tunnel at half-time.
UEFA had announced no action; it will wait for referee and delegate reports before deciding.
background: Haaland joined City in 2022; he now plays under Enzo Maresca.
member_headlines: Haaland says Porto player grabbed his backside in ill-tempered Champions League clash

headline: Luton boss Wilshere sent off for reaction to referee after no foul before Stevenage's opener
facts: Stevenage beat Luton 2-1; Luton's bench was angry that Dan Phillips was not penalised for a foul on Liam Walsh in the build-up to Dan Kemp's 23rd-minute opener.
Wilshere's reaction to referee Andrew Humphries was judged unacceptable and he watched the rest from the dressing room.
Assistant boss Chris Powell said officials should have handled the incidents better and that he believed Josh Magennis's winner came from an offside position.
background: Wilshere, a former Arsenal and England midfielder, is in his early days as a manager; he was also later involved in a post-match scuffle with Barnsley's boss in October.
member_headlines: Luton boss Wilshere sent off for reaction to referee after no foul before Stevenage's opener

headline: Arteta calls Sunderland penalty for Konsa foul 'unacceptable' as Arsenal still win 2-0
facts: Early in the second half Sunderland were given a penalty when Ezri Konsa was judged to have fouled Dan Ballard at a corner; referee Stuart Attwell gave it and VAR upheld it.
Arteta called it unacceptable at this level, compared the contact to a judo throw and warned it could affect Arsenal's title chances.
David Raya saved Enzo Le Fee's penalty, Bruno Guimaraes scored from outside the box and Bukayo Saka added an injury-time penalty in a 2-0 Arsenal win.
background: Arteta has a history of public complaints about officials, and Arsenal were Premier League champions last season.
footage_terms: Raya saves penalty Le Fee Arsenal Sunderland
member_headlines: Arteta calls Sunderland penalty for Konsa foul 'unacceptable' as Arsenal still win 2-0

headline: Philippe Coutinho, 34, signs for Neymar's Santos after months without a club
facts: Coutinho was set to join Santos for the rest of the year, though the club had not formally announced it.
He left Vasco da Gama in February and had no club since, citing mental exhaustion.
Neymar welcomed him in a video after Santos beat Cruzeiro 2-1, and coach Cuca said he is in good shape.
background: Coutinho is a former Liverpool and Barcelona midfielder and played with Neymar for Brazil.
member_headlines: Philippe Coutinho, 34, signs for Neymar's Santos after months without a club

headline: Goalkeeper Noah Atubolu saves a sixth straight Bundesliga penalty for Frankfurt
facts: Atubolu saved a penalty in the Rhine-Main derby in gameweek three, his sixth in a row, a Bundesliga goalkeeper record.
He has not been beaten from the spot since May 2024 and is on loan at Frankfurt from Freiburg after spending pre-season away from the first team.
Reports say Germany coach Julian Nagelsmann is considering him for a senior call-up.
background: Atubolu, 24, from Freiburg with German and Nigerian heritage, was Freiburg's number one from 2023-24 and reached the U-21 Euro final in 2025, lost to England. Older story, kept for background.
member_headlines: Goalkeeper Noah Atubolu saves a sixth straight Bundesliga penalty for Frankfurt

headline: Al Taawoun fined and fans banned after Diogo Jota chants aimed at Ruben Neves
facts: The Saudi federation ordered Al Taawoun to play two home games behind closed doors and fined it 100,000 riyals after fans chanted Jota's name during a 6-0 loss to Al Hilal.
The ruling cannot be appealed; Ronaldo called for lifetime stadium bans for those involved.
Ruben Neves, a close friend of Jota, reacted sarcastically to the chants.
background: Jota, the Liverpool and Portugal forward, died in a car crash in Spain in July 2025; Neves played with him for Wolves.
member_headlines: Al Taawoun fined and fans banned after Diogo Jota chants aimed at Ruben Neves

headline: Man City teen Floyd Samba scores twice on debut, compared to Pogba
facts: ESPN says the 17-year-old scored two goals on his senior debut in a 5-0 Carabao Cup win over Norwich, with Enzo Maresca playing him as a striker.
He is about 6 feet tall, a free-kick specialist, and models his game on Paul Pogba as a box-to-box No. 8.
He scored a notable free kick against Man United in last season's FA Youth Cup final.
This is background older than 45 days.
background: City lack a natural backup for Erling Haaland, which could open striker minutes for him.
footage_terms: Floyd Samba Manchester City debut goals
Floyd Samba free kick FA Youth Cup final
member_headlines: Man City teen Floyd Samba scores twice on debut, compared to Pogba

headline: Paris FC coach Liam Rosenior taunts former club Strasbourg's fans and sparks a mass melee
facts: Paris FC beat Strasbourg 2-1 with goals from Ilan Kebbal and Pablo Pagis plus a late Moustapha Mbow own goal.
After the final whistle Rosenior ran to the away fans and gestured at them, and about 30 people from both sides rushed in for a mass shoving match.
Rosenior said a small section of Strasbourg's support had disrespected his family and that the chants were a step too far.
background: Rosenior spent 18 months as Strasbourg head coach before joining Chelsea, and Paris FC were second in Ligue 1 at the time.
footage_terms: Rosenior Strasbourg fans melee Paris FC
member_headlines: Paris FC coach Liam Rosenior taunts former club Strasbourg's fans and sparks a mass melee

headline: Mohamed Salah scores his first Trabzonspor hat trick in a 4-0 win over Galatasaray
facts: Salah scored a hat trick as Trabzonspor beat league leaders Galatasaray 4-0.
It was his first hat trick for the club, and he also set up Noah Saviolo's goal.
He had seven league goals at that point. A street in Yomra, Turkiye is also set to be named after him, per ESPN on 31 August.
background: ESPN reports Salah, 34, joined Trabzonspor in summer 2026 after leaving Liverpool, on about 17 million euros a season.
member_headlines: Mohamed Salah scores his first Trabzonspor hat trick in a 4-0 win over Galatasaray

headline: Teenager pleads not guilty over racist message to England defender Jess Carter during Euro 2025
facts: A 19-year-old appeared at Chelmsford Magistrates' Court and pleaded not guilty.
The charge is sending an offensive or menacing message over a public network on July 17, 2025, the day of England's quarter-final against Sweden.
Trial is set for October 2027 at Cambridge Magistrates' Court.
The defendant is presumed innocent unless proven guilty.
background: Jess Carter was part of England's Euro 2025 squad and has since moved from Gotham to Bay FC in the NWSL.
member_headlines: Teenager pleads not guilty over racist message to England defender Jess Carter during Euro 2025

headline: Barcelona and Florentino Perez due in a Madrid court on 25 November over his Negreira comments
facts: Barcelona took legal action on 12 June over comments Perez made on 12 May, which the club says were knowingly false and defamatory.
Perez had called the Negreira case the most serious case of corruption in football and said his club's trophy count would be higher without rivals' gains.
AFP sources said both sides are due before a Madrid court for a conciliation hearing on 25 November; if conciliation fails, the club plans a criminal complaint.
background: A court cleared Barcelona of bribery charges in 2024, and Barcelona says the payments to Negreira were for referee reports.
member_headlines: Barcelona and Florentino Perez due in a Madrid court on 25 November over his Negreira comments

headline: Monaco top Ligue 1 under new coach Filipe Luis while leaning on a teenage academy
facts: Monaco led Ligue 1 under new head coach Filipe Luis, with four wins and a draw from their first five league games.
Eric Dier is a senior defender and also coaches the club's under-17s at the La Diagonale academy.
Monaco have no Champions League income this season and are recruiting players aged 15 to 17 to compete with rivals.
background: Filipe Luis is a former Chelsea and Atletico Madrid left-back who won the Copa Libertadores as Flamengo coach; Monaco later slipped to 7th in the table with 16 points after 10 games.
member_headlines: Monaco top Ligue 1 under new coach Filipe Luis while leaning on a teenage academy

headline: Joan Laporta says he made peace with Atletico over the Julian Alvarez affair
facts: On 30 September 2026 Laporta said he had repaired his relationship with Atletico CEO Miguel Angel Gil Marin after the summer row over Barcelona pursuing Julian Alvarez.
Atletico objected to Barcelona discussing a player under contract while Barcelona's finances were under La Liga scrutiny; Gil Marin had called the affair a private circus.

Laporta said the two embraced at the European clubs' assembly in Copenhagen. The account is Laporta's own, not a joint statement. Alvarez later helped set up Atletico's goal in their 1-2 loss to Barcelona on 8 November.
background: Atletico said in June that Barcelona's 100 million euro offer for Alvarez had come in on a Friday, a claim Barcelona disputed.
member_headlines: Joan Laporta says he made peace with Atletico over the Julian Alvarez affair

headline: Man City found guilty of breaking more than 100 Premier League financial rules
facts: An independent commission found City used sham sponsorship contracts between 2009/10 and 2017/18 to inflate revenue by 830 million pounds.
It also found misleading accounts, breaches of Premier League and UEFA spending limits, and a failure to cooperate; three of four cooperation-related charges were upheld and one was not proven.
No sanction has been set yet; a further hearing will decide it, with points deductions, fines, transfer bans or expulsion all possible.
City lodged an appeal on 1 October; the rules point to a decision around Christmas or January, and the club says it is innocent.
background: The period covered by the case is 2009/10 to 2017/18, and City were first charged in February 2023.
footage_terms: Manchester City verdict Premier League reaction
member_headlines: Man City found guilty of breaking more than 100 Premier League financial rules

headline: FA Cup qualifier replayed after referee error with a penalty, and the same team wins again
facts: In an FA Cup second qualifying round tie, Woodford were awarded a penalty but players entered the box early; the referee gave Mulbarton an indirect free kick instead of ordering a retake.
An FA subcommittee under the Professional Game Board ordered a replay after Woodford appealed the original 2-1 Mulbarton win.
Mulbarton won the replay 2-0, both goals from Ashley Jarvis, and moved on to face Gloucester Town in the third qualifying round.
background: Both clubs play at the deep non-league level, where an FA Cup qualifying run is the biggest stage of the season.
footage_terms: Mulbarton Wanderers Woodford Town FA Cup replay
FA Cup qualifying penalty retake referee error
member_headlines: FA Cup qualifier replayed after referee error with a penalty, and the same team wins again

headline: UEFA examines Real Madrid's Negreira documents on Barcelona
facts: Football Espana reported that UEFA announced on 1 October 2026 it is investigating Barcelona, with its ethics and disciplinary inspectors assessing documents Real Madrid sent about the Negreira case.
The report stresses that the announcement does not establish wrongdoing or any sanction, and no outcome or timetable was given.
Negreira is a former vice-president of the Spanish referees' technical committee; a separate RFEF disciplinary matter involving Barcelona also exists.
background: Spanish courts have examined up to 7 million euros in payments from Barcelona to Negreira-linked companies over about two decades; Barcelona says they were for referee reports and denies wrongdoing.
member_headlines: UEFA examines Real Madrid's Negreira documents on Barcelona

headline: Australian top referees strike ends as Football Australia reaches deal after a month
facts: Nearly 100 top referees, represented by the PFRA, had been on strike since 4 September over a Football Australia plan to contract them to the APL rather than to FA.
The strike threatened the Australia Cup final and the start of the A-League seasons, including the opening Sydney derby on 16 October.
The 2 October deal keeps referees employed by Football Australia for 2026-27, with the APL covering the costs of A-League matches while longer-term talks continue.
background: Referees rarely strike in top-level football, which is why the threat of bringing in overseas officials made headlines.
footage_terms: Australia Cup final 2026 South Melbourne Victory
member_headlines: Australian top referees strike ends as Football Australia reaches deal after a month

headline: Kevin De Bruyne scores his 200th and 201st career goals for Belgium
facts: De Bruyne scored twice in Belgium's 3-0 Nations League win over Turkiye in Liege.
Substitute Romelu Lukaku sealed the win.
De Bruyne is 35 and plays for Napoli. Belgium, now under Mark van Bommel, trail France by a point in their group.
background: De Bruyne spent a decade at Manchester City before moving to Napoli.
member_headlines: Kevin De Bruyne scores his 200th and 201st career goals for Belgium

headline: England hammer Croatia 7-0 in Rijeka, Kane scores twice and nears Shilton's cap record
facts: England won 7-0 on 3 October; Kane scored twice, Saka twice, with Bellingham, Gordon and Rogers also scoring.
It was England's biggest win over Croatia and Croatia's heaviest defeat.
Croatia were coached by Slaven Bilic and led by Luka Modric, and Alex Scott started for England for the first time.
background: England and Croatia met in the 2018 World Cup semi-final, which Croatia won, so this result closed an old score.
member_headlines: England hammer Croatia 7-0 in Rijeka, Kane scores twice and nears Shilton's cap record

headline: Celtic condemn tennis-ball protest aimed at owner Dermot Desmond at St Andrews
facts: Tennis balls bearing Desmond's crossed-out face were thrown onto the 15th green at the Alfred Dunhill Links pro-am, and security escorted him off the course.
The Celtic Fans Collective posted the protest and called for change and accountability at the top of the club.
Celtic called it premeditated, said it no longer accepts the Fans Collective speaks for the wider support, and Police Scotland said enquiries were ongoing with no injuries.
background: Dermot Desmond is Celtic's principal shareholder.
member_headlines: Celtic condemn tennis-ball protest aimed at owner Dermot Desmond at St Andrews

headline: South Korea's Asian Games stars apologise for military exemption remarks
facts: South Korea beat Japan 1-0 in the Asian Games final through a goal by Swansea's Eom Jisung, a fourth straight title.
Tottenham's Yang Min-hyeok, on loan at Westerlo, said the military exemption was the real prize; he and teammates later apologised.
Gold in the Asian Games exempts able-bodied Korean men from military service.
background: South Korean men must normally serve in the military before turning 28, which makes Asian Games gold a major career prize.
footage_terms: South Korea Japan Asian Games final highlights
Asian Games football final Korea gold
member_headlines: South Korea's Asian Games stars apologise for military exemption remarks

headline: Raphinha's Barcelona contract runs to June 2030
facts: Football Espana reported on 6 October 2026, citing Fabrizio Romano, that Raphinha agreed a new Barcelona contract through June 2030.
No salary or release-clause figures were reported, and the formal club announcement was still pending at that point.
Wikipedia dates the official extension to 5 November 2026. In September, a separate piece described the revival of his Barcelona career as starting with one phone call from Hansi Flick.
background: Raphinha joined Barcelona from Leeds United in 2022 and has become a regular goalscorer under Hansi Flick.
member_headlines: Raphinha's Barcelona contract runs to June 2030

headline: Messi plays his last Argentina match, ending a 21-year international career
facts: ESPN reports Messi played his final Argentina match on 6 October 2026, a friendly win over Benin, scoring a penalty.
Messi's last official match was the 1-0 World Cup final loss to Spain; ESPN gives his farewell numbers as 208 appearances and 126 goals (a second ESPN piece says 207 caps and 125 goals).
Messi will return to Argentina on 19 January 2027 with Inter Miami for a friendly against River Plate at the Monumental.
background: Messi captained Argentina to the 2022 World Cup and two Copa America titles, and he is still playing club football for Inter Miami in MLS.
member_headlines: Messi plays his last Argentina match, ending a 21-year international career

headline: Kane equals Shilton's England appearance record in a 3-0 win over Czechia
facts: Kane reached 125 caps, level with Peter Shilton, in England's 3-0 home win over Czechia, scoring twice and adding an assist.
He has played in all but one of England's last 101 competitive matches, the exception being the 2024 Nations League loss to Greece.
ESPN later reports he became the outright record holder against Croatia at Wembley on 12 November.
background: Kane made his England debut at 21 and the article notes the only big gap in his career is a major trophy, as England's last was in 1966.
member_headlines: Kane equals Shilton's England appearance record in a 3-0 win over Czechia

headline: Messi plays his 208th and last match for Argentina in a 3-0 win over Benin
facts: Argentina beat Benin 3-0 on 6 October in Messi's farewell match, his 208th and final senior cap.
He captained Argentina to the World Cup final, lost 1-0 after extra time to Spain on 19 July, scoring 8 goals at the tournament.
Sports Illustrated says Messi announced his Argentina retirement in August after the final.
background: Messi won the 2022 World Cup with Argentina and finished with 126 international goals, second to Ronaldo's record according to ESPN.
footage_terms: Argentina Spain World Cup final 2026 highlights
member_headlines: Messi plays his 208th and last match for Argentina in a 3-0 win over Benin

headline: Barcelona tribute to Messi after his last Argentina game
facts: Barcelona posted a tribute to Messi on 7 October 2026 after what the report calls his final match for Argentina, a 3-0 win over Benin.
Football Espana says Messi scored and assisted twice in that match.
The club's post traced his Argentina career back to the Beijing 2008 Olympic gold medal and used a photo of a young Messi with that medal.
background: Messi left Barcelona in 2021 and Argentina lost the 2026 World Cup final 1-0 to Spain on 19 July, per Wikipedia.
member_headlines: Barcelona tribute to Messi after his last Argentina game

headline: Dani Carvajal close to joining Getafe after leaving Real Madrid, pending LaLiga salary-limit approval
facts: Reports said the 34-year-old defender completed a medical and agreed terms with Getafe, but the deal is not official until LaLiga approves his registration.
His Real Madrid contract expired on 30 June 2026, so no fee is due.
Getafe must free up room under LaLiga's salary limit before they can register him.
Coach Jose Bordalas reportedly phoned Carvajal himself to explain his role; this is the situation as of 7 October.
background: Carvajal made his final Real Madrid appearance in May, setting up a goal in the win over Athletic Club, after winning multiple Champions League titles with the club.
member_headlines: Dani Carvajal close to joining Getafe after leaving Real Madrid, pending LaLiga salary-limit approval

headline: Al Ittihad's George Ilenikhena scores on Nigeria debut in AFCON qualifier
facts: The 20-year-old Al Ittihad forward scored a first-half stoppage-time equalizer on his Nigeria debut in a 2-1 win over Madagascar.
Alex Iwobi set up the goal and Moses Usor scored the winner; Victor Osimhen was injured.
Four days later he came off the bench in a 3-0 loss away to Guinea-Bissau.
background: Ilenikhena is a 20-year-old forward who plays his club football for Saudi side Al Ittihad.
member_headlines: Al Ittihad's George Ilenikhena scores on Nigeria debut in AFCON qualifier

headline: Nigeria draw 3-3 with Russia as brothers debut together
facts: Nigeria drew 3-3 with Russia in Nizhny Novgorod; Iheanacho scored about 10 minutes in, his 15th goal for Nigeria.
Russia led 3-1 before 19-year-old debutant Peter Edokpolor and a stoppage-time Akor Adams goal rescued the draw.
Abubakar and Abdullahi Umar became the first brothers to debut for Nigeria in the same match.
background: Coach Eric Chelle named five debutants in a heavily rotated side.
member_headlines: Nigeria draw 3-3 with Russia as brothers debut together

headline: Ivory Coast's Yalcouye scores on debut under returning coach Renard
facts: Renard started his second Ivory Coast spell with two wins and two clean sheets, beating Ghana 2-0 in Bouake.
Brighton midfielder Malick Yalcouye scored on debut in that win, with Yann Gboho also scoring.
In November, Yalcouye scored the opener in a 2-1 win over Gambia, and Ivory Coast lead Group C by three points.
background: Renard led Ivory Coast to the AFCON title eleven years earlier; Yalcouye is a 21-year-old midfielder.
footage_terms: Herve Renard Ivory Coast press conference
member_headlines: Ivory Coast's Yalcouye scores on debut under returning coach Renard

headline: Referee error costs West Ham: penalty given outside the box in 1-1 draw with QPR
facts: West Ham drew 1-1 with QPR on 9 October 2026 after a first-half penalty was awarded for a foul that replays showed was outside the box.
There is no VAR in the Championship, so the decision stood; Tomas Soucek called it a massive mistake and said the ball was won cleanly.
West Ham missed a late penalty from Jarrod Bowen, and a win would have taken them to the top of the Championship.
background: West Ham were relegated from the Premier League last season and have missed several late penalties this term, including against Charlton and QPR.
member_headlines: Referee error costs West Ham: penalty given outside the box in 1-1 draw with QPR

headline: Atletico mock Real Madrid on social media over Valverde's quick return from a 'grade three' ankle sprain
facts: Valverde was hurt in the 20 September derby at the Metropolitano, which Real Madrid lost 2-1, after a challenge by Kang-in Lee.
Real Madrid announced a grade-three ankle sprain on 22 September and sought a red card for the tackle.
Valverde returned to the squad for the Villarreal game 17 days later, and Atletico's official account posted an ironic message congratulating Madrid on 'making history' by proving medicine wrong.
No formal complaint from either club was reported.
background: The Madrid derby has been a feud this season, with Mourinho, now in charge at Real Madrid, criticising the referee after the derby defeat.
footage_terms: Valverde injury Atletico Real Madrid derby
member_headlines: Atletico mock Real Madrid on social media over Valverde's quick return from a 'grade three' ankle sprain

headline: Rayo's Sergio Camello has seven goals in seven games while Vallecas stadium stays closed
facts: Camello has seven goals in seven LaLiga games, and only Barcelona's Raphinha has scored more among Europe's top five leagues.
His previous league seasons brought five, three and three goals.
Madrid's council declared the Vallecas stadium unsafe, so Rayo played home games in Leganes while fans boycotted; they were due back on 10 October.
Camello credits more freedom, new coach Benat San Jose and therapy, and mentioned an anxiety episode after the Olympics.
background: Rayo reached the Conference League final last season, losing to Crystal Palace, and then lost coach Inigo Perez in the summer.
footage_terms: Rayo Vallecano Leganes home games boycott
member_headlines: Rayo's Sergio Camello has seven goals in seven games while Vallecas stadium stays closed

headline: Spurs and United draw 1-1: Bentancur red-carded for headbutting Luke Shaw, Solanke equalises in added time
facts: Bryan Mbeumo put United ahead in the 73rd minute; Dominic Solanke headed an equaliser at 90+2.
Rodrigo Bentancur was sent off about 12 minutes after coming on for headbutting Luke Shaw.
It was Tottenham's first point of the season from a draw and left United with 6 points. The page's shot map conflicts on scorers, so details are from the scoreboard and commentary.
background: Spurs beat United in the 2025 Europa League final.
footage_terms: Bentancur red card Luke Shaw headbutt
member_headlines: Spurs and United draw 1-1: Bentancur red-carded for headbutting Luke Shaw, Solanke equalises in added time

headline: Anthony Gordon scores his first Barcelona goal after about two minutes against Getafe
facts: Gordon scored his first Barcelona goal about two minutes into a 3-0 La Liga win over Getafe on 10 October 2026.
Gabriel Jesus and Jules Kounde also scored, according to the season match list. The win was Barcelona's eighth in a row.
Flick praised his speed, ball control and dribbling, and said Gordon gives the team a lot. Gordon plays on the left alongside Adeyemi, which lets Raphinha play as centre-forward.
background: Gordon joined from Newcastle in the summer on a deal reported at about 80 million euros, and his Barcelona debut in August brought two assists in a 5-0 win at Elche.
footage_terms: Anthony Gordon first Barcelona goal Getafe
Hansi Flick on Anthony Gordon press conference
member_headlines: Anthony Gordon scores his first Barcelona goal after about two minutes against Getafe

headline: Vinicius Junior sent off and has goal ruled out for pulling Villarreal's Saliba by the hair
facts: After a VAR review, Vinicius's goal was disallowed and he was shown a red card for pulling Villarreal midfielder Nathan Saliba's hair.
Real Madrid still won 1-0 against Villarreal, with Yan Diomande scoring the winner.
ESPN reported that Vinicius served the first game of a four-match ban against Sevilla on 18 October.
Real Madrid's Mourinho later said Vinicius should move on from his difficult summer.
background: Vinicius is playing under Mourinho at Real Madrid this season, and Mourinho has said he should move on from his difficult summer.
footage_terms: Vinicius red card hair pull Saliba
member_headlines: Vinicius Junior sent off and has goal ruled out for pulling Villarreal's Saliba by the hair

headline: Augsburg score within seconds at Bayern, who escape with a 2-2 draw
facts: Sky's highlights headline says Bayern fell behind after just six seconds before escaping a scare.
ESPN lists the match as 2-2 on 10 October, with Fellhauer scoring in the first minute after a Neuer mistake.
Saibari (55') and Nathaniel Brown (80') scored for Bayern.
background: Manuel Neuer has been Bayern's goalkeeper since 2011 and is credited by Rummenigge as the origin of the modern sweeper-keeper game.
member_headlines: Augsburg score within seconds at Bayern, who escape with a 2-2 draw

headline: Henderson taps the Chelsea badge after scoring and Liverpool fans fume
facts: Chelsea beat Bournemouth 5-1; Henderson scored in the second minute and added a free kick in the 70th.
After the second goal he tapped the Chelsea badge, and some Liverpool fans called it disrespectful.
It was only his second Chelsea appearance.
background: Henderson, 36, joined Chelsea in the summer after his Brentford contract was mutually terminated, and some Liverpool fans saw the move as betrayal.
member_headlines: Henderson taps the Chelsea badge after scoring and Liverpool fans fume

headline: Maresca's City win 3-0 at Anfield as Gravenberch is sent off
facts: City won 3-0 at Anfield after Gravenberch's second yellow on Doku around the 62nd minute; Haaland, Doku and Gvardiol scored.
The page says Maresca became only the fourth manager to win his first six Premier League matches.
Liverpool's xG was 0.86 to City's 1.30 and they dropped to ninth.
background: Maresca is in his first season as City manager, and City later lost three straight league games from late October, per ESPN.
member_headlines: Maresca's City win 3-0 at Anfield as Gravenberch is sent off

headline: Cristian Romero scores first Atletico goal, an 87th-minute header that wins at Alaves
facts: Alejandro Grimaldo opened the scoring, Lucas Boye equalised from a penalty before half-time, and Romero headed in Baena's cross in the 87th minute.
It was Romero's first goal for Atletico, and he played in a striker-like position for the finish.
The win ended a four-match winless run for Atletico.
It was Atletico's first win in four visits to Mendizorrotza.
background: Atletico signed Romero from Tottenham, where he was captain, in a reported 34 million pound deal this summer, ending a long pursuit.
member_headlines: Cristian Romero scores first Atletico goal, an 87th-minute header that wins at Alaves

headline: Isco scores twice as Betis hit five against Osasuna and climb to third
facts: Betis won 5-2 at home; Isco scored a 10th-minute penalty and a second goal after Osasuna had levelled with two goals at 56'.
Ezzalzouli, Diego Llorente and Jose Antonio Morante, who came on at 90', also scored.
Ante Budimir and Raul Garcia scored for Osasuna.
The win lifted Betis to third with 19 points from eight games, one point above Real Madrid.
background: Isco is a former Real Madrid and Spain playmaker who joined Betis in 2024 after leaving Sevilla.
member_headlines: Isco scores twice as Betis hit five against Osasuna and climb to third

headline: Corinthians hire Clarence Seedorf after seven straight league defeats
facts: Corinthians named Seedorf head coach on a contract running to the end of 2027, replacing Fernando Diniz who was fired after seven consecutive league losses.
The club was 16th of 20, one place above the relegation zone, at the time.
Seedorf last coached Cameroon more than seven years ago and none of his three previous club spells lasted longer than six months.
background: Seedorf is the only player to win the European Cup or Champions League with three different clubs: Ajax, Real Madrid and AC Milan.
member_headlines: Corinthians hire Clarence Seedorf after seven straight league defeats

headline: Coventry hammer Newcastle 4-1, their first home Premier League win in 25 years
facts: Coventry scored through Rudoni (6' penalty), Cherif (48'), Simms (81') and Mfuni (86'); Sven Botman got Newcastle's goal in the 70th minute.
It was Coventry's first home Premier League victory in 25 years.
Newcastle had 67% possession and higher expected goals (1.84 to 1.43) but wasted chances.
background: Newcastle were 11th after the defeat, having started the season by drawing 2-2 with Bournemouth.
footage_terms: Coventry City first home win Premier League
member_headlines: Coventry hammer Newcastle 4-1, their first home Premier League win in 25 years

headline: Lille weigh legal action after Tiago Santos ruptures ACL in uncarded Le Havre tackle
facts: Defender Tiago Santos, 24, ruptured the ACL in his right knee and will miss the rest of the season.
Lille called the tackle by Le Havre's Amir Richardson uncontrolled and dangerous; he was not shown a card.
Lille said they were considering legal action and asked the league to send the incident to its disciplinary panel.
background: It is Santos's second ACL injury, after a left-knee rupture in October 2024; Lille won the Le Havre game 1-0 and sat second in Ligue 1.
footage_terms: Lille Le Havre Tiago Santos injury
member_headlines: Lille weigh legal action after Tiago Santos ruptures ACL in uncarded Le Havre tackle

headline: Regulator's State of the Game report: 94% of clubs in top five divisions lost money
facts: English football earned over 9bn pounds in revenue last season, yet 94 per cent of clubs in the top five divisions lost money.
More than 60 per cent of EFL and National League clubs are technically insolvent, with liabilities above the book value of assets.
Over a quarter of clubs could not last a month without owner funding, and 32 clubs hold less than 30 days of cash cover.
background: The average Premier League club earns more than eight times the revenue of the average Championship club, and parachute payments add to Championship overspending.
footage_terms: Independent Football Regulator State of the Game
member_headlines: Regulator's State of the Game report: 94% of clubs in top five divisions lost money

headline: Barcelona come from behind to win 4-1 at Galatasaray
facts: Barcelona won 4-1 in Istanbul on 13 October 2026 after Galatasaray scored first through a deflection off Joao Cancelo.
Cancelo equalised in the 43rd minute. After the break Fermin Lopez headed in a Yamal cross, Gordon scored after Yamal created the chance, and substitute Karim Adeyemi added the fourth on the counter.
A Victor Osimhen header for Galatasaray was ruled out for offside after a VAR check.
background: The win gave Barcelona six points from their first two Champions League matches, as Gordon and Adeyemi were both summer signings.
member_headlines: Barcelona come from behind to win 4-1 at Galatasaray

headline: Atletico beat 10-man Manchester United 2-0 as Barrios scores after 47 seconds
facts: Pablo Barrios scored after 47 seconds at the Metropolitano, and Lookman added a second at 79' from a rebound.
Leny Yoro was sent off at 74' for denying Jonathan David a clear scoring chance.
The win gave Atletico their first points of this Champions League league phase.
Captain Koke's mother died that morning, a minute's silence was held, and the win was dedicated to him.
background: Atletico lost their league-phase opener 1-2 to Liverpool, who scored a late winner through Mac Allister.
footage_terms: Yoro red card Atletico Manchester United
member_headlines: Atletico beat 10-man Manchester United 2-0 as Barrios scores after 47 seconds

headline: Viking 3-3 Bayern: Norwegian side lead twice, Olise sent off for two quick yellows
facts: Viking led 2-0 by half-time; Kane scored a penalty and a header, then Diaz and Olise put Bayern 3-2 up.
Olise was booked twice in quick succession and Bayern played the rest with ten men.
Herman Haugen headed Viking's late equaliser in the 90th minute in Stavanger.
background: Bayern started this Champions League league phase with a 5-0 win at Bodo/Glimt, another Norwegian side, on 10 September.
footage_terms: Viking FK Bayern Munich Champions League
member_headlines: Viking 3-3 Bayern: Norwegian side lead twice, Olise sent off for two quick yellows

headline: Dortmund extend Kovac's contract to 2029
facts: Dortmund announced on 13 October that Kovac's deal now runs to June 2029.
The club says his 2.15 points per Bundesliga game is the best of any Dortmund coach.
His brother Robert and assistant Filip Tapalovic also extended.
background: Kovac took over in January 2025 with Dortmund 11th, finished fourth that season and second last season.
member_headlines: Dortmund extend Kovac's contract to 2029

headline: Arsenal score three in seven minutes to beat Lille 3-0 in the Champions League
facts: Arsenal were held until the 64th minute, when Jurrien Timber broke the deadlock.
Eberechi Eze and Bukayo Saka scored soon after, giving Arsenal three goals in just over seven minutes.
The win gave Arsenal six points from two Champions League games.
background: Lille went into the game second in Ligue 1 after beating Le Havre 1-0 and also lost 2-4 at home to Galatasaray in the league phase.
member_headlines: Arsenal score three in seven minutes to beat Lille 3-0 in the Champions League

headline: Vinicius sent off for hair pull, gets four-game ban and misses the Clasico
facts: Vinicius scored at Villarreal but the goal was disallowed and he was red-carded after VAR showed him pulling Nathan Saliba's hair; Madrid still won 1-0.
The federation gave two games for violent conduct and two for his reaction to the referee; the ban does not cover the Champions League.
He missed the games against Sevilla, Barcelona, Racing Santander and Valencia; he apologised on social media.
background: Mourinho questioned why the committee announced the punishment just before a big match; Yan Diomande scored the winner at Villarreal.
footage_terms: Vinicius red card Villarreal hair pull
member_headlines: Vinicius sent off for hair pull, gets four-game ban and misses the Clasico

headline: Real Madrid beat Roma 4-3 after trailing 3-1 with seven minutes left
facts: Roma led 3-1 through De Roon and two Malen goals before Espi, Endrick and Rudiger scored in the last seven minutes.
Arda Guler delivered the corner for Endrick and another set piece for Rudiger's winner.
Mbappe's goal came in his 100th Champions League appearance, making him the youngest to reach 100.
background: Mourinho returned to a former club, where a banner honoured his Conference League win with Roma.
member_headlines: Real Madrid beat Roma 4-3 after trailing 3-1 with seven minutes left

headline: Bodo/Glimt beat Dortmund 1-0 in the Arctic Circle
facts: Fredrik Sjovold scored in the 52nd minute from a Sondre Auklend cross in Bodo, Norway.
Dortmund were below their best for long spells and only pressed late; Nmecha was denied in stoppage time.
Expected goals were about 1.1 for Bodo/Glimt and 0.8 for Dortmund.
background: Bodo/Glimt play at the small Aspmyra stadium in northern Norway, where the crowd for this match was 7,885; Bayern had beaten them 5-0 in this league phase.
member_headlines: Bodo/Glimt beat Dortmund 1-0 in the Arctic Circle

headline: Gerrard backs Iraola at Liverpool and says keeping Gakpo was essential
facts: On Goal's Beast Mode On Podcast, Gerrard said Iraola earned the Liverpool job and needs patience to shape a title challenger.
He said keeping Gakpo was essential and praised the forward's World Cup, pre-season and start to the season.
Manchester City and Tottenham had both been interested in Gakpo in the summer.
background: Gerrard is a Liverpool legend who later managed Rangers and Aston Villa.
footage_terms: Steven Gerrard Beast Mode On podcast Liverpool
member_headlines: Gerrard backs Iraola at Liverpool and says keeping Gakpo was essential

headline: Seventeen straight Champions League games without a clean sheet for Barcelona
facts: Football Espana reported that Barcelona had gone 17 consecutive Champions League matches without a clean sheet.
Former Barcelona defender Abelardo said the team needs a top-level centre-back to win the competition, naming strikers like Kvaratskhelia and Harry Kane as the tests.
The piece notes Barcelona did not sign a centre-back in the summer window; they had won both league-phase games so far but conceded in each.
background: Barcelona had sold or loaned out Ronald Araujo to Liverpool in the summer, leaving Pau Cubarsi as the main young centre-back.
footage_terms: Hansi Flick high defensive line explained
member_headlines: Seventeen straight Champions League games without a clean sheet for Barcelona

headline: Lyon beat Crystal Palace 3-2 in Europa League as ex-Lyon coach Pierre Sage returns as visitor
facts: Lyon won 3-2 through Corentin Tolisso, Ernest Nuamah just before the break and Pavel Sulc.
Yeremy Pino and Daichi Kamada scored for Palace.
It was Lyon's second Europa League win in two games, after beating Anderlecht 2-1.
background: Pierre Sage managed Lyon from November 2023 to January 2025 and now coaches Palace; Lyon had dropped into the Europa League after losing a Champions League playoff to Fenerbahce.
member_headlines: Lyon beat Crystal Palace 3-2 in Europa League as ex-Lyon coach Pierre Sage returns as visitor

headline: Onana concedes a direct corner, saves a penalty and Salah scores as Trabzonspor beat KuPS 4-2
facts: Onana let in a corner from Petteri Pennanen directly, then dived to his right to save a penalty; the rebound went over the bar.
Paul Onuachu scored after three minutes, Salah made it 2-0 before half-time and now has eight goals in eight games; Franculino Dju scored his second in stoppage time.
Onana is on a second season-long loan from Manchester United, was told in the summer he was not in Michael Carrick's plans, and has two years left on his United deal.
background: Manchester United sacked Michael Carrick on 12 November, a month after this story, according to ESPN's report on Crystal Palace's own sacking.
member_headlines: Onana concedes a direct corner, saves a penalty and Salah scores as Trabzonspor beat KuPS 4-2

headline: Rutter bags a brace as Brighton thrash Kauno Zalgiris 4-0 on their Conference League debut
facts: Georginio Rutter scored in the 41st and 53rd minutes on his first start since the opening day, after losing his place to teenager Charalampos Kostoulas.
Jack Hinshelwood (45+2) and Matt O'Riley (67') also scored; Hinshelwood returned from an ankle injury that kept him out since August.
Brighton arrived on a four-match winning streak in all competitions that included wins over Arsenal and Manchester United.
background: Kauno Zalgiris are the Lithuanian champions who dropped down into the Conference League after losing in the Champions League and Europa League play-offs.
member_headlines: Rutter bags a brace as Brighton thrash Kauno Zalgiris 4-0 on their Conference League debut

headline: Balogun's World Cup ban suspended after Trump call; FIFA to review disciplinary process
facts: The one-match ban on USA striker Folarin Balogun was suspended during the World Cup, after a call from Donald Trump to Infantino, according to Sky's report of the Council background.
Balogun played for the USA against Belgium while suspended; Sky raises questions about whether Trump or Infantino pressured the disciplinary committee.
FIFA's Legal Committee will review disciplinary procedures, with findings due at the December 2026 Council meeting.
The FA wrote to Infantino on 17 September about the World Cup sell-off plan and the Balogun controversy.
background: Balogun is a USA international whose move from Monaco to Everton collapsed on deadline day in September 2026.
member_headlines: Balogun's World Cup ban suspended after Trump call; FIFA to review disciplinary process

headline: Nigeria's Super Falcons set 2028 Olympic gold as goal after WAFCON and World Cup failures
facts: Interim coach Augustine Eguavoen said the team set its eyes on an Olympic gold medal in 2028.
Nigeria lost the 2026 WAFCON quarter-final to Cameroon and lost a World Cup playoff to South Africa.
They beat Comoros 7-0 on aggregate in Olympic qualifying and face Morocco next.
Eguavoen called the gold goal easier said than done.
background: Nigeria have won a record 10 African titles but never an Olympic medal; their best was the quarter-finals at Athens 2004.
footage_terms: Super Falcons Olympic qualifier Comoros highlights
member_headlines: Nigeria's Super Falcons set 2028 Olympic gold as goal after WAFCON and World Cup failures

headline: Barcelona wear 'GOLF' on the shirt for El Clasico, Tyler, The Creator collab
facts: The word GOLF on the front promotes Tyler, The Creator's GOLF WANG brand in a Spotify campaign.
The shirt was for the El Clasico on 25 October, and only 1,899 matchday shirts were sold to the public.
Spotify gave an artist full creative control over a campaign for the first time.
background: Spotify has sponsored Barcelona since 2022, and past Clasico shirts have featured artists starting with Drake in 2022.
footage_terms: Barcelona Real Madrid El Clasico October 2026 highlights
member_headlines: Barcelona wear 'GOLF' on the shirt for El Clasico, Tyler, The Creator collab

headline: Lautaro Martinez to miss about seven games with a hamstring strain
facts: Tests showed a strain in Lautaro's left hamstring; he was expected to miss seven games including the derby on 31 October.
He scored twice in Inter's 4-3 home defeat to Club Brugge in the Champions League on 13 October.
He had six goals in seven games across Serie A and the Champions League this season, and a return was expected around Inter's trip to Atalanta on 22 November.
background: Lautaro is Inter's captain and has led their attack for years; Inter are the reigning Serie A champions under coach Cristian Chivu.
member_headlines: Lautaro Martinez to miss about seven games with a hamstring strain

headline: Aaron Ramsey's Oxford play with nine, briefly eight men at Mansfield and argue over disputed red and dive card
facts: Oxford drew 1-1 at Mansfield after Luka Lynch scored on his first start; Michael Smith equalised in the 82nd minute.
Gatlin O'Donkor got a second booking with six minutes left, and Oxford were briefly down to eight when Brodie Spencer went off after an injury stoppage.

Ramsey disagreed with the first red card, arguing there was contact in the area that should have been a penalty, and disputed Peter Kioso's 75th-minute booking for diving; Kioso was later sent off for a second yellow.
background: Ramsey is a former Arsenal, Juventus and Wales midfielder who is now managing Oxford United.
footage_terms: Aaron Ramsey press conference Oxford eight men
member_headlines: Aaron Ramsey's Oxford play with nine, briefly eight men at Mansfield and argue over disputed red and dive card

headline: Villa win 1-0 at Newcastle through Manzambi; Emery picks up his 100th Premier League win
facts: Johan Manzambi headed the only goal in the 36th minute at St James' Park.
Villa won consecutive league matches at St James' Park for the first time since 1957-58.
It was Unai Emery's 100th Premier League win as a manager; goalkeeper Zion Suzuki made key saves, including one late on.
background: Villa and Newcastle both finished the match on 8 points.
member_headlines: Villa win 1-0 at Newcastle through Manzambi; Emery picks up his 100th Premier League win

headline: Alex Iwobi's goal gives Arbeloa's Fulham their first Premier League win, 1-0 over Hull
facts: Fulham beat Hull City 1-0 at Craven Cottage on 17 October 2026 through Alex Iwobi's 33rd-minute goal.
It was Alvaro Arbeloa's first league win after six league games without one, and it lifted Fulham out of the bottom three.
Ryan Sessegnon was sent off late for a foul on Robinio Vaz.
background: Arbeloa is the Spanish former Real Madrid defender now in charge at Fulham.
member_headlines: Alex Iwobi's goal gives Arbeloa's Fulham their first Premier League win, 1-0 over Hull

headline: SE Dons, the YouTube and Sunday League club, are one win from the FA Cup first round
facts: SE Dons came from 2-1 down to beat Chichester City 3-2, then won 5-1 away at Weymouth, leaving them one win from the first round proper.
In their first FA Cup campaign they have played six matches including a replay, have beaten four higher-league sides and next face Sholing.
They are one of only three clubs left that entered at the extra preliminary round.
background: Rapper Don Strapzy founded the club in 2014 as a Sunday League side in south-east London, and it now has more than 250,000 YouTube subscribers; the result of the Sholing tie was not checked.
member_headlines: SE Dons, the YouTube and Sunday League club, are one win from the FA Cup first round

headline: Barcelona rout Betis 5-2 to equal Real Madrid's record La Liga start
facts: Barcelona won 5-2 at Betis on 17 October 2026, their ninth straight league win, matching Real Madrid's 1968-69 record for the best start to a La Liga season.
Yamal opened with a backheel turn and curled finish that won La Liga Goal of the Month for October. Rodri scored his first Barcelona goal, a header from a Fermin corner.
Sky reports Barcelona scored 39 goals in nine games, the best start by any team in 86 years. Flick called Yamal the best player in the world.
background: Rodri, a former Ballon d'Or winner, joined from Manchester City in August 2026 on a four-year deal reported at up to 76.5 million euros.
member_headlines: Barcelona rout Betis 5-2 to equal Real Madrid's record La Liga start

headline: Baena's 89th-minute goal at Espanyol gives Atletico a fifth straight league win
facts: Alex Baena scored in the 89th minute into the top corner after a pass from Julian Alvarez, which was Alvarez's first league assist of the season.
It was Atletico's fifth straight league win and their second successive late away win.
Baena came on at 62' for Lee Kang-in; Simeone praised his decisiveness and strength after last season's injuries.
Cristian Romero asked to come off with an adductor strain and missed the next Champions League trip.
background: Baena joined Atletico from Villarreal in 2025, and this was Atletico's longest league winning run since October to November 2025.
member_headlines: Baena's 89th-minute goal at Espanyol gives Atletico a fifth straight league win

headline: Pellegrini blames 'inexplicable decisions' after Betis lose 2-5 to Barcelona
facts: Betis lost 2-5 at La Cartuja on 17 October, and Facundo Bernal was sent off shortly after Abde Ezzalzouli made it 3-2.
Pellegrini said a Lo Celso goal was wrongly disallowed for handball and that Barcelona's third goal should have been ruled out for a high foot by Fermin Lopez.
He felt Bernal was provoked by Lamine Yamal and that both should have been punished.
He said the game was even until the red card, and the result equalled Barcelona's record league start.
background: Pellegrini is a former Manchester City and Real Madrid coach who took over Betis in 2024 and reached the Conference League final in 2025.
member_headlines: Pellegrini blames 'inexplicable decisions' after Betis lose 2-5 to Barcelona

headline: Bayern thrash Leipzig 6-1 as Luis Diaz scores a hat-trick
facts: Bayern won 6-1 at the Allianz Arena on 17 October; Diaz scored three, with Pavlovic, Olise and Kane adding one each per ESPN's scorer list.
Leipzig's only goal came in stoppage time.
The result moved Bayern back to the top of the Bundesliga.
background: Luis Diaz joined Bayern from Liverpool in 2025, where he had been a regular goalscorer on the left wing.
member_headlines: Bayern thrash Leipzig 6-1 as Luis Diaz scores a hat-trick

headline: Strasbourg 1-3 PSG: Dembele misses a penalty then scores, Reyna opens the scoring for Strasbourg
facts: Gio Reyna put Strasbourg ahead in the 17th minute, and PSG scored three times in the second half.
Illya Zabarnyi equalised around the 77th minute, Dembele scored in the 85th, and Desire Doue added a stoppage-time goal.
Dembele had missed a penalty in the 72nd minute after a handball by Pape Demba Diop; Luis Enrique had rested Doue, Vitinha, Nuno Mendes and Hakimi to start ahead of the Barcelona game.
background: Dembele is the 2025 Ballon d'Or winner as described by Sky Sports, and Reyna joined Strasbourg from Borussia Monchengladbach this season.
member_headlines: Strasbourg 1-3 PSG: Dembele misses a penalty then scores, Reyna opens the scoring for Strasbourg

headline: Wrexham boss Phil Parkinson eases pressure with 4-1 win over Preston
facts: Wrexham beat bottom club Preston 4-1 with goals from Devine, Whiteman, Smith and Moore.
A 2-1 home loss to West Brom earlier had left them near the bottom, and Steven Gerrard had been linked with the job.
The win moved Wrexham up to 14th.
background: Whiteman, who scored against his former club Preston, was one of four scorers.
member_headlines: Wrexham boss Phil Parkinson eases pressure with 4-1 win over Preston

headline: Mourinho: Vinicius should have left Real Madrid in the summer
facts: Sky Sports reports Mourinho said Vinicius should have left Real Madrid in the summer.
He argued the player would have received more respect in another country.
Arsenal were one of the clubs interested in the winger.
background: Vinicius later signed a long-term deal in August to stay; Mourinho returned as Madrid coach in July 2026.
footage_terms: Mourinho press conference Real Madrid October 2026
member_headlines: Mourinho: Vinicius should have left Real Madrid in the summer

headline: Real Madrid thump Sevilla 4-1 while Vinicius serves ban
facts: Guler scored in the 30th minute, Mbappe in the 37th and 63rd (penalty), and Diomande in the 82nd; Bueno scored for Sevilla.
Sky Sports' highlights headline described an Mbappe goal and Panenka penalty.
It was Madrid's first league game after Vinicius's red card.
background: Madrid had lost to Atletico 2-1 on 20 September and to Betis earlier in the season.
member_headlines: Real Madrid thump Sevilla 4-1 while Vinicius serves ban

headline: Man City fans carry inflatable bananas in defiance after 115-charges verdict
facts: City fans are taking inflatable bananas to games after the club was found guilty of 115 charges by an independent commission.
Former striker Imre Varadi sells branded bananas for 10 pounds and says demand has gone through the roof.
The tradition dates to 1987, when Frank Newton brought one to a game against Plymouth.
background: The inflatable craze started in the 1987 season, long before the City ownership era.
member_headlines: Man City fans carry inflatable bananas in defiance after 115-charges verdict

headline: Celtic thrash Hearts 7-1, five months after Hearts lost the title to a last-gasp Celtic goal
facts: Celtic won 7-1 at Parkhead with goals from Tierney, Nygren (two), Osmand (two), Duran and Baur, plus an own goal reported in the match report; Laurent Mendy scored for Hearts.
Celtic moved four points clear of Rangers, while Hearts arrived as the division's top scorers.
Hearts had 23 set-piece goals, the most in the league, and Celtic signed set-piece coach Ross Grant from Hearts' staff over the summer.
background: It was the first meeting since Osmand's goal sealed Celtic's last-gasp title win over Hearts. Scoring details in the match report are inconsistent, so exact scorers should be rechecked.
footage_terms: Celtic Hearts title decider Osmand goal
Martin O'Neill press conference Celtic Hearts
member_headlines: Celtic thrash Hearts 7-1, five months after Hearts lost the title to a last-gasp Celtic goal

headline: Spurs finally win a league game: 3-1 over Coventry lifts them off the bottom
facts: James Maddison, Omar Marmoush and Ben Davies (90+6') scored for Spurs; Jack Rudoni replied for Coventry.
It was Tottenham's first Premier League win of the season and moved them off the bottom of the table.
Spurs had 65% possession and five shots on target to Coventry's one.
background: De Zerbi arrived at Spurs after the club had faced relegation last season, and Spurs spent over £330m this summer, per Sky Sports.
member_headlines: Spurs finally win a league game: 3-1 over Coventry lifts them off the bottom

headline: Brentford call police over rugby ball thrown at pitch in Liverpool defeat
facts: Footage showed a person apparently kicking a rugby ball toward the pitch from a nearby rooftop during Brentford v Liverpool on 17 October 2026.
Brentford called the behaviour dangerous, referred it to police and are supporting the investigation.
Liverpool won 2-1 with a late Alexander Isak goal while Brentford were down to nine men.
background: The Liverpool win moved Liverpool above Brentford into fifth place.
member_headlines: Brentford call police over rugby ball thrown at pitch in Liverpool defeat

headline: Barcelona score 39 goals in nine games, the best LaLiga start in 86 years
facts: Barcelona beat Real Betis 5-2 to make it nine wins from nine in LaLiga, with 39 goals scored.
Sky says that is the best scoring start to a LaLiga season by any team in 86 years.
Nine opening wins is the longest run to start a campaign in 58 years.
background: Hansi Flick's Barcelona won a second straight LaLiga title last season with 94 points.
member_headlines: Barcelona score 39 goals in nine games, the best LaLiga start in 86 years

headline: Lazio post best-ever Serie A start after beating Juventus 3-0 in Turin
facts: Lazio won 3-0 at Juventus, their best-ever start to a Serie A season.
Oliver Provstgaard scored in the game, only the second top-division goal of his career.
Lazio's six-match winning run later ended in a 1-1 draw at Napoli in early November, with Inter one point behind.
background: Lazio last won Serie A in 1999-2000, and Juventus are one of Italy's most decorated clubs.
member_headlines: Lazio post best-ever Serie A start after beating Juventus 3-0 in Turin

headline: CAS to rule on Senegal v Morocco AFCON final dispute by end of November
facts: In January Senegal beat host Morocco in the final after their players walked off in protest at a late Morocco penalty; Morocco's penalty was then saved and Senegal scored the only goal in extra time.
In March CAF overturned the result and awarded Morocco a 3-0 default win; Senegal appealed to the Court of Arbitration for Sport.
CAS held its hearing on 8 October in Lausanne and said a ruling is expected by the end of November.
background: The final in Rabat saw a 15-minute stoppage and fan clashes; Morocco currently hold the title only through the CAF ruling.
footage_terms: Senegal Morocco AFCON final walk off
Senegal Morocco final penalty saved Brahim Diaz
member_headlines: CAS to rule on Senegal v Morocco AFCON final dispute by end of November

headline: Jack Wilshere scuffles with Barnsley boss Daniel Stendel after Luton win
facts: Luton boss Jack Wilshere clashed with Barnsley manager Daniel Stendel after Luton's 2-1 win on a Tuesday night.
Wilshere reportedly shook Stendel's hand, then pushed him, sparking a bigger melee on the pitch; the cause was not stated.
Wilshere played it down, saying both sides wanted to win and that he respects Barnsley.
background: Wilshere is a former Arsenal midfielder; Luton were 13th in League One and Barnsley 22nd at the time, and ESPN compared it to the 2022 Conte-Tuchel clash.
member_headlines: Jack Wilshere scuffles with Barnsley boss Daniel Stendel after Luton win

headline: PSG beat Barcelona 4-2 in a Champions League thriller, ending a 12-match unbeaten run
facts: PSG won 4-2 at the Parc des Princes on 20 October 2026, Barcelona's first defeat of the season after 12 unbeaten games.
Doue scored after a Lamine Yamal mistake in the 38th minute. Teenager Xavi Espart equalised in the 55th and Yamal made it 2-2 in the 79th, before Vitinha and Fabian Ruiz scored late for PSG.

Injuries hit both sides: Dembele went off with a suspected hamstring problem, Dani Olmo came off for Barcelona, and Kvaratskhelia was helped off for PSG. Gordon said Barcelona were outlasted athletically.
background: PSG are the defending Champions League holders, and this was Barcelona's third league-phase match after wins over Feyenoord and Galatasaray.
footage_terms: PSG vs Barcelona 4-2 Champions League highlights
Lamine Yamal goal Parc des Princes October 2026
member_headlines: PSG beat Barcelona 4-2 in a Champions League thriller, ending a 12-match unbeaten run

headline: McTominay's brace gives Napoli a 4-3 win over Bodo/Glimt
facts: Napoli won the Champions League game 4-3: Politano scored in the first minute, McTominay twice, and Bjortuft put one in his own net.
Bodo/Glimt scored through Hauge, Helmersen and Fet, the last deep in added time.
It was Napoli's first Champions League win of the season after losses to Arsenal and Villarreal, and McTominay's first goals since heart surgery in September.
background: Napoli had lost three of their first seven Serie A games, which put pressure on coach Massimiliano Allegri.
member_headlines: McTominay's brace gives Napoli a 4-3 win over Bodo/Glimt

headline: Man City's 85 million pound teenager Bouaddi starts to deliver
facts: Bouaddi, 19, joined City for a reported 85 million pounds and is seen as a possible successor to Rodri.
In his first league start he made 93 touches, third-highest in the match, with seven line-breaking passes.
Enzo Maresca said he is very good and that City should avoid putting pressure on him.
background: Maresca now manages City after Pep Guardiola; Bouaddi is a Morocco international.
member_headlines: Man City's 85 million pound teenager Bouaddi starts to deliver

headline: Real Madrid crush Leipzig 4-1 as Vinicius is whistled by his own fans
facts: Bernardo Silva scored his first Madrid goal, then Guler, Mbappe and Diomande scored in a 4-1 Bernabeu win.
Diomande came on for Vinicius and volleyed in the final goal against his former club.
Some home fans whistled Vinicius when he was substituted; Mourinho said whistles at home hurt a player.
background: Diomande left Leipzig in the summer for a reported fee of up to 140 million euros and had failed to score in his first eight Madrid games.
member_headlines: Real Madrid crush Leipzig 4-1 as Vinicius is whistled by his own fans

headline: Sevilla file a formal complaint after Guler escapes an elbow card in 4-1 defeat at Real Madrid
facts: Real Madrid won 4-1 on 18 October; Guler scored at 30', Mbappe scored twice including a Panenka penalty, and Yan Diomande scored the fourth.
Sevilla say Guler was not sent off for an elbow on Peque Fernandez at 0-0, and coach Luis Garcia Plaza said his team lost the chance to play 11 against 10.
Sevilla complained to LaLiga about unequal replay coverage, and the referees committee met the club, but Sevilla disagreed with its explanation.
Mourinho said nobody had shown him a clear image of the alleged elbow.
background: Sevilla survived relegation only on the penultimate matchday of last season, and Mourinho took over at Real Madrid in the summer.
footage_terms: Garcia Plaza press conference Guler elbow
member_headlines: Sevilla file a formal complaint after Guler escapes an elbow card in 4-1 defeat at Real Madrid

headline: Arsenal fight back to draw 2-2 at Bayern in the Champions League
facts: Eze (25') and Rice (82') scored for Arsenal; Davies (35') and a Kane penalty (61') scored for Bayern.
Eze's goal was first ruled offside, then VAR found him onside; Kane's penalty followed a handball by Jurrien Timber.
Bayern were without the suspended Michael Olise; Neuer made a late save to keep the point.
background: Kane scored his 16th goal in 22 appearances against Arsenal in this match, a record carried over from his Tottenham years.
member_headlines: Arsenal fight back to draw 2-2 at Bayern in the Champions League

headline: Barcelona complain to UEFA about chainsaw-themed PSG tifo after 4-2 loss in Paris
facts: Barcelona complained to UEFA about a chainsaw-themed tifo displayed at the Champions League match in Paris, calling it deeply disturbing.
UEFA said it was waiting for the match report before deciding on any action.
PSG won the match 4-2 on 20 October and topped the 36-team league table after three wins from three.
background: PSG are chasing a third straight Champions League title; the Sky article is mainly about Kvaratskhelia's ACL injury sustained in this match.
footage_terms: Parc des Princes tifo Barcelona UEFA
member_headlines: Barcelona complain to UEFA about chainsaw-themed PSG tifo after 4-2 loss in Paris

facts: The second leg at the Maracana ended 0-0 and Estudiantes won the shootout 3-2, after a goalless first leg in La Plata on 15 October.

facts: Andy Woodman left League One Bromley by mutual consent, ending a spell that began in 2021.

facts: Kompany collapsed at the training ground on Friday 23 October during a second-team session; Max Eberl said the cause was meningeal irritation.
