American defender Joe Scally equalised with a backheel before half-time and set up Wael Mohya's winning header; it was his fourth goal of the season.
Their goal difference had been a club-record minus 20 before the game and they remain at the bottom of the table.

facts: The LFP moved PSG-Lyon from Sunday 8:45 pm to Monday after a Paris police prefecture order banned staging the match on Sunday.

The sanction followed flares thrown toward rival fans and the pitch in a 3-0 home loss to Club Brugge that was briefly stopped.

headline: IFAB panels reject five-second countdown for corners and free kicks, back single coin toss for shootouts, announce full VAR review
facts: The football and technical advisory panels did not back extending the five-second countdown to corner kicks and free kicks, citing tactical complexity.

They supported a single coin toss for penalty shootouts, where the winning captain picks the goal or shooting first or second, and heard that the goalkeeper injury-delay trial has shown very positive initial results.
IFAB announced a comprehensive VAR review using stakeholder feedback and independent data; input feeds the Annual Business Meeting in Zurich on 14 January 2027.
background: IFAB, the body that writes the Laws of the Game, has been pushing a faster tempo after the time-wasting measures introduced for 2026/27.

facts: Arsenal, Chelsea, Manchester City and Bayern Munich are monitoring the 21-year-old France international.

Luis Enrique has earlier questioned why Doue is not seen as a Ballon d'Or contender.
background: Doue scored in PSG's wins over Strasbourg and Villarreal this autumn and is one of the club's young forwards covering for injured stars.
member_headlines: PSG progress in contract talks with Desire Doue as Arsenal, Chelsea and City watch

headline: UEFA moves Rennes v Olympiacos a day earlier because of French general strike; match ends 0-0
facts: UEFA moved Rennes-Olympiacos from Thursday 5 November to the Wednesday before, with a 4:30 p.m. local kick-off, after French authorities said routine security could not be assured during a planned national strike.
The strike was called by French unions amid protests over cost of living; Ligue 1 also moved games that weekend.
ESPN's match page shows the game, played 4 November at Roazhon Park, finished 0-0 (Olympiacos 58% possession, Rennes 4 shots on target to 3).
background: Olympiacos are 3-1-0 with 10 points in the league phase while Rennes are unbeaten with 1 win and 3 draws.
member_headlines: UEFA moves Rennes v Olympiacos a day earlier because of French general strike; match ends 0-0

headline: Wrexham fined 75,000 pounds by EFL for fielding two unregistered players
facts: The EFL fined Wrexham 75,000 pounds, of which 25,000 is suspended, for selecting two ineligible players this season.
Issa Kabore played in the 2-1 home loss to Birmingham on 28 August without his registration documents properly submitted.
Callum O'Hare was in the matchday squad as an unused substitute against Millwall on 2 September, but was not registered in time.
Wrexham reached an agreed decision with the EFL and said it is taking steps to prevent a repeat.
background: Wrexham are co-owned by Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney and are playing in the Championship.
member_headlines: Wrexham fined 75,000 pounds by EFL for fielding two unregistered players

headline: Bayern and Ajax to open new Nairobi stadium on 5 January
facts: Bayern and Ajax will play a friendly in Nairobi on 5 January to open the new Raila Odinga International Stadium.
The clubs last met in December 2018, a 3-3 Champions League draw with four goals in the last 10 minutes.
Bayern's only previous games in Africa were at the 2013 Club World Cup in Morocco, which they won.
background: The stadium is a venue for AFCON 2027, the first AFCON in East Africa since 1976.
footage_terms: Bayern Munich Club World Cup 2013 final Raja
member_headlines: Bayern and Ajax to open new Nairobi stadium on 5 January

headline: Mbappe's Mao-meme joke angers China; CCTV pulls Real Madrid games
facts: On the French show The Bridge, Mbappe said his favourite meme of himself showed him as a Chinese dictator with his face on Mao.
Mbappe apologised, calling the comment ill-judged, and Chinese sponsors Dongpeng, Mengniu and Milkground ended partnerships with him.
China Media Group suspended Real Madrid broadcasts on CCTV-5 until the club formally apologises, and Real Madrid issued an apology.
background: China reportedly accounts for 10 to 15 percent of Real Madrid's international merchandise sales.
member_headlines: Mbappe's Mao-meme joke angers China; CCTV pulls Real Madrid games

headline: Teenager Dowman sent off vs Fleetwood; lip-reader claims Arteta's reaction
facts: Max Dowman, 16, was sent off in the 85th minute after reacting to a heavy challenge from Harrison Neal.
Arsenal drew 1-1 with 26 shots and 78% possession, then lost 5-3 on penalties to Fleetwood.
A lip-reader said Arteta told Dowman to go straight to the changing room; Arsenal fans criticised Arteta on social media.
background: Fleetwood are a lower-league side, and Arsenal were Carabao Cup round-of-16 favourites.
member_headlines: Teenager Dowman sent off vs Fleetwood; lip-reader claims Arteta's reaction

headline: Everton knock Newcastle out of the Carabao Cup 3-1, then win again in the league four days later
facts: Everton won 3-1 in the Carabao Cup fourth round with goals from James Garner, Hayden Hackney and Thierno Barry, and face Fleetwood in the quarter-final.
The tie came after Newcastle had lost to Coventry and Aston Villa in the league, putting Jaissle under pressure.
Everton also beat Newcastle 1-0 in the league four days later with a Barry goal at St James' Park.
background: Everton have not won a trophy since the 1995 FA Cup.
footage_terms: Moyes Everton Carabao Cup quarter final
member_headlines: Everton knock Newcastle out of the Carabao Cup 3-1, then win again in the league four days later

headline: Mbappe reaches 100 Real Madrid goals in 116 games
facts: Mbappe hit 100 Madrid goals with his Clasico double.
It took him 116 matches, making him the fifth-fastest Madrid player to the mark.
ESPN's own figures show Ronaldo needed 106 games, despite the headline claim.
background: Ronaldo is Madrid's all-time top scorer with 451 goals in 438 matches.
footage_terms: Mbappe vs Ronaldo goals Real Madrid
member_headlines: Mbappe reaches 100 Real Madrid goals in 116 games

headline: Kane's Munich homecoming: guard of honour, a golden schnitzel joke and a knighthood question
facts: Kane did not play in the 6-1 cup win over Magdeburg but received a guard of honour and fan chants at the Allianz Arena.
He said his children played with the Ballon d'Or trophy and that being called 'Sir' would feel odd; he said he would not turn down a knighthood.
Former Bayern president Uli Hoeness first called the transfer fee crazy but now says he would have paid 150 million euros for Kane.
background: Hoeness, long Bayern's club president, was among those who doubted the size of Kane's 2023 fee when Bayern signed him from Tottenham.
footage_terms: Kane Ballon d'Or guard of honour Bayern
member_headlines: Kane's Munich homecoming: guard of honour, a golden schnitzel joke and a knighthood question

headline: Bayern's xG luck: unlucky, while Dortmund are lucky and good
facts: Connelly rates Bayern unlucky: they dropped points at Schalke (0-0) and Augsburg (2-2) despite big expected-goals margins.
Kane had four league goals from shots worth 5.2 expected goals at that point.
Dortmund had allowed goals in just two league games, with keeper Gregor Kobel praised but regression expected.
background: Dortmund finished second last season under Niko Kovac and conceded fewer goals than any other side.
member_headlines: Bayern's xG luck: unlucky, while Dortmund are lucky and good

headline: Liverpool contact Monaco's Lamine Camara over his future after the Chelsea deal collapsed
facts: The Sun reports Liverpool have contacted Camara's representatives and asked to be kept updated on his future.
A January move is ruled out after a reported 55 million euro deal with Chelsea collapsed over the summer.
Liverpool and Chelsea are both expected to explore a transfer for the 22-year-old Senegal international next year.
background: Monaco have no Champions League income this season, which Sky Sports says makes player sales and qualifying for the competition important.
member_headlines: Liverpool contact Monaco's Lamine Camara over his future after the Chelsea deal collapsed

headline: PSG see Leverkusen's Ibrahim Maza as a possible Kvaratskhelia replacement, Leverkusen plan to resist
facts: PSG are reported to see Algeria winger Ibrahim Maza as a possible mid-season replacement for Kvaratskhelia.
Leverkusen reportedly plan to resist the interest.
ESPN's same roundup says Chelsea and PSG are reportedly competing for Barcelona midfielder Fermin Lopez.
background: Kvaratskhelia's ACL injury ends his season; Luis Enrique said on 25 October that PSG must sign a new player, although ESPN reported two days later that he had indicated no replacement would come.
member_headlines: PSG see Leverkusen's Ibrahim Maza as a possible Kvaratskhelia replacement, Leverkusen plan to resist

headline: Kovac says Dortmund must stop Kane together before Bayern clash
facts: Kovac called Kane sensational and said he cannot be stopped one on one.
Dortmund and Bayern were level on points at the top of the Bundesliga.
Dortmund had not beaten Bayern in their last five meetings, and Kompany was absent after his hospital stay.
background: Kane, the Ballon d'Or winner, was to be honoured by Bayern before the match.
footage_terms: Harry Kane Ballon d'Or Bayern honour
member_headlines: Kovac says Dortmund must stop Kane together before Bayern clash

headline: Moyes keeps Everton's cup run going and backs Grealish discipline decision
facts: Everton beat Newcastle 3-1 in the Carabao Cup with goals from Garner, Hackney and Barry.
Grealish missed the game over a club discipline breach and Moyes said he supports the decision.
Everton now face League Two Fleetwood in the quarterfinal; they have not won a trophy since the 1995 FA Cup.
background: Arsenal, Chelsea, Manchester United and Aston Villa were already out of the competition.
member_headlines: Moyes keeps Everton's cup run going and backs Grealish discipline decision

headline: Sheffield United beat Wrexham for the first time in 44 years
facts: Ben Brereton Diaz scored the only goal at Bramall Lane in the 30th minute, his third goal in three games against Wrexham.
It was Sheffield United's first league win over Wrexham since October 1982.
Wrexham had just one shot on target, in the 96th minute, are winless in five away games and have no Championship clean sheet since 5 September.
background: Sheffield United are managed by Chris Wilder and moved up to 10th, a point off the play-offs, while Wrexham stayed 17th.
footage_terms: Ben Brereton Diaz goal Sheffield United Wrexham
member_headlines: Sheffield United beat Wrexham for the first time in 44 years

headline: Kane edges Mbappe for the 2026 Ballon d'Or by 28 points
facts: Kane won with 1,055 points to Mbappe's 1,027; Kane had 40 first-place votes to Mbappe's 23.
Bellingham finished 11th, Vinicius 17th and Marc Cucurella 18th.
L'Equipe ranked it the fourth-closest vote in the award's 70-year history.
background: Mbappe led LaLiga with 25 goals and won the World Cup Golden Boot with 10 goals, but won no trophies with Madrid or France last season.
member_headlines: Kane edges Mbappe for the 2026 Ballon d'Or by 28 points

headline: Police identify Barcelona fan who hit Camavinga with a flag at the Clasico
facts: Police identified the Barcelona supporter who struck Camavinga with a flag in the 87th minute while Madrid celebrated.
LaLiga reported it to the federation's disciplinary and anti-violence bodies; a fine up to 60,000 euros and a 6-24 month stadium ban are possible.
Barcelona suspended the Gol 1957 section's activity for the Alaves league match.
background: Camavinga played a key role in the winning goal, bursting forward from deep to set up Mbappe.
footage_terms: Barcelona Real Madrid Clasico fan incident
member_headlines: Police identify Barcelona fan who hit Camavinga with a flag at the Clasico

headline: CAF reverses four-year AFCON plan and restores two-year cycle
facts: CAF's executive committee unanimously reversed its December 2025 decision to play AFCON every four years after 2028.
CAF said the planned Africa Nations League would take years to generate the needed revenue.
Next tournaments are 2027, 2028, 2031 and 2033, leaving a three-year gap after 2028.
background: CAF announced the four-year plan in December 2025 alongside a proposed $1 billion commercial tender; many players and coaches opposed it.
member_headlines: CAF reverses four-year AFCON plan and restores two-year cycle

headline: Clubs and U.S. Soccer clash over control of USWNT players in the NWSL
facts: The tension came to a head over the U20 World Cup, which fell outside a FIFA window so clubs did not have to release players.
Several age-eligible players, including Claire Hutton, Lily Yohannes and Kimmi Ascanio, were left off the U20 squad.
The NWSL will start its 2027 season on February 11, a month earlier than before, to allow a six-week World Cup break.
Anonymous GMs complained that the federation expects clubs to accommodate it at any cost; one GM praised Emma Hayes as supportive.
USWNT coach Emma Hayes said the team needs its best players available for long-term development.
background: U.S. Soccer helped found the NWSL in 2013 and paid USWNT players' salaries until the league became independent after the 2020 season.
footage_terms: NWSL U.S. Soccer player release dispute
member_headlines: Clubs and U.S. Soccer clash over control of USWNT players in the NWSL

headline: FIFA plans to at least double 2027 Women's World Cup prize money, still short of equal pay
facts: FIFA's administration will propose at least doubling prize money for the 2027 tournament in Brazil.
The plan goes to the FIFA Council in December for approval.
Even doubled, it would stay below the men's tournament total.
The 2023 tournament had a record $150 million package, including $110 million in prize money.
Each association will get $2.5 million in preparation funds.
background: Infantino said in 2023 that the aim was equal prize money for the 2026 men's and 2027 women's tournaments.
footage_terms: Women's World Cup prize money equal pay
Infantino Women's World Cup prize money
member_headlines: FIFA plans to at least double 2027 Women's World Cup prize money, still short of equal pay

headline: Milan owner Cardinale backs Amorim with a 'Top Gun' vow: 'I'm not leaving my wingman'
facts: Speaking to Gazzetta dello Sport, Cardinale cited the Top Gun line about not leaving a wingman and said Amorim faces no threat of dismissal.
He said Amorim learned from his time at Manchester United and that the atmosphere at Milanello has improved.
Milan were fifth, seven points behind the leaders, and faced Inter in the derby that weekend.
background: RedBird's Cardinale bought Milan in 2022 and the club has changed coaches frequently in recent years, which he now says he will not repeat.
footage_terms: Amorim Milan press conference Inter derby
member_headlines: Milan owner Cardinale backs Amorim with a 'Top Gun' vow: 'I'm not leaving my wingman'

headline: Pulisic calls new Milan contract 'the most important chapter' of his career
facts: Pulisic, 28, re-signed with Milan through 2031 and said he is in love with the club and that his family is happy there.
His previous deal ran to June 2027, and the new one extends beyond the next World Cup.
The renewal came a day after Milan announced a new stadium due to open in 2031.
background: Pulisic joined Milan from Chelsea in 2023 for a reported 22m euros and has 44 goals and 28 assists in 141 appearances for the club.
member_headlines: Pulisic calls new Milan contract 'the most important chapter' of his career

headline: Spurs beat Palace 2-0 as Mateta is sent off; third straight league win, first in about 20 months
facts: Archie Gray headed in a corner in the 25th minute and Jan Paul van Hecke added a second in the 73rd.
Mateta was sent off for a late lunge on Micky van de Ven after VAR upgraded a yellow card.
Spurs had 34 shots to Palace's 2 and moved up to eighth place.
background: Palace sit in the relegation zone and have now turned to Thomas Frank, who was sacked by Spurs in February.
footage_terms: Mateta red card Van de Ven
member_headlines: Spurs beat Palace 2-0 as Mateta is sent off; third straight league win, first in about 20 months

headline: Villa keeper Suzuki fumbles a corner into his own net as Fulham draw 1-1
facts: Nicolas Jackson scored in the 39th minute; Zion Suzuki then tried to parry an Alex Iwobi corner and the ball crossed the line in the 64th minute.
John McGinn hit the crossbar with a first-half penalty.
Fulham had higher expected goals (2.21 to 1.71) and Villa stayed ninth.
background: Sky's Ref Watch later asked whether Lammens fouled Suzuki before United's late equaliser at Old Trafford on 8 November.
member_headlines: Villa keeper Suzuki fumbles a corner into his own net as Fulham draw 1-1

headline: Man City 0-1 Brighton: Ayari goal stuns the Etihad and cuts the gap to the top
facts: Brighton won 1-0 at the Etihad on 31 October 2026 through an early goal by Yasin Ayari.
The win left Brighton within two points of Manchester City at the top of the league.
It was City's second straight league defeat after seven unbeaten games; goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen kept them out.
background: Brighton's rise this season has led ESPN to ask whether they are among the Premier League's most complete teams.
member_headlines: Man City 0-1 Brighton: Ayari goal stuns the Etihad and cuts the gap to the top

headline: Brentford 2-0 Nottingham Forest ends winless run and adds pressure on Glasner
facts: Brentford won 2-0 on 31 October 2026: Nikola Milenkovic scored an own goal in the 30th minute and Igor Thiago added a second in the 76th.
It ended a four-match winless run and was Brentford's 100th Premier League match at the Gtech.
Forest had 12 shots but only two on target and have scored just six league goals this season.
background: Oliver Glasner previously managed Crystal Palace before his move to Forest.
member_headlines: Brentford 2-0 Nottingham Forest ends winless run and adds pressure on Glasner

headline: Glasner warns Forest: change or a sixth manager will come in
facts: Forest lost 2-0 at Brentford, with a Milenkovic own goal and a late Igor Thiago strike, leaving them second from bottom.
Glasner said he made too many compromises early on, that Forest have lost four of their last five, and that a sixth manager would come in if things do not change.
He is Forest's fifth head coach in less than a year.
background: Glasner is a former Crystal Palace manager who won the FA Cup and the Conference League there before taking over at Forest at the start of this season.
footage_terms: Oliver Glasner press conference Forest sixth manager
member_headlines: Glasner warns Forest: change or a sixth manager will come in

headline: Coventry beat Sunderland 3-1 to climb out of the relegation zone
facts: Sakamoto (17'), Awoniyi (37') and Rudoni (52') scored for Coventry; Le Fee replied for Sunderland from the spot.
Coventry moved to 17th on nine points while Sunderland stayed 19th on eight.
Sunderland had taken one league point since their Europa League campaign began in mid-September.
background: Coventry are one of three newly promoted clubs this season, with Ipswich and Hull, and are managed by Frank Lampard.
member_headlines: Coventry beat Sunderland 3-1 to climb out of the relegation zone

headline: Fabio Celestini's first Burnley game ends 0-0 as Clarets still lack a home win in over a year
facts: Fabio Celestini took a point from his first game in charge, a goalless draw with Portsmouth at Turf Moor on his 51st birthday.
Celestini called it 'a good first step'; Burnley created chances before the break but lost control after half-time.
Burnley have not won a home league game in over a year and remain in the relegation places.
background: Celestini is Swiss, and replaced the sacked Nicky Hayen a week earlier; Josh Cullen made his first appearance of an injury-hit season off the bench.
member_headlines: Fabio Celestini's first Burnley game ends 0-0 as Clarets still lack a home win in over a year

headline: Barcelona hit Alaves for six at Camp Nou
facts: Barcelona beat Alaves 6-1 at Spotify Camp Nou on 31 October 2026, six days after the Clasico defeat.
Per the season page, Raphinha scored twice, Yamal scored twice, and Fermin Lopez and Anthony Gordon each added one. Alaves scored once, in the 84th minute.
The win put Barcelona back on track after the Clasico loss. Raphinha topped the league scoring list with 15 league goals by 8 November.
background: Barcelona had lost only once in La Liga this season before this match, and the Clasico loss was their first league defeat after nine straight wins.
member_headlines: Barcelona hit Alaves for six at Camp Nou

headline: Real Sociedad defender Jon Martin says he is staying despite Real Madrid and Barcelona interest
facts: Martin said Real Sociedad is his home, where he has been since he was 12, and that he is focused on the Basque derby rather than his future.
He has been linked with Real Madrid, Barcelona and big Premier League clubs, but no move is imminent.
He signed a long-term deal in July that ties him to the club until 2032.
He praised coach Pellegrino Matarazzo as close to the players and trustworthy.
background: Martin helped Real Sociedad win the Copa del Rey under Matarazzo in April and made his Spain debut in June against Iraq.
footage_terms: Real Sociedad Copa del Rey final winners
member_headlines: Real Sociedad defender Jon Martin says he is staying despite Real Madrid and Barcelona interest

headline: VAR review sends Lisandro Martinez off as Chelsea beat Man United 2-0
facts: Chelsea beat Manchester United 2-0 on 31 October; referee Peter Bankes initially gave no penalty or card for Martinez's aerial challenge on Wesley Fofana.
After a VAR review by James Bell, Bankes awarded Chelsea a penalty and sent Martinez off for a second yellow, in the 61st minute.
ESPN's Andy Davies judged the VAR intervention correct, saying Martinez led with his arm and caught Fofana's head.
background: Martinez, who won the 2022 World Cup with Argentina, has a reputation for aggressive aerial and defensive challenges.
footage_terms: Lisandro Martinez red card Chelsea Man United
member_headlines: VAR review sends Lisandro Martinez off as Chelsea beat Man United 2-0

headline: Arsenal win at Anfield for the first time since 2012, Havertz scores the only goal
facts: Arsenal beat Liverpool 1-0 at Anfield on 1 November; Havertz scored in the 16th minute from a Rice cross.
ESPN's match page calls it Arsenal's first Anfield win since 2012 and their 300th Premier League away win, which put them three points clear.
Liverpool did not register a shot on target, and the page notes an Alisson error in the first half.
background: Arsenal were the Premier League champions in 2025/26 with 85 points, per ESPN's season preview; Liverpool had won the title a year earlier before finishing fifth.

Arsenal Anfield first win since 2012 reaction
Arteta post match press conference Liverpool

headline: Bellingham scores 50th Real Madrid goal and passes Zidane
facts: Bellingham chipped the Racing Santander goalkeeper for his 50th Real Madrid goal.
Sky reports the goal moved him past Zinedine Zidane's tally for the club.
Madrid won the league game 3-0.
background: Bellingham is 23 and joined from Borussia Dortmund; Zidane, now France coach, won three Champions Leagues as Madrid manager.
member_headlines: Bellingham scores 50th Real Madrid goal and passes Zidane

headline: Athletic Club win the Basque derby 2-1 over Real Sociedad despite having only 38 percent possession
facts: Inaki Williams scored at 14', Luka Sucic equalised at 30', and Alex Berenguer scored a penalty at 45+2'.
Real Sociedad had 62 percent of the ball, but the expected goals were 2.93 for Athletic and 1.40 for Real Sociedad.
Orri Oskarsson had a late header at 88' that was blocked.
Before the match Real Sociedad had 19 points and Athletic had 15.
background: The derby came after Real Sociedad beat Athletic in the Copa del Rey semi-final earlier in 2026 on their way to the trophy.
member_headlines: Athletic Club win the Basque derby 2-1 over Real Sociedad despite having only 38 percent possession

headline: VAR error in Liverpool v Arsenal? No penalty for Timber pulling Isak's shirt
facts: In the 34th minute of Liverpool v Arsenal, Alexander Isak appeared to have his shirt pulled by Jurrien Timber as he went to head a cross.
Referee Andy Madley played on and VAR Stuart Attwell cleared the no-penalty decision.

ESPN's Andy Davies called the non-intervention an error by VAR, arguing Timber made no attempt to play the ball. The article gives no date; 1 November is inferred from a report that Arsenal were due at Liverpool that Sunday.
background: Isak joined Liverpool from Newcastle in 2025 in a record British transfer.
footage_terms: Isak Timber shirt pull Liverpool Arsenal
Liverpool Arsenal VAR penalty claim Isak
member_headlines: VAR error in Liverpool v Arsenal? No penalty for Timber pulling Isak's shirt

headline: Bosnian teen Kerim Alajbegovic scores first Serie A goal as Juventus beat Napoli
facts: Juventus beat 10-man Napoli 2-0 at the Allianz Stadium on 1 November 2026.
The Bosnian teenager scored the opener in the 70th minute with a 20-yard shot into the top corner, his first Serie A goal.
Jeremie Boga added the second.
background: Alajbegovic is a Bosnian teenager in Juventus's squad; ESPN does not give his exact age.
member_headlines: Bosnian teen Kerim Alajbegovic scores first Serie A goal as Juventus beat Napoli

headline: Drew Spence becomes the WSL's all-time appearance record holder in Tottenham's 4-1 win at Birmingham
facts: Spence made her 217th WSL appearance, passing former Chelsea defender Millie Bright.
Tottenham won 4-1, ending a three-match losing run in the league.
Julie Blakstad, Olivia Holdt, Signe Gaupset and Victoria Pelova scored for Spurs.
background: Spence is 34, captains Tottenham, and spent 14 years at Chelsea before joining Spurs in 2022.
member_headlines: Drew Spence becomes the WSL's all-time appearance record holder in Tottenham's 4-1 win at Birmingham

headline: Arsenal draw 1-1 with Aston Villa as pressure grows on Renee Slegers
facts: Chasity Grant scored for Villa in the 25th minute from their only shot, deflecting off Steph Catley.
Alessia Russo equalised with an 85th-minute header from a Stina Blackstenius cross.
Georgia Stanway missed a stoppage-time chance to win it.
Arsenal have won only one of their last five league games and sat seventh, 12 points behind Chelsea.
background: Renee Slegers is Arsenal's manager, and her side earlier made a run to a Champions League final against Barcelona.
footage_terms: Arsenal vs Aston Villa Women highlights
member_headlines: Arsenal draw 1-1 with Aston Villa as pressure grows on Renee Slegers

headline: Adventurer Karl Bushby ends a 28-year walk from Chile in Hull wearing the club shirt
facts: Bushby, a 57-year-old former paratrooper, reached Hull on the Monday before the story ran, after swimming the Channel on 5 October to start the final leg.
Hull City backed him and urged fans to welcome him at City Hall; the club posted his video in a Hull shirt after the 2-2 draw with Ipswich.
He said he hopes to see a match at the MKM Stadium in person.
background: Bushby set out from Chile in 1998 and walked about 31,000 miles across four continents, including the frozen Bering Strait, under rules of no transport and no return to Britain until the journey was done.
footage_terms: Karl Bushby Goliath Expedition walk finish
member_headlines: Adventurer Karl Bushby ends a 28-year walk from Chile in Hull wearing the club shirt

headline: Udinese change coach again and sit bottom of Serie A
facts: Udinese made a managerial change on 2 November and appointed Paolo Zanetti.
As of 8 November they were bottom with 5 points, with Venezia 19th on 6 and Monza 18th on 7.
Earlier this season Udinese lost 5-3 at Inter and 5-2 to Roma in high-scoring games.
background: Wikipedia's season page lists many early coaching changes in Serie A this season, including Napoli, Milan, Lazio, Bologna, Fiorentina and Atalanta.
member_headlines: Udinese change coach again and sit bottom of Serie A

headline: Twente beat Excelsior 9-0 as Orjasaeter makes five assists
facts: Twente won 9-0 away at Excelsior, the biggest win on the continent that weekend.
Wout Weghorst scored four goals.
Sondre Orjasaeter became the first player this century to register five assists in an Eredivisie game.
background: Wout Weghorst is a veteran Dutch striker who has played in the Premier League and Bundesliga before returning to the Eredivisie.
member_headlines: Twente beat Excelsior 9-0 as Orjasaeter makes five assists

headline: Real Madrid's Yan Diomande hits a stunning half-volley in 3-0 win at Racing
facts: Sky Sports says Diomande scored a sensational half-volley in Real Madrid's 3-0 LaLiga win at Racing Santander's El Sardinero.
The strike silenced the home crowd and left team-mates stunned.
ESPN lists him in a debate with Vinicius Junior over a start against Celta Vigo.
background: Diomande is a Real Madrid forward whose age Sky does not state; he now competes with Vinicius Junior for a spot.
footage_terms: Yan Diomande half volley Real Madrid
member_headlines: Real Madrid's Yan Diomande hits a stunning half-volley in 3-0 win at Racing

headline: Yamal's father says 'Lamine Yamal' is not his real full name
facts: On a live broadcast, Mounir Nasraoui said Lamine Yamal is his son's first name, not a first name plus surname.
He gave the surname as Nasraoui Ebana.
He asked everyone to understand that.
background: Yamal is Barcelona's teenage winger, who finished third in the 2026 Ballon d'Or voting.
member_headlines: Yamal's father says 'Lamine Yamal' is not his real full name

headline: Strasbourg's Godo goes viral for odd pre-match eye routine, then scores
facts: Before kick-off Godo moved his fingers before his face, shifted his gaze and closed one eye repeatedly.
Strasbourg beat Auxerre 5-1, and it was Godo's first goal of the season.
He said the routine puts him in the conditions of reality.
background: Godo plays for Strasbourg in Ligue 1.
member_headlines: Strasbourg's Godo goes viral for odd pre-match eye routine, then scores

headline: Hincapie answers Van Dijk's sarcasm with 'I don't forget' Instagram post
facts: Arsenal won 1-0 at Anfield through a first-half Kai Havertz goal, their first win there since 2014.
Van Dijk said a penalty was clear on Isak after a Timber shirt pull, and sarcastically congratulated Arsenal.
Hincapie posted images captioned 'I don't forget', including a zoomed-in Premier League sleeve badge.
background: Van Dijk posted a similar sleeve-badge image after Liverpool's 0-0 draw at the Emirates in January.
member_headlines: Hincapie answers Van Dijk's sarcasm with 'I don't forget' Instagram post

headline: 14-year-old arrested after a Coventry fan taunts Sunderland supporters with a photo of Bradley Lowery
facts: A fan was filmed holding up a photo of Bradley Lowery to taunt Sunderland supporters at the game in Coventry.
A 14-year-old boy handed himself in, was arrested on suspicion of a public order offence and was bailed with conditions.
Coventry said they do not tolerate offensive behaviour; Bradley's mother condemned it as cruel and asked people not to send hate to the boy's family.
background: Bradley Lowery was a young Sunderland fan who became loved across football during his fight with neuroblastoma and died in 2017 aged six.
footage_terms: Bradley Lowery Foundation Stadium of Light
member_headlines: 14-year-old arrested after a Coventry fan taunts Sunderland supporters with a photo of Bradley Lowery

headline: Camavinga credits Mourinho for confidence boost after Harvard summer course
facts: Camavinga said Mourinho helped him mature and boosted his confidence.
He spent part of the summer on a short business course at Harvard Business School.
He says he now arrives two to three hours early for gym work.
