member_headlines: Mourinho warns Vinicius he is not guaranteed a start when ban ends

headline: Mbappe set to attend NFL game in Madrid, Bengals' Higgins says he is a fan
facts: Bengals receiver Tee Higgins said he is impressed by Mbappe's skill.
He said he is glad Mbappe will attend the Bengals-Falcons NFL game in Madrid.
He called the idea 'dope'.
background: Mbappe is Real Madrid's star forward and finished second in the 2026 Ballon d'Or.
member_headlines: Mbappe set to attend NFL game in Madrid, Bengals' Higgins says he is a fan

headline: HSV beat Gladbach 3-1 with two long-range goals as Gladbach lose a man
facts: Miro Muheim scored from about 30 metres in the 11th minute and Albert Gronbaek added a long-range goal in the 70th, with Shafiq Nandja also scoring.
Joe Scally equalised for Gladbach in the 44th minute, but Ko Itakura was sent off with a second yellow in the 49th.
Gladbach stay bottom after another defeat, and HSV climbed into the top half.
background: HSV are back in the Bundesliga after a seven-year absence, and Muheim has three goals this season, all from outside the box.
member_headlines: HSV beat Gladbach 3-1 with two long-range goals as Gladbach lose a man

headline: Gio Reyna scores for Strasbourg then limps off with thigh injury and misses USMNT Nations League games
facts: Reyna scored in the 67th minute, his third of the season, then came off three minutes later with a left-thigh problem as Strasbourg lost 3-1 at Toulouse.
U.S. Soccer later withdrew him from the Concacaf Nations League quarterfinals against Haiti, citing an unspecified injury.
Stoke City's Jack McGlynn was called up in his place.
background: Reyna has had injury setbacks at Dortmund and Gladbach, and Strasbourg were 13th in Ligue 1 on 10 points.
member_headlines: Gio Reyna scores for Strasbourg then limps off with thigh injury and misses USMNT Nations League games

headline: Tuchel leaves Cole Palmer out of England squad, says he misses too many chances to impress
facts: Palmer and Kobbie Mainoo were left out for the Croatia and Spain games after withdrawing from the previous camp.
Tuchel said he rewards commitment in camp, that Palmer misses too many opportunities to impress him, and that the door stays open.
Jobe Bellingham and 19-year-old Josh King were called up.
background: Palmer is a Chelsea forward who has been a regular in England squads under Tuchel since early 2025, and Jobe joins his older brother Jude in the squad.
member_headlines: Tuchel leaves Cole Palmer out of England squad, says he misses too many chances to impress

headline: FIFA chief legal and compliance officer Emilio Garcia Silvero steps down amid Infantino turmoil
facts: FIFA confirmed on 6 November that Garcia Silvero is leaving for a new professional chapter in Madrid after eight years in the role.
COO Kevin Lamour left in August and said the plan to sell a stake in World Cup commercial rights had 'deceived' FIFA's administration.
Arsene Wenger is reportedly not expected to renew his contract as chief of global football development.
Jan Kleiner will temporarily oversee the legal and compliance departments.
background: Garcia Silvero worked with Infantino at UEFA and followed him to FIFA, and also sits on the management board of the Court of Arbitration for Sport.
member_headlines: FIFA chief legal and compliance officer Emilio Garcia Silvero steps down amid Infantino turmoil

headline: Baleba hamstring blow adds to Man United injury woes
facts: Baleba hurt his hamstring in United's 3-2 Champions League win over Roma and went off early in the second half.
Michael Carrick said he will be out for a number of weeks.
The win ended a nine-game winless run and left United just above the relegation zone.
background: Baleba, 22 and a Cameroon international, joined United from Brighton for about 70 million pounds in the summer and had an ankle injury before his debut.
member_headlines: Baleba hamstring blow adds to Man United injury woes

headline: Bayern coach Kompany out since collapsing at a training session
facts: Kompany collapsed at a reserve training session on 23 October and was treated for meningeal irritation.
Assistant Aaron Danks has run the team for five games and says Kompany is well on the way to full recovery.
Bayern have a policy of not involving him in football decisions while he recovers.
background: Harry Kane reportedly became the first Bayern player in 45 years to win the Ballon d'Or and signed a new deal.
member_headlines: Bayern coach Kompany out since collapsing at a training session

headline: Manchester City lose three league games in a row, losing 3-1 at Nottingham Forest
facts: Forest won 3-1 at the City Ground, with Jair Cunha and two goals from Liam Delap; Cherki scored for City.
ESPN's commentary says a Gvardiol error led to the first goal.
It was City's third straight league loss after a 7-0-3 start, and they are six points behind Arsenal.
It was Forest's first home win of the season.
background: Maresca is in his first season in charge, and City had won seven straight in all competitions before the slide, per Sky.
member_headlines: Manchester City lose three league games in a row, losing 3-1 at Nottingham Forest

headline: Leeds 1-0 Spurs: Okafor's late goal ends Leeds' five-game winless run
facts: Substitute Noah Okafor scored in the 79th minute at Elland Road.
Spurs had about 61% possession but lower expected goals (roughly 0.7 against about 2.0 for Leeds).
It was only the second Leeds win in 14 Premier League meetings between the clubs.
background: Spurs host Ipswich on 21 November and sit 11th on 12 points.
member_headlines: Leeds 1-0 Spurs: Okafor's late goal ends Leeds' five-game winless run

headline: Parker stays winless as Blackburn beat West Ham 2-1
facts: Blackburn won 2-1 on 7 November 2026 with goals from Andri Gudjohnsen (54') and Dapo Afolayan (71'); Joel Piroe replied for West Ham late on.
It was West Ham's first away defeat of the season and Parker's first match without a win as boss.
West Ham dominated possession but conceded early in the second half.
background: West Ham are chasing an immediate return to the Premier League after last season's relegation.
member_headlines: Parker stays winless as Blackburn beat West Ham 2-1

headline: Forest stun Man City 3-1 as Delap shines and Schlager wins the ball off the 116 million pound Anderson
facts: Forest beat City 3-1 on 7 November; Schlager won the ball from Elliot Anderson to start the move for Delap's first goal.
It was City's third straight league defeat after a perfect start.
Schlager, a free signing from Leipzig, has made more tackles than any other Premier League player this season.
background: Schlager replaced Anderson, who cost 116 million pounds, in Forest's midfield and had previously worked with Glasner at Wolfsburg.
footage_terms: Liam Delap goal Forest Man City
Oliver Glasner press conference Forest City
member_headlines: Forest stun Man City 3-1 as Delap shines and Schlager wins the ball off the 116 million pound Anderson

headline: Leeds beat Spurs 1-0 as Okafor scores 97 seconds after coming on and Bogle escapes a red
facts: Substitute Noah Okafor scored in the 79th minute, 97 seconds after coming on, ending a run of five Leeds games without a win.
Jayden Bogle caught Mathys Tel on the Achilles in the 34th minute; after a four-minute VAR check no card was shown, and Tel went off injured.
Leeds moved up to eighth and Spurs' three-game winning run ended; De Zerbi was booked and faces a touchline ban.
background: Daniel Farke's Leeds are in the Premier League after winning promotion from the Championship in 2025.
footage_terms: Jayden Bogle tackle Mathys Tel VAR
De Zerbi press conference Leeds Bogle
member_headlines: Leeds beat Spurs 1-0 as Okafor scores 97 seconds after coming on and Bogle escapes a red

headline: Cardiff come from 4-1 down to beat Burnley 5-4 with a 103rd-minute red card
facts: Cardiff won 5-4 after trailing 4-1; Salech scored twice and Alex Robertson grabbed the winner in the 94th minute after scoring an own goal earlier.
Connor Roberts was sent off after a push on Salech that led to Moylan's penalty.
Burnley are in the relegation zone, four points from safety, with one win in their first 14 league games.
background: Fabio Celestini took over at Burnley after Nicky Hayen was sacked and earned a point in his first game, a 0-0 draw with Portsmouth.
member_headlines: Cardiff come from 4-1 down to beat Burnley 5-4 with a 103rd-minute red card

headline: Cardiff win nine-goal thriller 5-4 against Burnley with a stoppage-time winner
facts: Cardiff were 4-1 down after Alex Robertson's own goal on 62 minutes, then scored four times to win 5-4.
Yousef Salech scored twice, Jack Moylan converted a penalty, and Robertson scored the winner in the fourth minute of stoppage time; his team-mates called him Kangaroo.
The win took Cardiff to 18 points, while Burnley, on 10 points, remain in the relegation zone.
background: Burnley were tipped for promotion before the season; Cardiff are managed by Brian Barry-Murphy, and Robertson is a Socceroos midfielder who had an Achilles issue before the game.
member_headlines: Cardiff win nine-goal thriller 5-4 against Burnley with a stoppage-time winner

headline: Bottom club Preston get Graham Alexander's first win by beating Southampton 1-0
facts: Jordan Thompson volleyed in from outside the box on 33 minutes to give Preston a 1-0 win at Deepdale.
It was Graham Alexander's first win as Preston manager, and Preston were bottom of the Championship at the time.
Lee Nicholls made his league debut in goal for Preston; Southampton came in unbeaten in six and Eckert said his side 'wasted one half'.
background: Alexander has struggled since returning to Preston, per Sky analyst Andy Hinchcliffe, after Paul Heckingbottom led the club to 14th last season; Preston lost nine of 11 before this result.
member_headlines: Bottom club Preston get Graham Alexander's first win by beating Southampton 1-0

headline: Notts County win FA Cup tie on penalties in thick fog: 'couldn't see the ball'
facts: Notts County beat Altrincham 3-2 on penalties after a 2-2 draw through 120 minutes of the FA Cup first round.
Dense fog cut visibility; County manager Martin Paterson said he couldn't see the ball or the players.
Altrincham led with six minutes left, Callum Roberts equalised in the 84th minute, and three Altrincham spot-kicks were missed in the shootout.
background: Altrincham boss Neil Gibson said coaching became almost impossible in extra time but called the referee's decision to play on probably the right one.
footage_terms: Notts County Altrincham FA Cup fog
FA Cup first round fog highlights
member_headlines: Notts County win FA Cup tie on penalties in thick fog: 'couldn't see the ball'

headline: Valencia 0-3 Real Madrid: eighth straight win, Guler stars
facts: Valverde (28'), Guler (36') and Mbappe (75') scored at Mestalla.
Madrid had 11 shots on target to Valencia's two and an expected-goals edge of 2.26 to 0.16.
ESPN's recap called it Madrid's eighth straight win.
background: Valencia were 19th with nine points; Madrid's league table position was reported differently on the page, so the title-race gap is unverified.
member_headlines: Valencia 0-3 Real Madrid: eighth straight win, Guler stars

headline: Alvarez says sorry to Atletico fans after the failed Barcelona move that Atletico blocked with a EUR 100m refusal
facts: In June Alvarez told ESPN he wanted to leave Atletico, and sources said he preferred Barcelona.
Atletico refused to sell to a title rival and turned down a EUR 100m offer, so he stayed.
Fans jeered him earlier in the season over the attempt to force a move, and he has since apologised.
He had started Atletico's last four matches and scored twice; Simeone said he was in good form ahead of the Barcelona game.
background: Alvarez joined Atletico from Manchester City in 2024 and won the World Cup with Argentina in 2022.
member_headlines: Alvarez says sorry to Atletico fans after the failed Barcelona move that Atletico blocked with a EUR 100m refusal

headline: Roma beat Sassuolo 3-0 and stay unbeaten; Gasperini says Inter favourites
facts: Roma beat Sassuolo 3-0 on 7 November: Hermoso scored, Sassuolo's Walukiewicz put through his own net, and Rodrigo Mora scored the third.
Sky says Mora was involved in all three goals and Roma remain unbeaten (8 wins, 3 draws).
Gasperini said Inter are best placed to win the title, while adding that every team is in the mix.
background: Gasperini built a famous attacking Atalanta side before taking over at Roma, where he has pushed for a title challenge.
member_headlines: Roma beat Sassuolo 3-0 and stay unbeaten; Gasperini says Inter favourites

headline: Kane sets up both goals in 2-1 win at Mainz but is stuck in a four-game goal drought
facts: Mainz 1-2 Bayern on 7 November: Kimmich (14') and Karl (57') scored from Kane assists; Tietz scored for Mainz in stoppage time.
Sky says Kane has gone four games without a goal, which has happened only once before in his Bayern career, while his eight Bundesliga assists lead the league.
Bundesliga.com reports Manuel Neuer injured his foot at Mainz and remains out.
background: Kane built his name as a pure goalscorer but has reinvented himself as a deep-lying playmaker, a change he credits partly to Jose Mourinho's freedom at Tottenham.
member_headlines: Kane sets up both goals in 2-1 win at Mainz but is stuck in a four-game goal drought

headline: Fuellkrug's scoring run ends as Stuttgart edge Bremen 1-0
facts: Maximilian Mittelstaedt scored in the 7th minute from a Grischa Promel pass to give Stuttgart a 1-0 win.
Fuellkrug's run of seven straight games with a goal ended; Bremen had 21 shots but failed to score.
Stuttgart coach Sebastian Hoeness called it a needed win but admitted it was partly lucky, while Bremen coach Thioune felt his side deserved a point.
background: Bremen had been unbeaten in seven league games before this loss, and Fuellkrug has returned to the Germany squad.
member_headlines: Fuellkrug's scoring run ends as Stuttgart edge Bremen 1-0

headline: Leipzig destroy Augsburg 5-2 after Orban's blunder in his 400th Leipzig game
facts: Anton Kade scored for Augsburg in the first minute after a mistake by Willi Orban in his 400th Leipzig appearance.
Leipzig replied with five goals from Banzuzi, Nkunku, Raum, Romulo and Baumgartner; Brajan Gruda had two assists.
Leipzig reached 18 points; Augsburg have nine and have lost six leads this season and are seven league games without a win.
background: Leipzig are coached by Martin Demichelis and want to qualify for the Champions League every season.
footage_terms: Orban Fehler Kade Tor Leipzig Augsburg
member_headlines: Leipzig destroy Augsburg 5-2 after Orban's blunder in his 400th Leipzig game

headline: A Frankfurt fan falls from the stands before Paderborn 2-2 Frankfurt
facts: Shortly before kick-off a Frankfurt fan fell from the stands in the away block and was taken to hospital in critical condition; a later report said he was responsive again.
Both sets of fans stayed silent for the full 90 minutes and furled their flags and banners.
The game ended 2-2: Burkardt scored twice, the second a heel flick from a corner in the third minute of stoppage time, with Frankfurt down to ten men after Elias Baum's second yellow.
background: Paderborn are 11th with 10 points and Frankfurt eighth with 12 after the draw; Frankfurt are coached by Adi Hutter.
member_headlines: A Frankfurt fan falls from the stands before Paderborn 2-2 Frankfurt

headline: PSG edge Troyes 1-0 for an 11th straight win as Zabarnyi heads the winner
facts: Illia Zabarnyi scored a 39th-minute header from a Senny Mayulu cross at the Parc des Princes.
Mayulu hit the woodwork twice in the opening six minutes and Troyes had a late equaliser ruled out for offside.
The win was PSG's 11th in a row in all competitions and left them top on 23 points, ahead of Lille on 21 and Paris FC on 20.
background: PSG failed to win any of their first three league games this season, so the winning run came after a slow Ligue 1 start.
member_headlines: PSG edge Troyes 1-0 for an 11th straight win as Zabarnyi heads the winner

headline: No red for Bogle after studs-up Achilles challenge on Tel in Leeds' win over Spurs; Tottenham write to Pro Ref
facts: Leeds won 1-0 at Elland Road; Jayden Bogle caught Mathys Tel on the Achilles with his studs, and Tel was replaced after treatment.
Referee John Brooks gave no card, and after a lengthy VAR review no serious foul play was found; Tottenham plan to write to Pro Ref to ask why no red card was shown.
Bogle was then reportedly subjected to racist abuse on social media; Leeds and Tottenham both condemned it and the Premier League warned of bans and prosecution.
background: Leeds and Tottenham met in the Premier League this season, and Tottenham said they would take the VAR decision up with the referees' body.
footage_terms: Bogle Tel challenge VAR Leeds Tottenham
Tottenham Pro Ref letter Bogle red card
member_headlines: No red for Bogle after studs-up Achilles challenge on Tel in Leeds' win over Spurs; Tottenham write to Pro Ref

headline: Messi ends Argentina career with a penalty vs Benin and 41 goals in 2026
facts: ESPN's tracker says Messi scored a penalty in Argentina's 3-0 friendly win over Benin on Oct 6, his 126th Argentina goal in what it calls his final senior international appearance (208th cap).
His brace against Atlanta on Oct 17 took him to 25 MLS goals, the league lead at that point.
As of Nov 7 the page lists 41 goals and 19 assists in 47 games in 2026.
background: Messi captained Argentina to the 2022 World Cup and joined Inter Miami in 2023 after leaving Paris Saint-Germain.
footage_terms: Messi Inter Miami Atlanta United brace
member_headlines: Messi ends Argentina career with a penalty vs Benin and 41 goals in 2026

headline: Nigeria beat Japan 2-1 to become the first African team to win a FIFA Women's world title (U17)
facts: Nigeria won the U17 Women's World Cup final in Rabat 2-1 against Japan.
Oluebube Umejiaku scored four goals in the tournament and won the Golden Ball.
Nigeria lost its opening game to Poland and then beat defending champion North Korea.
Nigeria is only the second country, after France, to win both the men's and women's U17 World Cups.
Their coach, Busari, is local.
background: Nigeria's senior Super Falcons have won a record 10 African titles but failed to reach the 2027 Women's World Cup after losing a playoff to South Africa.
footage_terms: Nigeria vs Japan U17 Women's World Cup final highlights
Nigeria Flamingos celebrate U17 World Cup
member_headlines: Nigeria beat Japan 2-1 to become the first African team to win a FIFA Women's world title (U17)

headline: Bebe, 'United's biggest ever flop', finds a club in Spain's third tier
facts: Bebe joined CD Teruel, bottom of Spain's third division, after months as a free agent.
He left UD Ibiza at the end of last season.
An ESPN fan survey once named him United's biggest ever flop.
background: Ferguson signed Bebe from Vitoria de Guimaraes in August 2010 for a reported 7.4 million pounds, and he made only seven United appearances in four years.
member_headlines: Bebe, 'United's biggest ever flop', finds a club in Spain's third tier

headline: Iraola: Liverpool are 'too honest' as the referee praised their conduct after a loss
facts: Iraola said the referee complimented Liverpool players and staff after the 1-0 loss to Arsenal, and he was unsure how to feel.
He said Liverpool can be too honest about refereeing decisions.
Opta: Liverpool have been awarded only 88 fouls this season while conceding 128, the most in the league.
background: Iraola took over at Liverpool this season, following Arne Slot's sacking.
member_headlines: Iraola: Liverpool are 'too honest' as the referee praised their conduct after a loss

headline: Man Utd 4-4 Aston Villa: twice two goals down, equaliser in the 97th minute
facts: Villa led 2-0 inside four minutes through Alysson and Nicolas Jackson, a club-record concession of two goals in 3 minutes 42 seconds for United.
United came back twice: Bruno Fernandes scored a penalty, Zirkzee pulled one back in stoppage time, and substitute Patrick Dorgu equalised in the 97th minute from a Fernandes corner.

Fans called on the Glazers and Sir Jim Ratcliffe to sell, and United stayed 18th, winless in eight league games. Emery stormed off after the equaliser and sarcastically asked a reporter if there would be 'more questions'.
background: Emery's Villa were sixth in the Champions League table before this match; United's Carrick was sacked about a week later.
footage_terms: Dorgu equaliser Aston Villa Old Trafford
Emery post match interview Manchester United draw
Man Utd Villa 4-4 fans protest Glazers
member_headlines: Man Utd 4-4 Aston Villa: twice two goals down, equaliser in the 97th minute

headline: Liverpool beat Palace 3-1 at Selhurst Park as pressure on Sage grows
facts: Liverpool won 3-1 at Selhurst Park on 8 November 2026.
Alexis Mac Allister, Florian Wirtz and Alexander Isak scored for Liverpool.
Eddie Nketiah pulled one back with a stoppage-time penalty after a foul by Milos Kerkez.
background: Palace were bottom of the table, and Sage had lost seven of his first ten league games in charge.
member_headlines: Liverpool beat Palace 3-1 at Selhurst Park as pressure on Sage grows

headline: Aston Villa twice lead by two at Old Trafford and still draw 4-4; Emery storms off before the end
facts: Villa led 2-0 inside four minutes through Alysson and Nicolas Jackson and 4-2 through McGinn (penalty) and Goretzka before United scored twice in stoppage time through Zirkzee and Dorgu.
Dorgu's header came from a corner that Villa goalkeeper Zion Suzuki flapped at.
Emery left the touchline early after the equaliser and answered a reporter's question with sarcasm; Villa are 10th.
background: Emery has coached Villa since 2022 and took them into the Champions League in 2024.
footage_terms: Unai Emery post-match interview United Villa
member_headlines: Aston Villa twice lead by two at Old Trafford and still draw 4-4; Emery storms off before the end

headline: Bournemouth win eight in a row after a late scare at Ipswich
facts: Evanilson scored in the fifth minute, an Issa Diop and Leif Davis own goal made it 2-0, and Jack Clarke pulled one back from the spot in the 73rd minute.
It was Bournemouth's eighth straight win in all competitions and fourth in the league; Evanilson has scored in five consecutive league games.
Gary O'Neil said giving the ball to Evanilson twice was the key mistake for newly promoted Ipswich.
background: Under Marco Rose, Bournemouth have won all four of their Europa League group matches, and had earlier lost 5-1 to Chelsea this season.
member_headlines: Bournemouth win eight in a row after a late scare at Ipswich

headline: Fermin double gives Barcelona another comeback win at Atletico Madrid
facts: Barcelona won 2-1 at the Metropolitano on 8 November 2026 after Giuliano Simeone scored for Atletico in the 10th minute.
Fermin Lopez equalised in first-half stoppage time and scored the winner in the second half from a Lamine Yamal pass, in his 100th league game for Barcelona.
It was Hansi Flick's 23rd comeback win as Barcelona coach and kept Barcelona top of La Liga, five points clear of Atletico. Marc Bernal started in place of the injured Rodri.
background: Flick has coached Barcelona since 2024, and the club also came back from 2-0 down at the Metropolitano in 2024-25 to win 4-2.
footage_terms: Hansi Flick press conference after Atletico win
member_headlines: Fermin double gives Barcelona another comeback win at Atletico Madrid

headline: Robert Lewandowski has nine goals in 19 games for Chicago Fire since leaving Barcelona
facts: Lewandowski left Barcelona when his contract ended after the 2025-26 season and joined MLS side Chicago Fire in June 2026, wearing number 9.
As of 8 November 2026 he had 9 goals in 19 league appearances for Chicago.
His Wikipedia page says he has more than 170 caps and 92 goals for Poland, with the exact cap figures inconsistent on the page.
background: Lewandowski joined Barcelona from Bayern Munich in 2022 and won La Liga with the club, including the 2025-26 title.
member_headlines: Robert Lewandowski has nine goals in 19 games for Chicago Fire since leaving Barcelona

headline: Ter Stegen is playing for Ajax on loan from Barcelona
facts: Ter Stegen joined Ajax on loan from Barcelona for the 2026-27 season on 4 August 2026 and kept a clean sheet in his debut, a 2-0 win at Zwolle on 9 August.
By 8 November he had 11 Eredivisie and 5 Conference League appearances for Ajax.
Per Wikipedia, Germany's new head coach Jurgen Klopp started him in a 1-1 draw away to the Netherlands on 24 September.
background: Ter Stegen was Barcelona's number one for more than a decade and also spent a loan period at Girona in 2025-26, where he suffered a hamstring injury in January 2026.
member_headlines: Ter Stegen is playing for Ajax on loan from Barcelona

headline: Atletico Madrid lose 1-2 to Barcelona as Fermin Lopez scores twice and Alvarez misses chances
facts: Giuliano Simeone put Atletico ahead in the 10th minute after a Julian Alvarez cross; Fermin Lopez equalised at 45' and scored the winner at 66'.
Alvarez missed several chances, including a one-on-one against Joan Garcia and an early lob over the keeper that frustrated some home fans.
The home crowd showed a tifo that referred to Alvarez's reluctant stay at the club after his summer transfer attempt.
The loss ended Atletico's seven-game league winning run and left them third, five points behind Barcelona.
background: Diego Simeone has coached Atletico since 2011, and last season Atletico knocked Barcelona out of both the Copa del Rey and the Champions League.
member_headlines: Atletico Madrid lose 1-2 to Barcelona as Fermin Lopez scores twice and Alvarez misses chances

headline: Juventus draw 2-2 at Fiorentina after coming from behind twice
facts: Juventus drew 2-2 at Fiorentina on 8 November after trailing twice; Woltemade and Bremer scored for Juve.
Sky says Juventus stayed six points behind the top four after the draw.
Football Italia lists Juve seventh with 18 points, 11 behind leaders Lazio.
background: Juventus last won the Scudetto in 2020 and Luciano Spalletti is the coach trying to bring them back to the top.
member_headlines: Juventus draw 2-2 at Fiorentina after coming from behind twice

headline: Hertha Berlin start the 2. Bundesliga season with a record unbeaten run
facts: Hertha beat Wolfsburg 2-1 at home on matchday 11 and have 31 points from 11 games, with 10 wins and one draw.
More than 70,000 fans came to the Olympiastadion; the only dropped points so far were a 0-0 draw at bottom club Holstein Kiel.
They have scored 25 goals and conceded 9, and the lead over second place is seven points; last season they needed 20 games to reach 31 points.
background: Hertha were relegated from the Bundesliga in 2023, and their last promotion to the top flight was 14 years ago, so a seventh promotion in club history is now within reach.
member_headlines: Hertha Berlin start the 2. Bundesliga season with a record unbeaten run

headline: Greuther Fuerth members vote to drop the Greuther and go back to SpVgg Fuerth
facts: Members voted on 8 November 2026 to return to the name SpVgg Furth, with 1,867 votes in favour, 88.3 percent of those present.
The club needed 75 percent; the new name takes effect from the 2027/28 season.
A long-running fan initiative pushed for the change; some supporters see a special moment, others feel they lose a name that mattered to them.
background: The current name dates from a 1996 merger with TSV Vestenbergsgreuth.
footage_terms: Greuther Furth Namensaenderung SpVgg Furth Mitgliederversammlung
member_headlines: Greuther Fuerth members vote to drop the Greuther and go back to SpVgg Fuerth

headline: Freiburg beat Union 2-0 as Union flirt with the relegation zone
facts: Rani Khedira scored an own goal for Union in the 55th minute and Yuito Suzuki added a second for Freiburg in the 68th.
Union goalkeeper Frederik Ronnow saved a late Vincenzo Grifo penalty and was the team's best player in a very weak performance.
Union coach Mauro Lustrinelli said courage was punished; the table puts Union 16th with seven points.
background: Union have already faced Leverkusen, Bayern and Dortmund this season; Freiburg moved up to third with this win.
member_headlines: Freiburg beat Union 2-0 as Union flirt with the relegation zone

headline: Leverkusen beat Cologne 1-2 in a derby that ended in a brawl
facts: Aleix Garcia opened with a free kick from about 23 metres in the 7th minute; Patrik Schick sealed it in the 85th after an earlier goal was ruled out for handball.
Said El Mala pulled one back in the 90+2 minute from a cross by his brother Malek, and there was a brawl between the teams after the break.
Cologne stay on nine points and slide towards the relegation zone, while Leverkusen moved to 16 points after a run of defeats.
background: Cologne coach Rene Wagner is under fan pressure; Leverkusen coach Carles Martinez was credited with a controlled win, and defenders Quansah and Tapsoba largely shut down El Mala.
footage_terms: Aleix Garcia Freistoss Tor Koeln Leverkusen
member_headlines: Leverkusen beat Cologne 1-2 in a derby that ended in a brawl

headline: Karius hands Hoffenheim a goal as Schalke lose 2-1 at the bottom of the table
facts: Fisnik Asllani scored in the 10th minute after Schalke goalkeeper Loris Karius's pass hit him and deflected into the net; Tim Lemperle made it 2-0 in the 26th.
Junior Adamu pulled one back late after a parried Edin Dzeko header, the first goal by a Schalke striker this season.
Schalke created plenty of chances but wasted them and went into the international break in 17th place; Hoffenheim rose to eighth with 12 points.
background: Karius signed for second-division Schalke from Liverpool in 2024, and 40-year-old Edin Dzeko helped Schalke win promotion with a 1-0 over Fortuna Duesseldorf.
member_headlines: Karius hands Hoffenheim a goal as Schalke lose 2-1 at the bottom of the table

headline: Manchester United scout Rennes left-back Mahamadou Nagida for January
facts: Per TEAMtalk, Manchester United have been scouting the 21-year-old Cameroon international as a possible January left-back signing.
Nagida has played 13 times in all competitions this season, scoring once and providing two assists.
Other left-backs on United's reported shortlist include Alejandro Balde, David Raum and Adrien Truffert.
background: Rennes were 8th in Ligue 1 on 16 points in the latest table; striker Esteban Lepaul has nine league goals for them.
member_headlines: Manchester United scout Rennes left-back Mahamadou Nagida for January

headline: VAR lets Man United's injury-time equaliser stand in 4-4 draw with Aston Villa as pundits argue over a foul on the keeper
facts: Patrick Dorgu scored Manchester United's injury-time equaliser from a corner in a 4-4 draw with Aston Villa, while Villa keeper Zion Suzuki felt Senne Lammens had fouled him.
Referee Chris Kavanagh and VAR Craig Pawson left the goal standing; ESPN's Andy Davies called it correct but borderline, while United fan Mark Goldbridge argued VAR should have intervened.
The article dates the match 8 November; ESPN's coverage the same week shows Mauricio Pochettino has just taken over as United head coach.
background: Manchester United have been through several managers since Sir Alex Ferguson left in 2013, and Mauricio Pochettino is the latest to take the job.
member_headlines: VAR lets Man United's injury-time equaliser stand in 4-4 draw with Aston Villa as pundits argue over a foul on the keeper

headline: Manuel Neuer, 40, suffers a partial ligament tear in his foot
facts: Neuer was substituted just before halftime in Bayern's 2-1 win at Mainz and has a partial ligament tear in his right foot.
Bayern gave no return date and said he is out for the time being.
At 40 years and 225 days he had become Bayern's oldest Bundesliga player in that game; 23-year-old Jonas Urbig replaced him.
background: Urbig is seen as Neuer's long-term successor at Bayern.
member_headlines: Manuel Neuer, 40, suffers a partial ligament tear in his foot

headline: Simeone backs Julian Alvarez after big misses in Atletico's loss to Barcelona
facts: Atletico lost 2-1 at home; Fermin Lopez scored both Barcelona goals.
Alvarez missed several chances, including a one-on-one with Joan Garcia.
Atletico's seven-game league winning streak ended and they sit third, five points behind Barcelona.
background: Alvarez wanted to leave for Barcelona in June, was jeered by Atletico fans at the start of the season and has since apologised.
member_headlines: Simeone backs Julian Alvarez after big misses in Atletico's loss to Barcelona

headline: What if Manchester United had hired Klopp instead of Moyes?
facts: The ESPN analysis says even a huge Klopp effect would not have given United a title since Ferguson.
With 10 extra points a season, United would have averaged 76 instead of 66 points and 3.8 instead of 5.3 finishing place.
Whoever replaces Carrick would be the ninth coach since Ferguson.
background: United are 14 seasons without a league title; Moyes, Van Gaal, Mourinho, Solskjaer, Ten Hag, Amorim and Carrick have followed Ferguson.
member_headlines: What if Manchester United had hired Klopp instead of Moyes?

headline: Chelsea warn staff over fantasy football after João Pedro was quietly dropped from FPL teams
facts: ESPN sources say Chelsea reminded Cobham staff that FPL moves can reveal injuries or tactics.
Outsiders reportedly noticed Rogers and other Chelsea staff dropping João Pedro before the club confirmed he was injured.
Alonso said afterward that he does not follow fantasy football.
background: João Pedro was absent from the 2-0 home loss to Tottenham on 24 October without any pre-match announcement.
member_headlines: Chelsea warn staff over fantasy football after João Pedro was quietly dropped from FPL teams

headline: Dan Burn called into England squad as Guehi withdraws injured
facts: Marc Guehi withdrew from Tuchel's squad after being substituted at half-time in Manchester City's loss to Nottingham Forest, ending a run of 15 straight England appearances.
Newcastle's Dan Burn replaced him for Nations League games against Croatia at Wembley and Spain.
Burn has 11 caps and last featured at the summer World Cup as a late substitute in the win over Mexico.
background: Guehi's withdrawal came after Manchester City lost to Nottingham Forest; England then played world champions Spain on Sunday 15 November.
footage_terms: Dan Burn England Mexico World Cup
member_headlines: Dan Burn called into England squad as Guehi withdraws injured

headline: Australia coach Tony Popovic waves off links to the Palace job
facts: Popovic, 53, called the Palace links speculation and gave no guarantee about staying beyond his Australia contract, which ends in March.
He confirmed talks with Football Australia about an extension have started.
Thomas Frank, Sean Dyche and Vitor Pereira were also linked with Palace at the time.
background: Popovic played for Crystal Palace for five years, including their 2004-05 Premier League season, and later worked there as an assistant.
member_headlines: Australia coach Tony Popovic waves off links to the Palace job

headline: Tom Brady leaves Birmingham City as minority owner
facts: Birmingham announced that Tom Brady is leaving his minority ownership role; no reason was given.
The club thanked him for three years of support and said it will build on that foundation.
The exit comes while Birmingham top the Championship, having won seven of their last nine, including 2-1 against Swansea.
background: Brady, a seven-time Super Bowl winner, bought a stake of just over three per cent in August 2023; Birmingham were relegated that first season after sacking John Eustace, bounced back from League One, and finished 10th last season.
footage_terms: Tom Brady St Andrews Birmingham stadium visit
member_headlines: Tom Brady leaves Birmingham City as minority owner

headline: Yamal, Cubarsi and Rodri named in the 2026 FIFPRO World XI
facts: Three Barcelona players made the 2026 FIFPRO World XI: Lamine Yamal, Pau Cubarsi and Rodri.
Pedri was nominated but did not make the final team.
The XI was chosen by a vote of 19,806 professional footballers worldwide.
background: Rodri arrived at Barcelona in August 2026 from Manchester City, and Cubarsi came through La Masia.
footage_terms: Rodri Spain World Cup 2026 passing masterclass
member_headlines: Yamal, Cubarsi and Rodri named in the 2026 FIFPRO World XI

headline: Fiorentina 2-2 Juventus: handball row and Spalletti says his side wallows in doubt
facts: Late at 2-2, Joao Mario appeared to handle in his own box; Italian referee experts and papers say Juventus deserved a penalty and a VAR review.
Spalletti said his team loses belief too easily and declined to engage on the handball question.
The draw left Juventus seventh with 18 points, their worst Serie A start since 2021/22.
background: Juventus were six points outside the top four after 11 rounds.
member_headlines: Fiorentina 2-2 Juventus: handball row and Spalletti says his side wallows in doubt

headline: Holstein Kiel sack Tim Walter after eight points from 11 games
facts: Kiel dismissed head coach Tim Walter and his assistants Julian Hubner and Michael Wimmer after a 2-1 home loss to Arminia Bielefeld.
The club is last in the 2. Bundesliga with eight points from 11 games: one win, five draws, five defeats.
Sporting director Olaf Rebbe called the start alarming and unsatisfactory for everyone involved.
background: Walter, 51, returned to Kiel in February 2026 to replace Marcel Rapp; he had coached the club before, from May 2018 to 2019, and finished 12th last season.
member_headlines: Holstein Kiel sack Tim Walter after eight points from 11 games

headline: Karlsruhe's Marvin Wanitzek wins October Goal of the Month again with a free kick
facts: Wanitzek won the 2. Bundesliga October Goal of the Month with a free kick into the corner against Heidenheim.
He took more than 30 percent of the fan vote, ahead of Fabian Reese and Felix Klaus.
It is his second monthly award of the season after his August win.
background: Karlsruhe are 16th in the 2. Bundesliga, in the relegation play-off place, after 11 matchdays.
footage_terms: Marvin Wanitzek Freistoss Tor Heidenheim Karlsruhe
Karlsruher SC Wanitzek free kick goal
member_headlines: Karlsruhe's Marvin Wanitzek wins October Goal of the Month again with a free kick

headline: Bochum win 3-2 at home after Philipp Hofmann's stoppage-time winner
facts: Bochum came back from 2-1 down to beat Karlsruhe 3-2 on matchday 11.
Striker Philipp Hofmann scored twice, the second a stoppage-time winner.
It was Bochum's first home win of the season; they are eighth with 14 points.
background: Bochum are a former Bundesliga club now trying to climb back up the second tier; the table has them eighth.
member_headlines: Bochum win 3-2 at home after Philipp Hofmann's stoppage-time winner

headline: Magdeburg crush St. Pauli 4-1 as the Bundesliga's relegated club slide down
facts: Magdeburg scored three goals after the break to beat St. Pauli 4-1 and moved up to fourth place.
St. Pauli's Louis Oppie was sent off late in the game.
St. Pauli are ninth with 12 points from 11 games.
background: St. Pauli were relegated from the Bundesliga in the spring and are now fighting in the second tier, while Magdeburg sit on 20 points.
member_headlines: Magdeburg crush St. Pauli 4-1 as the Bundesliga's relegated club slide down

headline: Kane leads the Bundesliga in assists and matches his best season total
facts: Kane made two assists in Bayern's 2-1 win at Mainz, setting up goals for Joshua Kimmich and Lennart Karl.
He has eight Bundesliga assists, the most in the league, matching his best-ever Bundesliga season total.
He has gone four games without a goal, which the column says has happened only once before at Bayern.
background: Kane joined Bayern from Tottenham in summer 2023 and was Bundesliga top scorer with 36 goals last season.
member_headlines: Kane leads the Bundesliga in assists and matches his best season total

headline: Mbappe named LaLiga Player of the Month for October with 11 goals in the league
facts: Mbappe won LaLiga Player of the Month for October, his second such award after January 2025.
He scored four goals in October: two in the 4-1 win over Sevilla and two in the 2-1 Clasico win over Barcelona.
He ended October with 11 goals and two assists in the league.
background: Mbappe joined Real Madrid in 2024 and finished second to Kane in the 2026 Ballon d'Or.
footage_terms: Mbappe Clasico goals Barcelona Real Madrid
member_headlines: Mbappe named LaLiga Player of the Month for October with 11 goals in the league

headline: Porto win all 11 matches to start the Primeira Liga season
facts: Sky's Euro Debrief says Porto have won all of their 11 matches this season.
The same column notes PSG's 11th straight win in all competitions, a 1-0 win over Troyes.
In Ligue 1, Lassine Sinayoko has nine league goals, two more than anyone else.
background: Porto are one of Portugal's big three clubs alongside Benfica and Sporting.
member_headlines: Porto win all 11 matches to start the Primeira Liga season

headline: Chengdu Rongcheng blow 14-point lead, lose Chinese Super League title; coach Aloisi sacked
facts: Chengdu led by 14 points with five rounds left and needed one point, but lost the final matches and the title went to Dalian Yingbo.
Chengdu had the better goal difference, but the league ranks teams on head-to-head first and Dalian won both meetings.
The club dismissed coach John Aloisi and his staff on Tuesday; Aloisi apologized to fans.
background: Aloisi is a former Australia international who scored the penalty that sent Australia to the 2006 World Cup.
member_headlines: Chengdu Rongcheng blow 14-point lead, lose Chinese Super League title; coach Aloisi sacked

headline: Brighton teenager Zadok Yohanna leads Nigeria's Olympic qualifying squad
facts: Yohanna, 19, leads Nigeria's 23-man U23 squad for the African qualifiers against DR Congo, with legs on 13 and 17 November.
He joined Brighton from AIK this offseason on a five-year deal after five goals and four assists in 18 games for the Swedish club.
Nigeria last reached the Olympics in 2016, winning bronze in Rio.
background: Winning the tie sends Nigeria to the final qualifying round in March for the 2027 U23 AFCON in Egypt, a route to the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.
member_headlines: Brighton teenager Zadok Yohanna leads Nigeria's Olympic qualifying squad

headline: Xavi Simons ahead of schedule in ACL recovery, eyeing a return around the end of January
facts: Simons tore his anterior cruciate ligament on 25 April in Tottenham's 1-0 win at Wolves, which ruled him out of the last four league games and the World Cup.
He expects to start phase three of rehab later in November, which would bring him back into team training.
A competitive return around the nine-month mark, near the end of January, is possible.
background: Spurs are 11th and have scored fewer goals than all but two Premier League sides after 10 matches, per Sky Sports.
member_headlines: Xavi Simons ahead of schedule in ACL recovery, eyeing a return around the end of January

headline: Thiago red card appeal fails: Brentford striker banned for three games
facts: Brentford's appeal against Thiago's red card against Brighton was rejected on 10 November 2026.
The ban is three Premier League games, covering Everton, Manchester United and Arsenal.
Andrews says the squad is built to cope without key players, and Callum Wilson is expected to lead the attack.
background: Thiago joined from Club Brugge in 2024 for a club-record 30 million pounds and was last season's Golden Boot runner-up. He scored a hat-trick in Brentford's 4-2 win at Everton last season.
member_headlines: Thiago red card appeal fails: Brentford striker banned for three games

headline: Why foreign coaches are flocking to the Championship
facts: Eight Championship clubs have foreign head coaches: Celestini at Burnley, Hellberg at Middlesbrough, Clement at Norwich, Stephan at QPR, Eckert at Southampton, Matos at Swansea, Dionisi at Watford and Peixoto at Wolves.
Sky says 16 of the 24 clubs are still coached by men from the British Isles.
The second tier is seen as a route to the Premier League, and Bosnian Sergej Jakirovic, who took Hull up through the play-offs last season, is now a Premier League manager.
background: The appeal is the atmosphere, the rewards of promotion and the path to the top flight, according to coaches such as Schalke's Miron Muslic, who previously managed Plymouth.
member_headlines: Why foreign coaches are flocking to the Championship

headline: Juventus reportedly consider January move for Atletico striker Alexander Sorloth
facts: ESPN's transfer roundup says Juventus are considering Sorloth, 30, for the January window, and he is described as the favourite for that club.
No fee was reported, and this is a rumour, not a confirmed deal.
Sorloth had one of Atletico's last real chances as a substitute in the 1-2 defeat to Barcelona on 8 November.
The same roundup links Atletico with Arsenal's Martin Zubimendi.
background: Sorloth is a Norwegian striker who joined Atletico from Villarreal in 2025, after a 2024-25 season in which he scored heavily for Villarreal.
member_headlines: Juventus reportedly consider January move for Atletico striker Alexander Sorloth

headline: Manchester United and Tottenham reportedly eye Real Sociedad striker Orri Oskarsson
facts: ESPN's roundup reports that Manchester United and Tottenham are interested in the 22-year-old, with Everton, Brentford and Sunderland also linked.
He has 14 goals and six assists across LaLiga and the Europa League this season.
Any deal reportedly has to exceed EUR 20m, and Atalanta were linked earlier.
He scored in the 67th minute of Real Sociedad's 1-0 win over Rayo Vallecano on 8 November.
background: Oskarsson is an Iceland international who moved to Real Sociedad from FC Copenhagen in 2024.
member_headlines: Manchester United and Tottenham reportedly eye Real Sociedad striker Orri Oskarsson

headline: Marcus Thuram leaves France camp with hamstring injury after scoring against Como
facts: Thuram was ruled out of France's Nations League games with a hamstring injury picked up in the 2-0 win over Como after he scored.
France staff sent him back to Inter and called up Bournemouth's Junior Kroupi.
Football Italia reported on 19 November that Thuram is expected to be available for Inter's trip to Atalanta.
background: Marcus Thuram is the son of France World Cup winner Lilian Thuram and has been a key part of Inter's attack since 2023.
member_headlines: Marcus Thuram leaves France camp with hamstring injury after scoring against Como

headline: Fiorentina reportedly prepare to move on from David De Gea
facts: Corriere dello Sport says Fiorentina already look at replacements for the 36-year-old because of errors this season and his 3.5m euro net salary.
He was at fault for Bremer's goal in the 2-2 draw with Juventus, coming off his line for a cross and staying put.
Coach Vanoli defends him; Fiorentina have nine points and sit 15th.
background: De Gea is the former Manchester United goalkeeper; Corriere sees about seven months left for him in Florence.
footage_terms: Fiorentina Juventus De Gea Bremer goal
member_headlines: Fiorentina reportedly prepare to move on from David De Gea

headline: Cassano says Allegri will land at Fiorentina and calls Napoli's gap a scandal
facts: Cassano predicted Allegri will eventually join Fiorentina, where Paratici is sporting director.
He said Allegri has won nothing in seven or eight years and called Napoli's 14-point gap to Lazio a scandal given the wage bills.
Napoli are under pressure after defeats to Juventus and Porto, and De Laurentiis visited the training ground the week before.
background: Allegri worked with Paratici at Juventus, where the club won five straight Scudetti in his first spell.
member_headlines: Cassano says Allegri will land at Fiorentina and calls Napoli's gap a scandal

headline: Bayern's backup-goalkeeper shortlist: Baumann, Leno and Karius
facts: Sky Sports Deutschland reports Bayern want an experienced back-up goalkeeper for next season.
Oliver Baumann of Hoffenheim, Bernd Leno of Fulham and Loris Karius of Schalke are the names being considered.
Karius made five saves in Schalke's 0-0 draw with Bayern on 5 September.
background: Karius is best known for his errors in Liverpool's 2018 Champions League final defeat to Real Madrid.
member_headlines: Bayern's backup-goalkeeper shortlist: Baumann, Leno and Karius

headline: Kiel hire Mitch Kniat, the man who took Bielefeld to a cup final, as new coach
facts: Mitch Kniat, 40, is the new Kiel head coach one day after Tim Walter was sacked; the loss to his former club Bielefeld was Walter's last game.
His first match is away at Wolfsburg on 21 November, and his first home game is against Kaiserslautern the week after.
Assistants Dani Jara and Janik Steringer join him; Kiel are last with eight points.
background: Kniat won promotion from the 3. Liga with Bielefeld in 2025 and led them to the 2025 DFB Cup final after knocking out holders Leverkusen, losing 4-2 to Stuttgart.
footage_terms: Mitch Kniat Arminia Bielefeld DFB-Pokal Halbfinale Leverkusen
member_headlines: Kiel hire Mitch Kniat, the man who took Bielefeld to a cup final, as new coach

headline: Paris FC's Lassine Sinayoko leads Ligue 1 scoring with nine goals in ten games
facts: The 26-year-old Mali international has nine goals and five assists in 10 Ligue 1 games after a reported 8 million euro move from Auxerre.
He scored a hat-trick in a 3-2 loss at Marseille and had two goals and two assists in a 4-3 win over Rennes.
ESPN says he is the first African player since George Weah in 1991 to score eight goals in a Ligue 1 side's first nine matchdays.
background: Paris FC are the capital's second club and sat third in Ligue 1, three points behind PSG, at the time of the article; Sinayoko scored 12 goals in 32 games for Auxerre last season.
member_headlines: Paris FC's Lassine Sinayoko leads Ligue 1 scoring with nine goals in ten games

headline: Racing Santander loanee Yassir Zabiri, 21, has scored half his club's league goals
facts: ESPN says the 21-year-old has 9 goals in 12 La Liga games and more than half of Racing's 17 league goals.
He is on loan from Rennes with no purchase option; he previously played for Famalicao.
ESPN puts his expected goals at about 0.72 per 90 minutes, similar to Paris FC's Lassine Sinayoko, 26.
background: Zabiri is a Rennes-owned forward who was not a household name before this season.
member_headlines: Racing Santander loanee Yassir Zabiri, 21, has scored half his club's league goals

headline: Messi owns a fifth-tier Spanish club, and the Wrexham dream looks complicated
facts: Messi bought UE Cornella in April 2026, and the club's social following rose from about 35,000 to over a million.
Cornella now sit in Spain's fifth tier after two straight relegations and had won two of their first ten league games.
Messi also bought second-division Eldense, and federation rules could stop the two clubs from competing in the same competition.
background: Cornella were in Spain's third tier as recently as 2024. The Wrexham comparison refers to the Reynolds and McElhenney takeover.
member_headlines: Messi owns a fifth-tier Spanish club, and the Wrexham dream looks complicated

headline: Messi's takeover of fifth-tier UE Cornella: followers up to 1 million, results poor
facts: Messi took over UE Cornella, a semi-pro Spanish fifth-tier side, in April 2026; the club's social following grew from about 35,000 to over one million.
Adidas and MyInvestor joined as sponsors, but the team had won only two of its first ten league games.
Messi also agreed to buy second-division Eldense; that deal awaits approval and would force the clubs into separate competitions.
background: The Wrexham comparison refers to Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney's takeover of the Welsh club, which rose through English leagues.
member_headlines: Messi's takeover of fifth-tier UE Cornella: followers up to 1 million, results poor

headline: Alen Stajcic takes charge of Indonesia women's team on a three-year contract
facts: Stajcic, 53, replaces Japanese coach Satoru Mochizuki.
His first goal is qualifying for the 2029 Women's Asian Cup; the long-term aim is Indonesia's first Women's World Cup.
Friendlies against Bhutan (Nov 29) and Lebanon (Dec 5) are planned in Kudus.
background: Stajcic took Australia to the 2015 World Cup quarter-finals and led the Philippines to their first Women's World Cup in 2023, where they beat co-hosts New Zealand 1-0.
footage_terms: Alen Stajcic Philippines Women's World Cup New Zealand
member_headlines: Alen Stajcic takes charge of Indonesia women's team on a three-year contract

headline: Adidas launches knitted long-sleeve club shirts for Arsenal, Liverpool and Man Utd
facts: The knitted long-sleeve home shirts are a first for Adidas; Arsenal's version landed first in the UK.
The shirts replace the sponsor with the club name and have ribbed cuffs and waistband.
Liverpool and United versions are due before Christmas, with Real Madrid and Juventus expected too.
background: Knitwear shirts are limited to Adidas Elite clubs.
member_headlines: Adidas launches knitted long-sleeve club shirts for Arsenal, Liverpool and Man Utd

headline: Harry Kane wins the Ballon d'Or at 33, one of the oldest first-time winners
facts: Kane won his first men's Ballon d'Or at the London Palladium; ESPN's 11 Nov piece describes it as part of a fortnight of milestones, so the ceremony was roughly two weeks earlier.
He is the fourth-oldest first-time winner, at 33, and has 156 goals in 161 games for Bayern since a €120m move in August 2023.
He has 91 England goals and is closing on Peter Shilton's record of 125 caps.
background: Kane scored 280 goals in 435 games across 19 years at Tottenham but never broke Clive Allen's single-season club record of 49 goals.
member_headlines: Harry Kane wins the Ballon d'Or at 33, one of the oldest first-time winners

headline: Mbappe hamstring problem rules him out of France-Italy
facts: Mbappe sat out training with a hamstring issue and Zidane confirmed he would miss the Italy game in Milan.
Zidane called it nothing major and expected him fit for Sunday's game against Turkiye.
Italy coach Mancini joked that Mbappe should avoid risks given Madrid's upcoming Champions League game.
background: France lead their Nations League group; Zidane described not taking risks with the Real Madrid striker.
footage_terms: France Turkiye Nations League Bordeaux highlights
member_headlines: Mbappe hamstring problem rules him out of France-Italy

headline: Zubimendi denies he wants to leave Arsenal amid Atletico interest, admits he is short of minutes
facts: Zubimendi told Marca that talk of a January exit is far from reality and that he has not contacted anyone about a move.
He has played only about 100 minutes in seven league games this season, after playing all 38 league games last season.
He said he has considered psychological help but has not taken that step, and that he is happy in London.
Arteta told him before the season that competition for minutes would rise after the arrival of Bruno Guimaraes; he is under contract until 2030.
background: Arsenal signed Zubimendi from Real Sociedad in 2025 for a reported 51 million pounds, and he was part of Spain's 2026 World Cup winning squad.
member_headlines: Zubimendi denies he wants to leave Arsenal amid Atletico interest, admits he is short of minutes

headline: Harry Kane passes Peter Shilton to become England's most-capped player
facts: ESPN said Kane was set to pass Shilton's 125 caps in the match against Croatia. FourFourTwo says he reached 126 and then 127.
ESPN says he won the men's Ballon d'Or for the first time about a fortnight earlier.
He has not yet won a major trophy with England and signed a new Bayern deal through 2029.
background: Kane joined Bayern from Tottenham in August 2023 for 120 million euros and is England's record goalscorer.
member_headlines: Harry Kane passes Peter Shilton to become England's most-capped player

headline: FIFA clears US-led and UK bids for Women's World Cups, vote set for Nov 23
facts: FIFA said both joint bids met minimum requirements.
Members vote at an Extraordinary FIFA Congress on Nov 23.
The 2031 bid (US, Mexico, Costa Rica, Jamaica) is the only one for 2031 and proposes 20 stadiums for a 48-team event.
The 2035 UK bid proposes 19 stadiums with the final at Wembley.
background: The 2031 Women's World Cup will expand from 32 to 48 teams.
footage_terms: Women's World Cup 2031 bid USA Mexico
Women's World Cup 2035 UK bid Wembley
FIFA Congress Women's World Cup hosts
member_headlines: FIFA clears US-led and UK bids for Women's World Cups, vote set for Nov 23

headline: 2027 Women's World Cup draw set for Dec 11, with top four ranked teams kept apart until the semifinals
facts: The draw is on Dec 11 in Rio de Janeiro, with seeding from FIFA rankings as of Dec 7.
The four highest-ranked teams are kept apart if they win their groups, so they cannot meet before the semifinals.
The current top four are Spain, the United States, Germany and England.
Pot 1 is Brazil plus the top seven ranked teams.
background: The change follows the approach used at the men's World Cup earlier this year, and the 2027 tournament is hosted by Brazil.
footage_terms: FIFA Women's World Cup draw seeding
member_headlines: 2027 Women's World Cup draw set for Dec 11, with top four ranked teams kept apart until the semifinals

headline: Southgate: Kane isn't a better player than two years ago, just more confident, after Ballon d'Or win
facts: Southgate told ITV that Kane has not become a better player in two years, but his biggest change is self-belief.
Kane won the Ballon d'Or last month, beating Kylian Mbappe and Lamine Yamal and becoming the first English winner in 25 years.
Southgate recalled telling Kane after the 2024 final defeat that he would win the league with Bayern, which then happened.
background: Kane lost the 2021 and 2024 European Championship finals with England under Southgate and left Tottenham for Bayern in 2023 without a major trophy.
footage_terms: Southgate Kane Ballon d'Or ITV interview
member_headlines: Southgate: Kane isn't a better player than two years ago, just more confident, after Ballon d'Or win

headline: Kane thanks acupuncture doctor who revived his career before breaking England's caps record
facts: Kane credited acupuncture specialist Dr Alejandro Elorriaga Claraco, whom he began working with in 2020 after a run of injuries, for reviving his career.
At 33 he shared England's all-time caps record with Peter Shilton and was due to take sole ownership with his 126th cap against Croatia at Wembley.
ESPN reports he broke the record in that match and was inspired by Luka Modric as he chases his biggest dream.
background: Kane is the reigning Ballon d'Or winner, and England's all-time top scorer, having moved to Bayern from Tottenham in 2023.
footage_terms: Kane 126th cap England record Croatia Wembley
member_headlines: Kane thanks acupuncture doctor who revived his career before breaking England's caps record

headline: Dirk Kuyt leaves Fenerbahce a week after beating Liverpool
facts: Kuyt left after Fenerbahce agreed a deal with Emre Belozoglu, a former club captain.
His last game as interim coach was a 3-2 Champions League win over Liverpool in Istanbul.
Fenerbahce are sixth in the Turkish league and 19th in the Champions League table.
background: Kuyt played for Fenerbahce from 2012 to 2015 and rejoined in July as assistant to Ismail Kartal, who resigned in October.
member_headlines: Dirk Kuyt leaves Fenerbahce a week after beating Liverpool

headline: Morgan Rogers calls claims Palmer does not want England a 'lie'
facts: Rogers told BBC Radio 5 Live after England's 2-1 win over Croatia that Palmer 'wants to be here'.
Palmer withdrew from the autumn squad with a minor muscle injury, and Tuchel then suggested he had missed chances to impress him.
Palmer has played three times for England in two years and Tuchel left him out of the Croatia and Spain games.
Tuchel said Rogers was entitled to speak as a friend and teammate.
background: Rogers and Palmer are Chelsea teammates and longtime friends, and Rogers has started all ten league games for Chelsea this season.
member_headlines: Morgan Rogers calls claims Palmer does not want England a 'lie'

headline: Liverpool reportedly eye Brentford's Diouf as doubts grow over Kerkez
facts: Liverpool are reportedly interested in Brentford full-back El Hadji Malick Diouf, 21, a Senegal international.
They want to reinforce the left side in January because of doubts about Milos Kerkez's consistency.
Brentford are said to be reluctant to sell.
background: Diouf is a Senegal international who moved to Brentford in the summer.
footage_terms: El Hadji Malick Diouf Brentford highlights
member_headlines: Liverpool reportedly eye Brentford's Diouf as doubts grow over Kerkez

headline: Atletico's Baena and Pubill score as world champions Spain win 2-0 in Czechia
facts: Alex Baena scored a penalty after a handball in the area, and Marc Pubill added a late second goal, listed at 90+6'.
Czechia were reduced to ten men when Krejci was sent off.
It was Spain's 12th straight win, and their last defeat came against Colombia in March 2024.
Spain lead Nations League Group A3, with England three points behind and due to play them at the Metropolitano.
background: Spain are the reigning world champions after the 2026 World Cup, and both goalscorers play for Atletico.
member_headlines: Atletico's Baena and Pubill score as world champions Spain win 2-0 in Czechia

headline: Bayern injury list grows: Diaz, Gnabry, Saibari and Neuer all out
facts: Diaz tore a muscle against Arsenal on 21 October and was back in parts of team training on 12 November.
Saibari had right ankle surgery and Gnabry a hamstring injury after the 2-2 draw with Dortmund.
Musiala trained alongside Diaz while recovering from a muscle injury; Neuer is out with a foot injury.
background: Musiala said in August that he has treatable absence seizures and chose to keep playing after neurologists cleared him.
member_headlines: Bayern injury list grows: Diaz, Gnabry, Saibari and Neuer all out

facts: Judge Jeannette Vargas in the Southern District of New York denied motions by FIFA (Americas) Inc. and FWC2026 US, Inc. to intervene against UEFA's evidence request.

facts: Ronaldo said on Instagram that filming has begun on 'Day 1s', a football drama made with Matthew Vaughn's UR Marv Studios.

facts: Raphinha said he will give his best for Brazil if his body allows it, and that his earlier comments about managing his minutes were misread.

facts: Atletico announced on 13 November that it bought a 50 percent stake in Atletico Futbol Club, the Ecuadorian Serie B champions; no fee was disclosed.

facts: Tuchel has no release clause in the contract he signed in February and says he would turn down a big club approach before Euro 2028.
He says he misses the matchday rhythm of club football and plans to return to a club after England.

facts: ESPN's Ryan O'Hanlon ranks Yamal first, then Bellingham, Olise, Raphinha and Kane, with Mbappé sixth and Haaland eighth.

He brought forward ear-cyst surgery so he could join Brazil's two November friendlies and was set to captain the side against Japan.

facts: Egypt dismissed coach Hossam Hassan on 7 November, about four months after losing to Argentina at the World Cup.
Local press had scrutinised his relationship with Salah, who was substituted against Angola and later left camp before the South Sudan trip.

facts: Rummenigge says Bayern spoke to several coaches before Kompany and he was hesitant because Kompany had just been relegated.

facts: ESPN says Ronaldo, 41, quit international football after a falling out with coach Jorge Jesus over playing time; another ESPN piece dates the announcement to 5 November.
Denmark won 4-1 in Braga on 14 November, Portugal's heaviest competitive home defeat, with Hojlund scoring twice.

facts: After beating Croatia, Tuchel was asked how he would react to racist abuse in Spain and said he would remind players of the protocols.
Spain coach de la Fuente told a journalist there is no racism in Spain, and Tuchel said his message had been twisted and he was a little upset.

facts: Japan won 3-2 at Singapore's National Stadium in a friendly; Kubo and Keito Nakamura scored early, Vinicius Junior scored twice for Brazil.
Tatsuhiro Sakamoto's deflected shot won it in injury time.
Ancelotti and captain Raphinha were sent off after protests over a disputed foul.
It avenged Japan's 2026 World Cup knockout defeat to Brazil.

facts: Japan won 3-2 in the Mizuho Blue Challenge at Singapore's National Stadium before 38,688 fans.
Kubo scored after 15 minutes, Keito Nakamura after 19 and Tatsuhiro Sakamoto in injury time; Vinicius Junior scored both Brazil goals.

facts: La Gazzetta dello Sport (15 November) reports Manchester United are interested in McKennie.

facts: Chivu won the Panchina d'Oro for 2025-26, voted by coaches, his first time.

facts: Bayern confirmed on 16 November that Davies has a minor tear in his left hamstring.

facts: Chatzialexiou's time at Nuernberg ends on 30 November 2026; his contract originally ran to 31 January 2027, so both clubs agreed an early release.

headline: Ronaldo's mother says she is glad Portugal lost and blasts the tribute to her son
facts: Before the Denmark game the federation had every Portugal player wear a No. 7 shirt as a tribute, but Ronaldo did not attend.

member_headlines: Moriyasu's eight-year Japan reign ends after Paraguay friendly

headline: Lukaku retires from Belgium as all-time top scorer with 94 goals
facts: Lukaku retired after a 16-year international career with 94 goals in 135 caps, a Belgian record.
Kevin De Bruyne is second with 41; only Ronaldo, Messi, Ali Daei and Sunil Chhetri have more international goals.

facts: Scotland lost 4-0 in St Gallen: a Lewis Ferguson own goal (22') then goals from Boteli, Sanches and Amdouni.

headline: Declan Rice hits back at Souness who called him limited
facts: Souness had said in the summer that Rice was limited and maybe better as a centre-half.

facts: Ravenna's Serie C game against Forli on 15 November sold out, bringing in about 199,000 euros from tickets, with 6,743 inside the Stadio Benelli.

facts: El Confidencial reported Bale advises US fund Juggernaut Capital Partners, one of three groups interested in Sevilla.
A rival group, HD Ventures, led by the Sayed brothers, is also reported to be interested.
This is a report, not a confirmed deal; Bale earlier failed in an attempt to buy Cardiff.
background: Bale retired in 2023 aged 33 after three seasons at Los Angeles FC, and has spent far more time on the golf course than the pitch.
footage_terms: Gareth Bale best goals Real Madrid
member_headlines: Gareth Bale reportedly part of a bid group for Sevilla

headline: Arsenal ready to sell a midfielder to beat Chelsea and Liverpool to Alex Scott
facts: Sky reports Arsenal, Chelsea and Liverpool all like the 23-year-old Bournemouth midfielder; a deal could come in January or next summer.
Bournemouth reportedly want close to 100 million pounds including add-ons, though 75 to 80 million plus bonuses may be enough.
Arsenal would need to sell a current midfielder; Mikel Merino, with one league start this season, is seen as the likeliest.
background: Scott's Liverpool appeal comes partly from his history under Andoni Iraola, who managed Bournemouth until this summer.
member_headlines: Arsenal ready to sell a midfielder to beat Chelsea and Liverpool to Alex Scott

headline: Man Utd sack Carrick during the break and hand Pochettino a 2.5-year deal for an Anfield debut
facts: United waited for the November international break after the 3-0 home loss to Bournemouth on 25 October before sacking Michael Carrick and appointing Mauricio Pochettino.
Pochettino's first match is away at Liverpool on Sunday 22 November, with United 18th in the Premier League table.
ESPN reports the deal runs about two and a half years, to 2029; the exact appointment date is not stated in the sources, so 17 Nov is approximate.
background: Carrick took United to third place and Champions League qualification last season, per CEO Omar Berrada; Pochettino previously managed Tottenham from 2014 and was sacked there in November 2019.
footage_terms: Pochettino first press conference Manchester United
member_headlines: Man Utd sack Carrick during the break and hand Pochettino a 2.5-year deal for an Anfield debut

headline: Bruno Fernandes falls from No. 1 to 11th in Sky Sports' Premier League top 25
facts: Erling Haaland is now No. 1 in the Sky Sports ranking, up from fourth in March.
Fernandes was No. 1 in March and has dropped 10 places to 11th; he is the only United player in the top 25.
No player from Tottenham, Newcastle or Aston Villa appears in the top 25.
background: Fernandes is United's captain and the club's best player but his contract runs out at the end of the season.
footage_terms: Bruno Fernandes best Premier League player
member_headlines: Bruno Fernandes falls from No. 1 to 11th in Sky Sports' Premier League top 25

headline: Spurs spent over £330m in the summer, still score less than almost everyone; Richarlison has not played since August
facts: Sky says Spurs spent over £330m this summer yet only two Premier League sides scored fewer goals after 10 matches.
Richarlison rejected a move to Everton at the end of the summer window, has not played for the first team since August and is out of contract in the summer; Spurs want to find him a new club.
Eli Junior Kroupi was a summer target; Bournemouth would want a huge fee to sell in January.
background: Spurs won the Europa League in 2025, beating Manchester United in the final.
member_headlines: Spurs spent over £330m in the summer, still score less than almost everyone; Richarlison has not played since August

headline: Jaissle wants a No. 9 and a No. 10 in January but cash is tight; Toney is admired
facts: Sky reports Newcastle lack an out-and-out No. 10, with Willock and Wissa both used there without being natural in the role.
Signing a nine and a ten looks unlikely unless Newcastle sell players; Jaissle also wants more experience after several senior players left in the summer.
Jaissle admires Ivan Toney, whom he managed at Al Ahli, but a move is seen as unlikely to fit the club's strategy of buying young.
background: Newcastle have won only one of their five home Premier League games this season.
member_headlines: Jaissle wants a No. 9 and a No. 10 in January but cash is tight; Toney is admired

headline: Sky: Villa's biggest unfinished business is a new contract for Unai Emery
facts: Sky calls Villa's summer window a success, with high-profile departures replaced and a younger squad with all positions filled.
It says the main unfinished business is a new contract for Emery, which it rates above any signing.
ESPN's projection puts Villa 10th with 13 points but 13th at the end of the season because their underlying expected-goals numbers look weak.
background: Emery has won the Europa League with Villa and reached his 100th Premier League win as a manager on 17 October.
footage_terms: Unai Emery Aston Villa press conference
member_headlines: Sky: Villa's biggest unfinished business is a new contract for Unai Emery

headline: JJ Gabriel quits Man United as Real Madrid move nears, United threaten legal action
facts: The 16-year-old confirmed his Man United exit in an Instagram video; sources told ESPN he is on the brink of joining Real Madrid.
United would consider legal action if evidence shows he was illegally approached while under contract, ESPN reported on 18 November.
Sky Sports said on 4 November that a verbal agreement existed and Madrid want to sign him in January.
background: He joined United's academy in 2020 at age 10 and asked to leave in September; his EU passport lets him join any European club, and January is the first registration window for him.
footage_terms: JJ Gabriel Manchester United youth goals
Manchester United academy JJ Gabriel highlights
member_headlines: JJ Gabriel quits Man United as Real Madrid move nears, United threaten legal action

headline: Bastoni reportedly on Chelsea's radar as Barcelona hesitate over 80 million euros
facts: TEAMtalk reports Bastoni's representatives have contacted Chelsea, who are described as his most likely Premier League destination.
Barcelona's interest is reportedly uncertain at a fee of about 80 million euros.
ESPN presents these as reported claims, not confirmed deals.
background: Bastoni is one of the best left-sided centre-backs in Europe and scored Inter's only goal in the 3-1 derby loss to Milan on 31 October.
member_headlines: Bastoni reportedly on Chelsea's radar as Barcelona hesitate over 80 million euros

headline: Juventus plan January striker with Balogun and Sesko on the list
facts: Calciomercato reports Balogun has been offered to both Milan and Juventus, with agent Jorge Mendes contacting the clubs.
A 40 million euro move to Everton for Balogun collapsed at the end of the last window; he is under contract at Monaco until June 2028.
A 4 November ESPN roundup said Juventus are also weighing Manchester United's Benjamin Sesko and plan to sign a striker in January with about 100 million euros available.
background: Balogun, 25, is an American-born England-raised striker who plays for the USMNT and has played for Arsenal, Reims and Monaco.
member_headlines: Juventus plan January striker with Balogun and Sesko on the list

headline: Chelsea reported to lead race for Inter defender Bastoni as Barcelona doubt
facts: teamTALK reports Chelsea now lead the race; scouts watched him in Italy's 3-1 win over France.
Barcelona have chased him for years but coach Hansi Flick has doubts about fitting him into his system.
Football Italia says any move depends on Bastoni wanting to leave, with little sign of that.
background: Bastoni is better suited to a back three than the back four he plays for Italy; he scored for Inter in the lost derby.
member_headlines: Chelsea reported to lead race for Inter defender Bastoni as Barcelona doubt

headline: Newcastle set to rival Liverpool for Lens defender Ganiou while Bayern ask about keeper Risser
facts: Newcastle United are reported to be set to rival Liverpool for Lens defender Ismaelo Ganiou.
Bayern Munich have reportedly approached Lens about goalkeeper Robin Risser, with several Premier League clubs possibly competing.
Lens sat 11th in Ligue 1 on 13 points after 10 games.
background: Lens won their first French Cup last season and beat PSG in the French Super Cup in August, but have had a poor start to this Ligue 1 campaign.
member_headlines: Newcastle set to rival Liverpool for Lens defender Ganiou while Bayern ask about keeper Risser

headline: Portugal win 3-2 at Wales as Carlos Forbs scores in the Ronaldo-honouring No. 7 shirt
facts: Portugal beat Wales 3-2 in Cardiff in the Nations League, their first win since Ronaldo's retirement.
Carlos Forbs, 22, scored the 70th-minute winner, his first goal for Portugal, wearing No. 7 with a line through the number.
Pedro Neto, the Chelsea winger, was sent off for two reckless tackles in two minutes.
background: Forbs plays for Club Brugge, and Portugal finished top of their group with five wins from six games.
footage_terms: Pedro Neto red card Wales Portugal
member_headlines: Portugal win 3-2 at Wales as Carlos Forbs scores in the Ronaldo-honouring No. 7 shirt

headline: France federation boss Philippe Diallo confirms bid to unseat Infantino
facts: Diallo, 63, was put forward by UEFA's executive committee and says he needs 106 of 211 votes at the March vote in Rabat.
French President Macron backs him, and France withdrew an earlier letter of support for Infantino in September.
UEFA is pursuing legal action in U.S. courts and seeking evidence for a possible Swiss criminal complaint, which FIFA calls a smear campaign.
background: Diallo became interim French federation president in January 2023 and later joined UEFA's executive committee.
member_headlines: France federation boss Philippe Diallo confirms bid to unseat Infantino

headline: Portugal win first game of the post-Ronaldo era as Carlos Forbs takes the No. 7 shirt and scores
facts: Portugal beat Wales 3-2 in Cardiff in the Nations League.
Forbs scored the 70th-minute winner, his first international goal, wearing Ronaldo's No. 7 with a line across it as a tribute.
Portugal won the group with five wins from six but lost 4-1 to Denmark the previous Saturday.
They await a March quarterfinal against a runner-up; Netherlands were drawn on 20 November.
background: Ronaldo made the No. 7 shirt famous with Portugal; Forbs scored his first international goal in it twelve days after Ronaldo announced his retirement.
member_headlines: Portugal win first game of the post-Ronaldo era as Carlos Forbs takes the No. 7 shirt and scores

headline: McGinn says it is impossible to claim Scotland are heading in the right direction
facts: Aston Villa's McGinn said it is impossible to argue Scotland are on the right track under Pocognoli.
Scotland have beaten bottom side North Macedonia twice in six games under him.
Pocognoli says the 4-0 scoreline overstates how the game went.
McGinn was among those who missed first-half chances.
background: McGinn is Aston Villa's midfielder and a long-time Scotland regular; Pocognoli replaced Steve Clarke in August.
member_headlines: McGinn says it is impossible to claim Scotland are heading in the right direction

headline: Northern Ireland draw in Hungary to win promotion to the Nations League top flight
facts: Northern Ireland drew 1-1 in Budapest after Varga's opener; Justin Devenny equalised in the 65th minute.
They finished unbeaten and one point above Hungary in Group B2.
Michael O'Neill watched from the stands on a touchline ban while Steven Davis relayed instructions.
They had conceded no goal in the campaign until Varga's strike.
background: Northern Ireland were promoted from League C only two years earlier.
member_headlines: Northern Ireland draw in Hungary to win promotion to the Nations League top flight

headline: Gvardiol exit talks reportedly begun, Barcelona interested
facts: Reports say exit talks may begin as early as the summer.
Barcelona's Flick wants him, but a winter deal is described as almost impossible for funding reasons.
Transfermarkt values the 24-year-old at EUR 75m.
background: Gvardiol joined Manchester City from RB Leipzig in 2023.
member_headlines: Gvardiol exit talks reportedly begun, Barcelona interested

headline: Raya reportedly close to Arsenal extension after saying he would like La Liga one day
facts: The 31-year-old is reportedly very close to a new deal; his current contract runs to 2028.
He told Marca he would love to play in La Liga someday.
Real Madrid reportedly see him as a possible Courtois successor.
background: Raya joined Arsenal from Brentford in 2023 and has won the Golden Glove each season.
member_headlines: Raya reportedly close to Arsenal extension after saying he would like La Liga one day

headline: Column: Pochettino cannot fix United alone, the owners have to do their jobs
