facts: ESPN's Gabriele Marcotti notes Ratcliffe paid about 1.65 billion dollars for 28.9% and took over football operations; United have won 35 of 99 league games since and used four managers.
Ratcliffe has reportedly spent over 35 million dollars on payouts to dismissed coaches and sporting directors, including Dan Ashworth, who lasted about five months.
Avram Glazer told investors the club does not rely on sporting success for commercial strength; the column calls that tone-deaf, noting seven straight seasons of losses.
background: Ratcliffe's INEOS group took charge of United's football side after buying a minority stake, while the Glazers kept majority ownership.
footage_terms: Jim Ratcliffe Manchester United owners criticism
member_headlines: Column: Pochettino cannot fix United alone, the owners have to do their jobs

headline: Alex Scott, 23, becomes the midfield prize for Arsenal, Chelsea and Liverpool
facts: Sky reports the 23-year-old England midfielder has 12 months left on his Bournemouth deal and no new contract is agreed.
Bournemouth reportedly want close to 100 million pounds, though about 75 to 80 million plus bonuses could get a deal done.
Arsenal are willing to sell a midfielder, with Mikel Merino seen as most likely, to fund a move.
Thomas Tuchel has called him 'the complete package'; a recent England-duty injury has sidelined him.
background: Scott is a Bournemouth midfielder now linked with the clubs at the top of the table; Andoni Iraola, his old Bournemouth coach, is now at Liverpool.
member_headlines: Alex Scott, 23, becomes the midfield prize for Arsenal, Chelsea and Liverpool

headline: Freiburg's Derry Scherhant, 24, blossoms under Klopp and draws Roma and Bayern
facts: Goal says he joined Freiburg in 2025 for about 2 million euros and has 3 goals and 8 assists in all competitions this season.
He scored his first Germany goal in a 5-0 win over the Netherlands, in his fourth call-up; Klopp gave him his debut against Serbia.
Roma have scouted him and are frustrated that his price is expected to rise at least tenfold.
Another Goal report says Bayern have him on a left-wing list, per tz.
background: Born in Berlin in 2002, he came through several Berlin youth sides and developed late; Jurgen Klopp is now Germany head coach.
footage_terms: Klopp Germany Scherhant Gruda press conference
member_headlines: Freiburg's Derry Scherhant, 24, blossoms under Klopp and draws Roma and Bayern

headline: Dietmar Hamann says 'sky's the limit' for Bayern teen Lennart Karl
facts: Goal says the 18-year-old right winger is tied to Bayern through summer 2029.
Hamann called him probably Germany's biggest young prospect and said his Golden Boy chances may depend on Olise's situation.
A thigh injury ruled him out of the 2026 World Cup and he had a slow start to this season.
He competes with Olise, Luis Diaz and Harry Kane.
background: Karl became Bayern's youngest Champions League scorer at 17 years and 242 days after debuting at the 2025 Club World Cup.
member_headlines: Dietmar Hamann says 'sky's the limit' for Bayern teen Lennart Karl

headline: Griezmann wins MLS Newcomer of the Year in half a season
facts: Griezmann became the first Orlando City player and the first French player to win MLS Newcomer of the Year.
He scored 14 goals with 8 assists in 18 appearances, and scored on his 22 July debut in a 4-0 win over San Jose.
Sports Illustrated notes it is an MLS honour Messi never won.
background: Griezmann arrived from Atletico Madrid in July 2026 after finishing his two-part stint at the club.
footage_terms: Griezmann MLS Newcomer of the Year
member_headlines: Griezmann wins MLS Newcomer of the Year in half a season

headline: Romario demands Brazil sack Ancelotti and Ancelotti shrugs it off
facts: Before the Singapore friendly, Romario posted on Instagram criticising Ancelotti's work and urging the CBF president to fire him.
Ancelotti answered that Romario has the right to speak as much as he wants, and said he likes the direction but must do more.
Under Ancelotti Brazil lost the World Cup round of 16 to Norway and since then have won two and lost one.
background: Romario is a 1994 World Cup winner for Brazil.
member_headlines: Romario demands Brazil sack Ancelotti and Ancelotti shrugs it off

headline: Ajax striker Arokodare in huge form, but Nigeria still stuck
facts: Arokodare has 13 goals and 4 assists in 17 games for Ajax this season, including 7 in the Eredivisie and 6 in the Conference League.
He scored twice against Tanzania in Nigeria's 3-1 win, taking him to 4 goals in 13 caps.
Osimhen and Lookman were unavailable, making Arokodare Nigeria's lead striker candidate.
background: Arokodare moved to Ajax after a difficult spell at Wolves and has said he wanted to move past it.
member_headlines: Ajax striker Arokodare in huge form, but Nigeria still stuck

headline: Moriyasu's Japan era ends with a 2-1 loss to Paraguay
facts: Moriyasu's 113-match spell as Japan coach ended with a 2-1 friendly loss to Paraguay in Singapore.
Paraguay led 2-0 from two set pieces; Shio Fukuda scored on debut in the 85th minute.
He leaves with a 68 percent win rate, wins over Brazil, England, Spain, Germany and Uruguay, and no knockout-round win in two World Cups.
background: Moriyasu took Japan from 55th to 17th in the world rankings; he has been linked to Malaysia but no offer has been made, per ESPN.
member_headlines: Moriyasu's Japan era ends with a 2-1 loss to Paraguay

headline: Houston Dash hire ex-champion coach Seb Hines after his Orlando Pride exit
facts: Hines is the Dash's seventh full-time head coach in the club's 12-year history.
Orlando fired him this season while the team was 12th.
The Dash's women's soccer president said he brings a track record of success.
Contract terms were not given.
background: Hines won the 2024 NWSL Shield and Championship with Orlando, was 2024 Coach of the Year, and in 2022 became the first Black head coach in NWSL history.
member_headlines: Houston Dash hire ex-champion coach Seb Hines after his Orlando Pride exit

headline: England name squad for Ukraine World Cup playoff, with two uncapped call-ups
facts: England play Ukraine in Spain on Dec 1 and at Wembley on Dec 5; the winner goes to the 2027 World Cup in Brazil.
Isobel Goodwin and goalkeeper Katie Cox get their first senior call-ups.
Lucy Bronze returns and is two caps from 150.
Alex Greenwood and Lauren James are among those out injured.
England beat Greece 8-1 on aggregate to reach the playoff, and Sarina Wiegman has extended her contract through Euro 2029.
background: England reached the 2023 World Cup final. Ukraine cannot play home matches because of the war, so the first leg is held in Spain.
member_headlines: England name squad for Ukraine World Cup playoff, with two uncapped call-ups

headline: Liverpool open contract talks with Mac Allister as Bayern eye Ngumoha
facts: ESPN's roundup, citing Cesar Luis Merlo, says Liverpool have opened talks with Mac Allister, whose deal runs to summer 2028.
TEAMtalk reports Bayern contacted Ngumoha's representatives; Liverpool reportedly have no plans to sell and his contract enters its final 18 months in January.
Caught Offside says Liverpool and Chelsea are competing for Monaco midfielder Lamine Camara.
background: Mac Allister scored in the 3-1 win at Crystal Palace on 8 November.
member_headlines: Liverpool open contract talks with Mac Allister as Bayern eye Ngumoha

headline: Haaland is crowned Sky Sports' No 1 Premier League player ahead of Rice
facts: Haaland rose from fourth to first, with 14 league goals since March, almost double the next player, and replaced Bruno Fernandes, who fell to 11th.
Arsenal take places 2 to 4 with Rice, Raya and Gabriel; Cherki is 7th and Elliot Anderson 8th.
Chelsea's Joao Pedro is 9th and Cole Palmer 13th; Liverpool's Van Dijk is 15th and Alisson re-enters at 25th.
background: ESPN's own ranking in the same week had Haaland eighth in the world, saying he is less involved in build-up play than before.
footage_terms: Premier League top 25 players Sky Sports
member_headlines: Haaland is crowned Sky Sports' No 1 Premier League player ahead of Rice

headline: Newcastle's Lewis Hall completes five more first-half dribbles than Yamal in England's 3-2 win in Spain
facts: In the first half of England's 3-2 win over Spain in Madrid, Hall completed five dribbles, five more than Lamine Yamal.
Tuchel left him out of the summer World Cup squad, and England went with arguably only one specialist left-back.
Hall is 22, started as a midfielder in Chelsea's youth teams, and Berrada said United considered him but would not pay inflated prices.
background: Hall played well in Newcastle's home Champions League tie against Barcelona but was in the side that conceded seven in the away leg.
member_headlines: Newcastle's Lewis Hall completes five more first-half dribbles than Yamal in England's 3-2 win in Spain

headline: Onana signs a new Villa contract while recovering from a cruciate injury suffered at the World Cup
facts: Onana, 25, signed a new Villa contract while still recovering from a cruciate ligament injury that ended his World Cup with Belgium early.
He said the early rehab was hard, especially mentally, and that the club renewing his deal during recovery meant a lot.
Emery's preview says Onana is returning from injury and Villa are also offering extensions to Lindelof, Maatsen and George Hemmings.
background: Onana joined Villa from Everton in summer 2024 and credited Emery with the club's recent European success, including a Europa League title.
member_headlines: Onana signs a new Villa contract while recovering from a cruciate injury suffered at the World Cup

headline: Brentford build the next Premier League talent factory under Keith Andrews, with Ukrainian Yarmoliuk a B-team graduate
facts: Brentford are eighth with 14 points after 10 games under Keith Andrews, who replaced Thomas Frank.
The club won Category 1 academy status in April and is building a dome over its academy pitches.
Ukrainian midfielder Yehor Yarmoliuk came through the B-team and has over 100 Premier League appearances; 19-year-old striker Kaye Furo was PL2 Player of the Month in August.
background: Brentford lost Thomas Frank, Christian Norgaard, Bryan Mbeumo and Yoane Wissa in summer 2025 and missed out on a European place last season on goal difference.
member_headlines: Brentford build the next Premier League talent factory under Keith Andrews, with Ukrainian Yarmoliuk a B-team graduate

headline: Aaron Connolly reflects on injuries and regrets in League One at Leyton Orient
facts: Aaron Connolly, 26, plays for League One Leyton Orient and says he has struggled to handle setbacks.
He tore a quad after building momentum with goals and assists, and then needed shoulder surgery after rushing back.
He says he now trains far harder, arriving first and leaving last, has spoken openly about overcoming alcohol addiction, and mentors academy players.
background: The Irish forward scored twice on his Premier League debut for Brighton against Tottenham in 2019 aged 19, before spells at Hull and Sunderland.
footage_terms: Aaron Connolly Brighton debut Tottenham two goals
member_headlines: Aaron Connolly reflects on injuries and regrets in League One at Leyton Orient

headline: Nine games in a month for Barcelona, including Manchester City's first Camp Nou visit since 2016
facts: Barcelona play about nine matches before the end of 2026, starting with Villarreal on 22 November and Sabah FC away in Baku on 25 November.
Other fixtures include Deportivo away on 29 November, a rescheduled home game with Atletico on 2 December, Celta Vigo on 5 December and Manchester City at home on 8 December.
The Manchester City game is their first meeting at the Camp Nou since October 2016, and a Copa del Rey round-of-32 tie is expected in the week of 16 December.
background: Barcelona were playing at the Olympic stadium in Montjuic while the Camp Nou was rebuilt and have played at the renovated Spotify Camp Nou since returning.
footage_terms: Barcelona vs Manchester City Camp Nou 2016 highlights
member_headlines: Nine games in a month for Barcelona, including Manchester City's first Camp Nou visit since 2016

headline: Spain's Supreme Court makes annulment of LaLiga's 2021 CVC vote final, but the deal stands
facts: The Supreme Court rejected LaLiga's cassation appeal, making the annulment of the 12 August 2021 General Assembly vote that approved the CVC deal final, and LaLiga must pay the costs.
Real Madrid and Athletic Club won the case, while the separate December 2021 approval of the LaLiga Impulso project stays in force.
Under that deal clubs received about EUR 2bn in exchange for a share of audiovisual rights income over 50 years.
Real Madrid has taken the December ruling to the Supreme Court, which has not yet decided whether to admit the appeal.
background: Real Madrid, Barcelona and Athletic Club rejected the CVC deal in 2021, and the conflict between Real Madrid and LaLiga president Javier Tebas has run for years.
member_headlines: Spain's Supreme Court makes annulment of LaLiga's 2021 CVC vote final, but the deal stands

headline: Ex-Napoli striker Sosa takes a dig at Allegri over Hojlund's goal drought
facts: Sosa asked on X why Hojlund scores for Denmark but rarely for Napoli, implying Allegri's tactics are the problem.
Hojlund has three goals in 14 games for Napoli and six in his last six for Denmark.
Napoli are 10th with 15 points and have won once in their last five league games.
background: Sosa played for Napoli from 2004 to 2008 and scored 28 goals in 116 games.
member_headlines: Ex-Napoli striker Sosa takes a dig at Allegri over Hojlund's goal drought

headline: Napoli's spending under Conte compared with Spalletti: a financial gap
facts: Under Conte, Napoli spent 367m euros on transfers in two seasons and took in 223m from sales, a net deficit of 144m.
Wages and amortisation reached 253m and 300m euros in his two seasons, against never more than 200m under Spalletti.
Each Serie A point cost about 2.3m euros under Spalletti and about 3.5m under Conte.
background: Conte and Spalletti each won one Serie A title at Napoli; Spalletti's was the club's first since Maradona.
member_headlines: Napoli's spending under Conte compared with Spalletti: a financial gap

headline: Napoli buy land for new training centre at Qualiano
facts: Napoli signed a preliminary deal for up to 18 hectares at Qualiano, with eight pitches planned, two more with the extra land.
The site is zoned agricultural so building permission is still needed; work is expected to start in early 2027.
De Laurentiis posted that it is done and called it a new beginning after Castel Volturno.
background: Napoli have trained at Castel Volturno for years and won two league titles while based there.
member_headlines: Napoli buy land for new training centre at Qualiano

headline: Yildiz still out with a broken foot, Juventus target December return
facts: Yildiz fractured his left fifth metatarsal in his first league game of the season in August and needed surgery.
He has missed 20 club and international games, including 10 Serie A games.
Chiellini said he is back training with the ball but return will still take time; December is the target.
background: Initial estimates were two to three months; the worst case is a return in the new year.
member_headlines: Yildiz still out with a broken foot, Juventus target December return

headline: USMNT drops out of ESPN's top-15 World Cup 2030 power rankings as Spain stay No. 1 and Germany jump four places
facts: ESPN's 20-voter panel has Spain first with 15 first-place votes, England second and France third.
Germany rose four places to fourth after the 5-0 win over the Netherlands.
The US fell out of the top 15 as voters worried about life after Pochettino.
Spain stay No. 1 despite their 43-game unbeaten run ending against England.
background: The next World Cup is in 2030; Argentina will co-host as one of the opening-match hosts.
footage_terms: World Cup 2030 power rankings Spain England
member_headlines: USMNT drops out of ESPN's top-15 World Cup 2030 power rankings as Spain stay No. 1 and Germany jump four places

headline: Besiktas eye Manchester United's Matthijs de Ligt on January loan with obligation to buy
facts: TEAMtalk reports Besiktas are exploring a January move for the 27-year-old.
Any loan would have to include an obligation to buy; no fee was reported.
Fulham's Calvin Bassey is linked as a possible United replacement.
background: De Ligt joined United from Bayern Munich for about EUR 45m, as listed in the Pochettino squad audit. He previously played for Ajax and Juventus.
footage_terms: Matthijs de Ligt Manchester United highlights
member_headlines: Besiktas eye Manchester United's Matthijs de Ligt on January loan with obligation to buy

headline: Bayern reportedly make contact with Liverpool teenager Rio Ngumoha's representatives
facts: TEAMtalk reports Bayern contacted the 18-year-old's representatives.
Liverpool reportedly will not entertain offers.
He enters the final 18 months of his contract in January.
background: Ngumoha is a teenage Liverpool winger who joined the club from Chelsea's academy.
member_headlines: Bayern reportedly make contact with Liverpool teenager Rio Ngumoha's representatives

headline: Arsenal face unpopular contract decisions as seven players near expiry
facts: The Telegraph says Raya, Havertz, Odegaard, White, Rice, Merino and Timber are within 18 months of expiry.
Only Rice, Raya and Timber are reportedly close to new deals.
Odegaard says he wants to stay but talks have not started.
background: Arsenal won their first Premier League title in 22 years under Mikel Arteta, according to the article.
member_headlines: Arsenal face unpopular contract decisions as seven players near expiry

headline: Bournemouth reportedly want 100 million pounds each for Kroupi and Alex Scott
facts: The Sun reports Bournemouth want 100 million pounds for Kroupi, 20; Arsenal, Barcelona and PSG are keen.
Daily Star says they also want 100 million for Scott, 23, who has turned down several contract extensions.
Liverpool, Arsenal and Chelsea are linked with Scott.
background: Bournemouth are a Premier League club now fielding two young players reportedly valued at nine figures.
member_headlines: Bournemouth reportedly want 100 million pounds each for Kroupi and Alex Scott

headline: Panel rules Arsenal were wrongly denied a penalty against Hull after VAR review
facts: In Arsenal's 1-0 win over Hull on 7 November, Nobel Mendy held Kai Havertz, who was in an offside position; referee Farai Hallam gave no penalty and VAR Michael Oliver sent him to the monitor but the decision stood.
The five-member Key Match Incidents panel ruled unanimously that a penalty should have been awarded, because the holding came before any offside offence.
The panel reviewed 223 incidents in the first 10 rounds and found 85 percent of on-field decisions correct, rising to 97 percent after VAR.
background: Arsenal also lead the Premier League in offsides this season, with Havertz himself flagged 15 times, more than any other top-flight player.
footage_terms: Key Match Incidents Arsenal Hull penalty
member_headlines: Panel rules Arsenal were wrongly denied a penalty against Hull after VAR review

headline: How fallen giants and their fans bounced back, from Juventus to Rangers
facts: Juventus were relegated and stripped of two league titles over Calciopoli in 2006; Fiorentina were declared bankrupt in 2002 and restarted in the fourth tier.
Rangers entered administration in 2012 over an unpaid tax bill of about 9 million pounds, dropped to the fourth tier and are now hoping for a boost under new American ownership.
Marseille were relegated for match-fixing in 1994, a year after winning the European Cup, while City fans await an appeal over 114 breaches of Premier League financial rules.
background: Several of Europe's biggest clubs have dropped down the divisions after scandals and financial collapses, then clawed their way back.
member_headlines: How fallen giants and their fans bounced back, from Juventus to Rangers

headline: JJ Gabriel, 16, announces exit from Man Utd as Real Madrid deal nears
facts: The 16-year-old posted a farewell video on Instagram about leaving for his 'next chapter'; United say they were not told first and could not reach him or his family.
Real Madrid reportedly agreed a deal earlier in November but plan to sign him in January; he asked to leave United in September.
He has an EU passport through both parents; United say they will challenge the move legally if they find proof of inducement.
He never played a competitive first-team match for United.
background: Gabriel joined United's academy in 2020 at age 10 and made a pre-season first-team debut at 15 against Atletico Madrid.
footage_terms: JJ Gabriel Manchester United academy highlights
JJ Gabriel pre-season debut Atletico Madrid
member_headlines: JJ Gabriel, 16, announces exit from Man Utd as Real Madrid deal nears

headline: Gladbach's 17-year-old Wael Mohya draws Liverpool and Bayern, but Klopp leaves him out
facts: ESPN, citing Bild, says the 17-year-old attacking midfielder has 2 goals and 1 assist in 9 Bundesliga games.
Liverpool and Bayern are reportedly interested, with Brighton, Leverkusen and Leipzig linked earlier.
Klopp left him out of Germany's 23-man squad for the Nations League game in Serbia (ESPN, Nov 12).
background: Mohya plays as a No. 10 for Gladbach and is among Germany's youngest rising names.
member_headlines: Gladbach's 17-year-old Wael Mohya draws Liverpool and Bayern, but Klopp leaves him out

headline: Suarez says he expects to retire before Messi
facts: Suarez, 39, says he and Messi will play as long as they enjoy it and stay competitive.
He says Messi still has plenty of energy, so he expects to be the one who steps away first.
Suarez has 17 goals and 12 assists this regular season and is a free agent after 2026, per Sports Illustrated.
background: Suarez and Messi were Barcelona team-mates and are together again at Inter Miami. Suarez quit Uruguay duty in 2024.
member_headlines: Suarez says he expects to retire before Messi

headline: Vasco sign Carlos Vinicius on a pre-contract and annoy Gremio
facts: Striker Carlos Vinicius signed a pre-contract with Vasco in early November and is expected to join in January on a two-year deal with an option for a third year.
Gremio say their finances blocked a renewal, and its board felt the player's side was not transparent about the pre-contract.
Gremio are in the relegation zone on 38 points yet still have a Copa do Brasil final against Palmeiras on 6 December in Brasilia.
background: Renato Portaluppi coaches Gremio, and ESPN reports he will keep playing Carlos Vinicius despite the off-field row.
member_headlines: Vasco sign Carlos Vinicius on a pre-contract and annoy Gremio

headline: Ashley Sanchez wins NWSL MVP with a record-tying 20 goals for a team that missed the playoffs
facts: Sanchez scored 20 goals, tying the single-season record set by Temwa Chawinga in 2024.
She also had 5 assists and led the league with 25 goal contributions.
Her 20 goals were more than her first five NWSL seasons combined.
She is only the second player to win MVP while her team missed the playoffs.
background: Sanchez joined the North Carolina Courage from the Washington Spirit in a January 2024 trade.
member_headlines: Ashley Sanchez wins NWSL MVP with a record-tying 20 goals for a team that missed the playoffs

headline: England defender Jess Carter leaves Gotham for Bay FC
facts: Carter, 29, signed as a free agent on a deal through 2028 with an option for 2029.
She played all 30 regular-season games for Gotham in 2026.
Bay FC's football chief Paul Green worked with her at Chelsea.
She is in England's squad for the December World Cup playoff against Ukraine.
background: Carter won five straight WSL titles at Chelsea, joined Gotham in 2024, won the 2025 NWSL Championship, and has 56 England caps.
member_headlines: England defender Jess Carter leaves Gotham for Bay FC

headline: Veerle Buurman's 87th-minute header-in sends Chelsea past PSG in the Champions League
facts: Buurman bundled in a corner at the near post in the 87th minute for a 1-0 win.
Chelsea are on 11 points from five matches and control their own route to a direct quarter-final spot.
Chelsea created little in the match, and PSG are on 5 points.
Chelsea have not conceded in five league-phase games but have scored only four.
background: Sonia Bompastor has built Chelsea around defensive strength, and the team has the best defensive record in the WSL.
footage_terms: Chelsea vs PSG Women's Champions League highlights
member_headlines: Veerle Buurman's 87th-minute header-in sends Chelsea past PSG in the Champions League

headline: Man City beat Häcken 2-0 with two substitute goals, but Fowler's late penalty is saved
facts: Lauren Hemp scored in the 55th minute from a deflection, and Khadija Shaw added a second in the 77th.
Both scorers came on at half-time.
Jennifer Falk saved Mary Fowler's late penalty.
It was City's second straight away European win after three draws.
background: Man City won the WSL and the cup last season and are led by Swedish coach Andree Jeglertz.
footage_terms: Häcken vs Manchester City Women highlights
member_headlines: Man City beat Häcken 2-0 with two substitute goals, but Fowler's late penalty is saved

headline: Randy Waldrum named Malawi women's head coach on a two-year deal
facts: Waldrum, a veteran American coach, signed a two-year contract with Malawi.
He replaces Lovemore Fazili, who becomes his assistant.
Malawi reached the 2026 WAFCON final in its first attempt, losing 3-0 to Cameroon.
Malawi also qualified for the 2027 Women's World Cup in Brazil.
background: Waldrum previously coached Nigeria to the 2023 Women's World Cup round of 16 and was also head coach of the Houston Dash.
footage_terms: Randy Waldrum Nigeria Super Falcons World Cup 2023
member_headlines: Randy Waldrum named Malawi women's head coach on a two-year deal

headline: Amad snaps at fan who mocked his 336-day goal drought
facts: A United fan posted a video on Instagram about Amad's 336 days without a goal.
Amad replied angrily in the comments and offered to swap places with the fan.
It followed a 2-2 draw between Ivory Coast and Gambia in which Amad hit the crossbar.
background: Amad's last United goal came in a 4-4 draw with Bournemouth at Old Trafford on 15 December 2025.
member_headlines: Amad snaps at fan who mocked his 336-day goal drought

headline: Pochettino told 'Manchester is blue' and has a reply ready
facts: Ex-USMNT defender DeMarcus Beasley told Pochettino on TNT Sports US that Manchester is a blue city.
Pochettino disagreed and said fans would see otherwise, but that he needed time.
His United tenure officially began that Wednesday.
background: Pochettino coached the USMNT before United, which is why a former US international was interviewing him.
member_headlines: Pochettino told 'Manchester is blue' and has a reply ready

headline: Neil Warnock named 'Chief of Socks' and mocks holes-in-socks trend
facts: Warnock became 'Chief of Socks' for The Famous Grouse and modelled a limited Christmas sock range.
He criticised top players cutting holes in their socks, saying he does not believe it gives an advantage.
He draws on his chiropody qualifications for the role.
background: Kyle Walker said in 2021 he cut holes in his socks to release tension in his calves.
member_headlines: Neil Warnock named 'Chief of Socks' and mocks holes-in-socks trend

headline: Sneijder admits he 'released anger' at half-time of a legends charity game
facts: Sneijder played for Ajax legends against Barcelona legends at the Johan Cruyff Arena; Barcelona won 7-4.
He said he was only allowed about 30 minutes and criticised teammates and Danny Blind's selection.
The day before, he won his first game as manager of ninth-tier Eminent Boys 3-1.
background: Sneijder retired in 2019, and his last club was Al Gharafa.
footage_terms: Ajax legends Barcelona legends Johan Cruyff Arena
member_headlines: Sneijder admits he 'released anger' at half-time of a legends charity game

headline: Arteta faces a Saliba or Konsa selection dilemma at Arsenal
facts: Konsa has played well while Saliba was injured, so Arteta must choose or play them together.
Without Saliba, Arsenal's defensive line has sat at least a metre lower.
Konsa and Gabriel have made seven last-man tackles together this season, against five by Saliba and Gabriel in all of last season.
background: Konsa joined Arsenal from Aston Villa this summer for 55m pounds.
member_headlines: Arteta faces a Saliba or Konsa selection dilemma at Arsenal

headline: Giants who fell and climbed back: how Juventus, Rangers and Fiorentina recovered, as Man City await their verdict
facts: City fans are awaiting the outcome of their appeal and the punishment for 114 breaches of Premier League financial rules.
Juventus were sent to Serie B and stripped of their 2005 and 2006 titles in the Calciopoli case, then won the 2012 Serie A title.
Rangers entered administration in February 2012 over a 9 million pound tax bill, restarted in the fourth tier and won the league again in 2021.
background: Fiorentina were declared bankrupt in 2002 and restarted in Italy's fourth tier, returning to Serie A by 2004. Marseille were relegated for match-fixing after winning the 1993 European Cup.
member_headlines: Giants who fell and climbed back: how Juventus, Rangers and Fiorentina recovered, as Man City await their verdict

headline: David Raya is called the Premier League's best goalkeeper and is close to a new Arsenal deal
facts: Raya has seven clean sheets in 10 league games and has not conceded a 'saveable' goal this season, per Gradient Sports data.
Martinez, Alisson and Donnarumma have conceded three, four and five saveable goals.
He received the most FIFPRO World XI votes, 10,278, though Unai Simon won the Ballon d'Or goalkeeper award.
Sky says Arsenal are close to giving him a new contract; ESPN's roundup cites The Athletic saying terms are agreed.
background: Raya joined Arsenal from Brentford in 2023 and has kept clean sheets in nearly half of his 117 Premier League games for the club.
member_headlines: David Raya is called the Premier League's best goalkeeper and is close to a new Arsenal deal

headline: Haaland is one of four City captains and says fatherhood made leadership 'natural'
facts: City have four appointed captains this season: Haaland, Ruben Dias, Marc Guehi and Gianluigi Donnarumma.
Haaland said leading is now natural since he became a father and he tries to help new signings settle.
He scored a late winner against Denmark and a penalty against Wales for Norway.
City host Fulham on Saturday and then face Napoli in the Champions League.
background: He is in his fifth season at City and is now among the club's longest-serving players.
member_headlines: Haaland is one of four City captains and says fatherhood made leadership 'natural'

headline: Man City reportedly set to lose Mateo Kovacic at the end of the season
facts: ESPN's roundup cites a Marca report dated 19 November that Kovacic will leave when his contract expires at the end of the season.
The same roundup links Chelsea with Inter's Alessandro Bastoni and Liverpool with Barcelona left back Alejandro Balde, a possible 40 million euro move.
background: The report is a single-source rumour carried by ESPN's transfer roundup, not an official club statement.
footage_terms: Mateo Kovacic Manchester City best moments
member_headlines: Man City reportedly set to lose Mateo Kovacic at the end of the season

headline: Frank brings three coaches with him to Palace, two from his Brentford days
facts: Justin Cochrane joins as first-team coach; he worked with Frank at Brentford and Tottenham and currently works with England.
Chris Haslam joins as fitness and athletic performance coach after working with Frank at Brentford.
Bernardo Cueva joins from Chelsea, where he was set-piece coach, and also worked with Frank at Brentford.
background: Frank is already supported at Palace by coaches Paddy McCarthy and Andy Quy. Set pieces and defensive transitions are named by Frank as key areas to fix.
footage_terms: Chelsea set piece coach Bernardo Cueva
member_headlines: Frank brings three coaches with him to Palace, two from his Brentford days

headline: Barcelona renew interest in Brighton's Vuskovic as Real Madrid watch Chema
facts: Reports say Barcelona have renewed efforts to sign centre-back Luka Vuskovic; Bayern, Real Madrid and Liverpool are also watching him.
Real Madrid are reported to be monitoring midfielder Chema Andres as a possible return.
Brighton themselves are among clubs reported to be tracking Club Brugge winger Carlos Forbs and Monza striker Gustavo Varela.
background: Vuskovic was bought by Brighton from Tottenham for a reported 46 million pounds in the summer.
member_headlines: Barcelona renew interest in Brighton's Vuskovic as Real Madrid watch Chema

headline: Man United eye Everton's Branthwaite and Fulham's Bassey as Pochettino rebuilds the defence
facts: Per Sky Sports, United are considering Everton's Jarrad Branthwaite and Fulham's Calvin Bassey to strengthen their defence.
They are also monitoring Fulham left-back Antonee Robinson, who worked with Pochettino with the US national team.
Sky's January preview says Fulham could be forced into the market if United pursue Bassey, and they want a new contract for him.
background: Pochettino coached the USMNT before United appointed him head coach the week of 9 November after sacking Michael Carrick.
member_headlines: Man United eye Everton's Branthwaite and Fulham's Bassey as Pochettino rebuilds the defence

headline: Former West Ham striker Dylan Tombides' story is used to educate young players at the U17 World Cup
facts: Tombides' mother Tracy and brother Taylor, with the DT38 Foundation and FIFA Medical, talk to young players about regular self-examination.
They have spoken to around 1,200 players from 48 teams at this year's FIFA U17 World Cup in Doha.
Tombides was diagnosed with testicular cancer at the 2011 U17 World Cup and died in April 2014, aged 20.
background: Tombides was a West Ham striker and an Australian youth international.
member_headlines: Former West Ham striker Dylan Tombides' story is used to educate young players at the U17 World Cup

headline: Bournemouth boss Rose says he talks to Alex Scott every day amid Arsenal, Chelsea and Liverpool interest
facts: Rose said he speaks to Scott regularly about his future and believes Bournemouth is the best place for him to keep improving.
Sky's January preview says Bournemouth's window depends on selling Scott, who is wanted by Arsenal, Chelsea and Liverpool.
If Scott leaves, Bournemouth would look for a replacement midfielder.
background: Scott came through Bristol City and joined Bournemouth in 2023 as a teenage midfielder.
footage_terms: Marco Rose Alex Scott press conference
member_headlines: Bournemouth boss Rose says he talks to Alex Scott every day amid Arsenal, Chelsea and Liverpool interest

headline: Five Premier League clubs reportedly chase Club Brugge winger Carlos Forbs, 22
facts: TEAMtalk reports Villa, Newcastle, Brighton, Everton and Brentford are keen on Forbs before his fee rises.
Forbs took over Portugal's number 7 shirt after Cristiano Ronaldo retired from international football and impressed against Wales.
The report is a rumour and no bid has been confirmed.
background: Forbs, 22, plays for Club Brugge and is a Portugal international.
member_headlines: Five Premier League clubs reportedly chase Club Brugge winger Carlos Forbs, 22

headline: Barcelona revive interest in Brighton's 19-year-old defender Luka Vuskovic
facts: Barcelona have revived interest in Vuskovic, 19, as they look for a centre-back; Bayern, Real Madrid and Liverpool are also monitoring him.
ESPN's roundup says he cost Brighton 46 million pounds from Spurs.
A summer deal for Inter's Alessandro Bastoni collapsed when Hansi Flick prioritised other areas.
background: Brighton are second in the league and Sky's January preview says they are not expected to sell key players.
member_headlines: Barcelona revive interest in Brighton's 19-year-old defender Luka Vuskovic

headline: ESPN model rates newly promoted Coventry the most likely team to be relegated
facts: Ryan O'Hanlon's projection after 10 games puts Coventry 20th on 36.9 points, Palace 19th, Hull 18th, Sunderland 17th and Ipswich 16th.
Betting markets reportedly see Coventry as the most likely side to go down, and Hull and Sunderland are almost level in the model.
The table after 10 games had Palace bottom with seven points, Sunderland on eight, Manchester United on eight and Coventry on nine.
background: Coventry, Ipswich and Hull were promoted from the Championship last season.
footage_terms: Crystal Palace Hull Sunderland relegation fight
member_headlines: ESPN model rates newly promoted Coventry the most likely team to be relegated

headline: Port Vale boss braced for the sack but now has eight home wins in a row
facts: Port Vale have won eight home league games in a row and scored 17 goals in their last four matches.
Jon Brady said he expected to be sacked after a mid-September defeat to Walsall, when Vale were in the bottom three and had scored fewer than any other League Two side.
He switched to three at the back and moved Onel Hernandez into a forward role; Vale are 17th but third for expected goals since that Walsall game.
background: Brady, an Australian aged 51, was previously popular at Northampton; Port Vale were relegated from League One before this season, with about 80 per cent of the budget tied up in 18 contracted players.
footage_terms: Port Vale eight home wins in a row
member_headlines: Port Vale boss braced for the sack but now has eight home wins in a row

headline: Deco denies Barcelona want to push Balde out as Manchester United watch
facts: Deco denied that Barcelona are pushing left-back Alejandro Balde out and said there is no plan to sell him.
Balde has made five appearances this season for a total of 124 minutes.
Sky's Paper Talk reported on 27 September, citing Mundo Deportivo, that Manchester United were monitoring Balde, 22, for a possible January move.
background: Balde is a La Masia graduate who has been a regular in Barcelona's first team in recent seasons.
member_headlines: Deco denies Barcelona want to push Balde out as Manchester United watch

headline: Barcelona host Villarreal, a team that has beaten them often lately
facts: Barcelona face Villarreal at Spotify Camp Nou on Sunday 22 November, and have lost two of their last five against them, twice as many defeats as in the previous 29 meetings.
Those 29 earlier games brought 22 Barcelona wins, six draws and one loss; at home, Barcelona have lost three of the last five against Villarreal.
Villarreal are eighth in La Liga and 28th in the Champions League league phase, with new coach Inigo Perez, and have won only twice in eight away league games.
background: Since 2021-22, only Real Madrid have matched Villarreal's count of La Liga wins away at Barcelona.
member_headlines: Barcelona host Villarreal, a team that has beaten them often lately

headline: Inter eye Lazio's Provstgaard as John Stones struggles with fitness
facts: La Gazzetta dello Sport reports Inter are interested in Lazio defender Oliver Provstgaard, 23, whom Lazio value at about 40 million euros.
Inter could only afford that fee at the end of the season, not in January.
Stones has made four appearances this season after a thigh strain in mid-September and has just returned to training.
background: Inter signed England defender John Stones this summer after he agreed terms in July while Arsenal and Chelsea were also interested.
member_headlines: Inter eye Lazio's Provstgaard as John Stones struggles with fitness

headline: Conte explains why he joined Inter and why he walked out
facts: In teasers from a Cronache di Spogliatoio interview, Conte says Marotta and Steven Zhang asked him to end Inter's title drought and challenge Juventus.
He says Juventus hiring Maurizio Sarri pushed him towards Inter in 2019.
After winning the 2020-21 title he says he was told almost any player could be sold; Lukaku and Hakimi left the following window, and he says he would like to return to Juventus one day.
background: Conte won three Serie A titles with Juventus as coach, then won Inter's first title in eleven years in 2020-21 before leaving.
member_headlines: Conte explains why he joined Inter and why he walked out

headline: Juventus and Napoli eye Manchester United's Zirkzee in January
facts: Football Italia, citing Fabrizio Romano via IlNapolista, says Juventus and Napoli are considering a January move for Zirkzee.
Zirkzee has scored twice in ten appearances this season and Mauricio Pochettino replaced Michael Carrick as United manager the week before.
Juventus executive Frederic Massara is described as a key advocate; Bologna and Genoa are considering a loan.
background: Manchester United signed Zirkzee from Bologna for more than 40 million euros about two and a half years ago.
member_headlines: Juventus and Napoli eye Manchester United's Zirkzee in January

headline: Roma want Chelsea's Gittens and hope Malen can help persuade him
facts: Corriere dello Sport, relayed by Football Italia, says Roma want Gittens in January, possibly on loan with an option to buy.
Gittens has played 55 competitive minutes for Chelsea this season, all in two EFL Cup games; Roma could turn to Nottingham Forest's Hudson-Odoi if the deal fails.
Roma hope Malen, who spent about three and a half years at Dortmund with Gittens, can help persuade him.
background: Gittens cost Chelsea around 61 million euros with bonuses when he joined from Dortmund in summer 2025, and Malen joined Roma on a similar loan-with-option deal last January.
member_headlines: Roma want Chelsea's Gittens and hope Malen can help persuade him

headline: Conte says he left Inter after the 2021 title because of a broken plan and wants to return to Juventus one day
facts: In an interview Conte said Inter hired him in 2019 to end Juventus' dominance after Juventus chose Sarri instead of taking him back.
After the 2020-21 title he was told nearly any player could be sold; he felt the plan was broken and left, and Lukaku and Hakimi were sold afterwards.
He said he would like to return to Juventus one day to close the cycle.
background: Conte won the 2020-21 Serie A title with Inter and later coached Napoli before leaving by mutual consent this year.
member_headlines: Conte says he left Inter after the 2021 title because of a broken plan and wants to return to Juventus one day

headline: Milan reportedly eye McTominay as a new 50m-a-year Adidas deal lands
facts: Quotidiano Nazionale reports that Milan are interested in Napoli's McTominay.
Milan agreed a ten-year Adidas kit deal from 2028 worth 50m euros a season, which could fund a big signing.
McTominay's Napoli contract runs to June 2028 and he reportedly wants about 7m euros a year.
background: McTominay is an Adidas testimonial athlete, which the report links to the possible move.
footage_terms: McTominay Napoli Roma long range goal
member_headlines: Milan reportedly eye McTominay as a new 50m-a-year Adidas deal lands

headline: Kompany returns to the Bayern touchline for Cologne after five games away
facts: Kompany is set to coach Bayern against Cologne on 20 November after missing five games; he says his tests are clear.
Under Danks Bayern stayed unbeaten across those five games, including a 2-0 win at Atletico Madrid that Kompany called a highlight of his coaching career.
Bundesliga.com notes he still wore a sling for a shoulder injury at Thursday's press conference.
background: Kompany captained Manchester City under Pep Guardiola, who now praises him as a natural coach.
footage_terms: Kompany return Bayern Cologne press conference
member_headlines: Kompany returns to the Bayern touchline for Cologne after five games away

headline: Bayern's Karl and Cologne's El Mala: Germany's rising stars meet
facts: Karl scored 5 goals and gave 4 assists in 24 Bundesliga games last season and made his Germany debut against Switzerland in March 2026.
A muscle injury in June cost him the 2026 World Cup.
El Mala was released by Gladbach as a youth, played for TSV Meerbusch and Viktoria Cologne, and now wears Cologne's number 10.
background: Karl made his Bundesliga debut at 17 years and 181 days and first played for Bayern's senior team at the 2025 Club World Cup.
member_headlines: Bayern's Karl and Cologne's El Mala: Germany's rising stars meet

headline: Miroslav Klose has Nuernberg second in the 2. Bundesliga and praises Fuellkrug and Kane
facts: Nuernberg are second with 24 goals scored in ten games, and Klose credits team spirit, tough competition for places and trust in young players.
He says a team still needs a striker who scores and calls Harry Kane a role model for young players.
He also praises Niclas Fullkrug's current form.
background: Klose has coached Nuernberg since June 2024; as a player he won the 2014 World Cup with Germany at 36 and played for Kaiserslautern, Werder Bremen, Bayern Munich and five years at Lazio.
footage_terms: Miroslav Klose all goals World Cup
member_headlines: Miroslav Klose has Nuernberg second in the 2. Bundesliga and praises Fuellkrug and Kane

headline: Schalke's crisis: 17th place, six points, five goals and Bayern interest in Karius
facts: Schalke are 17th with six points from nine games and only five goals scored; only nine of 23 shots in the latest game hit the target.
Coach Miron Muslic's more attacking approach is seen as the right move, but the team needs a centre-forward and a creative midfielder, and Leverkusen defender Tim Oermann is reportedly a loan option.
Karius reportedly attracted Bayern interest, but chief executive Matthias Tillmann said being number one at Schalke beats being a backup elsewhere.
background: Schalke are back in the Bundesliga after promotion last season under Muslic, and host Stuttgart on Saturday.
member_headlines: Schalke's crisis: 17th place, six points, five goals and Bayern interest in Karius

headline: US Soccer scrambles for a new coach as Emma Hayes joins the hiring committee and Arena says they have no clue
facts: USWNT coach Emma Hayes will act as a technical advisor in the search for Pochettino's successor.
CEO J.T. Batson and COO Dan Helfrich lead the search; Pep Guardiola is seen as an obvious but uncertain target while on sabbatical.
U23 coach Steve Cherundolo will run the 13 December friendly against Jamaica meanwhile.
Former US coach Bruce Arena (San Jose boss) said the federation does not have a clue what it is doing, per ESPN on 18 November.
background: Arena coached the US national team in two separate spells and now manages the San Jose Earthquakes.
member_headlines: US Soccer scrambles for a new coach as Emma Hayes joins the hiring committee and Arena says they have no clue

headline: Judge rejects FIFA bid to block UEFA from World Cup stake-sale documents
facts: UEFA's Ceferin and other FIFA council members demanded a full response on documents about the failed 20 billion dollar plan to sell World Cup commercial rights.
FIFA said UEFA must accept strict review protocols at its Zurich office before seeing key documents.
On 12 November a Manhattan judge rejected FIFA subsidiaries' bid to block UEFA's evidence requests to Thrive and JP Morgan.
The aborted deal offered 4.2 billion dollars for a 20% stake in FIFA's tournament unit and 20 million dollars to each of 211 federations.
background: The plan was dropped after global backlash, and UEFA is also reported to be preparing a Swiss criminal complaint.
footage_terms: UEFA FIFA World Cup stake sale Infantino
FIFA investors Thrive Kushner World Cup
member_headlines: Judge rejects FIFA bid to block UEFA from World Cup stake-sale documents

headline: Palace boss Thomas Frank is fine with McCarthy doubling as Ireland first-team coach
facts: Thomas Frank was appointed Crystal Palace manager on 16 November after Pierre Sage was sacked.
Assistant Paddy McCarthy also works as Ireland's first-team coach and Frank is keeping that dual role.
McCarthy missed an Ireland recovery session to join Palace in London, then flew back to watch Ireland beat Kosovo.
Frank said there is no problem with the arrangement.
background: McCarthy is a retired centre-back and Palace club legend.
footage_terms: Thomas Frank Crystal Palace appointed press conference
member_headlines: Palace boss Thomas Frank is fine with McCarthy doubling as Ireland first-team coach

headline: Vinicius Junior stays at Real Madrid but looks short of form after a summer of transfer talk
facts: ESPN says Arsenal were the most prominent suitor in a summer of heavy speculation over his future.
Vinicius admitted he trained less than usual and that offers and contract talks distracted him.
He has one goal for Real Madrid this season, after a four-game suspension for pulling Villarreal player Nathan Saliba's hair, but scored five in two Brazil friendlies in November.
background: Vinicius has played for Real Madrid since 2018 and is one of their biggest stars. Real Madrid's club-record signing Yan Diomande, at EUR 125m, now competes with him for the left wing.
footage_terms: Vinicius Junior Brazil hat trick Singapore
Real Madrid Vinicius Villarreal red card
member_headlines: Vinicius Junior stays at Real Madrid but looks short of form after a summer of transfer talk

headline: Vinicius Junior back from ban as Mourinho says he is not at 100 percent after summer transfer saga
facts: Arsenal were among clubs chasing Vinicius in the summer while Madrid debated a renewal.
Mourinho says he is not at 100 percent and the player admitted he prepared badly and trained less than usual in the break.
He served a four-game ban for pulling Villarreal's Nathan Saliba by the hair, has one Madrid goal this season, but scored five in two Brazil friendlies including a hat-trick against Singapore.
background: Vinicius has been at Real Madrid since 2018 and won the Champions League with the club. Ancelotti, who coached him at Madrid, now coaches Brazil.
member_headlines: Vinicius Junior back from ban as Mourinho says he is not at 100 percent after summer transfer saga

headline: McTominay wants about EUR 7m a year as Napoli talks stall and Milan watch
facts: His Napoli contract runs to June 2028 but no new deal is agreed because he reportedly wants about EUR 7m a season.
Real Madrid and Manchester United are monitoring; Milan hope the impasse helps them.
Adidas is reported to return as Milan kit supplier from 2028-29 in a deal near EUR 500m over 10 years, and McTominay is an Adidas ambassador.
background: McTominay left Manchester United for Napoli, after growing up in United's academy and playing for Scotland.
member_headlines: McTominay wants about EUR 7m a year as Napoli talks stall and Milan watch

headline: Arsenal join race for Bournemouth's Alex Scott as sales would be needed
facts: Arsenal reportedly entered the race after Bournemouth softened on a sale; Liverpool are said to lead, partly due to manager Andoni Iraola.
Scott's contract runs to 2028 and Transfermarkt values him at EUR 70m; other reports cite about 100m pounds.
Arsenal would need to sell a midfielder such as Merino or Zubimendi to make room.
background: Scott moved from Bristol City to Bournemouth and won his first England cap this season.
member_headlines: Arsenal join race for Bournemouth's Alex Scott as sales would be needed

headline: Bayern open to offers for Kim Min-jae with Premier League clubs linked
facts: Bayern are reportedly open to offers for the centre-back.
Tottenham, Arsenal, Aston Villa, AC Milan and Fenerbahce are all linked.
background: Kim is a South Korea defender who joined Bayern from Napoli in 2023.
member_headlines: Bayern open to offers for Kim Min-jae with Premier League clubs linked

headline: Lukaku could be offered Anderlecht return in January
facts: ESPN's roundup says Anderlecht could try to re-sign the Fenerbahce striker in January.
background: Lukaku began his career at Anderlecht and is Belgium's record scorer.
member_headlines: Lukaku could be offered Anderlecht return in January

headline: Julian Alvarez at centre of Arsenal, Man United and Barcelona chase
facts: Goal says Arsenal staff reportedly met Alvarez and his agents in Madrid and a formal offer could come in January.
Atletico's president Cerezo reportedly blocked a Barcelona move and Atletico reportedly want a huge fee.
FourFourTwo reports Pochettino asked United about Alvarez, but finances may not allow a January deal.
background: Alvarez left Manchester City for Atletico Madrid and scored 29 goals in his first season under Simeone.
member_headlines: Julian Alvarez at centre of Arsenal, Man United and Barcelona chase

headline: Balde in limbo at Barcelona as Man United and Juventus linked
facts: The 23-year-old has made five appearances, all as a substitute, behind Cancelo and Espart.
Deco says he will not be sold unless he asks to leave; ESPN lists a possible EUR 40m permanent deal and Juventus loan interest.
He has 173 Barcelona appearances and seven trophies.
background: Balde joined Barcelona aged eight and debuted in 2021.
member_headlines: Balde in limbo at Barcelona as Man United and Juventus linked

headline: Barcelona reportedly reject free transfer of Lisandro Martinez
facts: Agent Pedro Bravo says he offered the defender to Deco, who declined.
Deco reportedly said he does not fit Barcelona's needs; his contract runs to summer 2027.
Barcelona want a left-footed centre-back who can also cover at full-back.
background: Martinez won the World Cup with Argentina and joined United from Ajax in 2022.
member_headlines: Barcelona reportedly reject free transfer of Lisandro Martinez

headline: Valencia reportedly ask about Ter Stegen as Barcelona still pay 90 percent of his Ajax wages
facts: Barcelona reportedly pay 90 percent of his wages while he is on loan at Ajax; his Barcelona deal runs to 2028.
Valencia's sporting director Braulio Vazquez has reportedly asked about his availability; Valencia would likely need to cover far more wages than Ajax do.
Pitchwise Holdings bought a 42 percent stake from Peter Lim's Meriton Holdings, still awaiting approval.
background: Ter Stegen, 34, is the German goalkeeper who is first choice at Ajax but not in Hansi Flick's long-term plans at Barcelona.
member_headlines: Valencia reportedly ask about Ter Stegen as Barcelona still pay 90 percent of his Ajax wages

headline: Atletico reportedly demand about 500 million euros for Julian Alvarez as Arsenal meet his camp
facts: Atletico reportedly want about 500 million euros to let Alvarez go.
Barcelona were his preferred destination but president Enrique Cerezo refused to strengthen a direct rival.
Arsenal representatives reportedly met him and his agents in Madrid and could bid in January with a higher salary.
background: Alvarez is an Argentine forward who left Manchester City for Atletico Madrid in 2025.
member_headlines: Atletico reportedly demand about 500 million euros for Julian Alvarez as Arsenal meet his camp

headline: Juventus confirm youngster Augusto Owusu extension to 2031
facts: The midfielder, born in 2005, signed until 30 June 2031.
He made his first-team debut on 17 September 2026 in the Europa League against NEC.
He has 59 appearances for Juventus Next Gen.
background: Owusu came through the Juventus academy, went out on loan in 2022-23, then played for the Primavera and Next Gen teams.
member_headlines: Juventus confirm youngster Augusto Owusu extension to 2031

headline: Pochettino's US contract extension had a release clause that cleared the way to United
facts: His August extension with the US team included a release clause and his representatives told United about it.
He is on a two-year deal at United according to the article; no compensation figure is given.
United sacked Carrick about 15 games into his permanent job; Pochettino's first game is at Liverpool on Sunday.
background: Pochettino was in charge of the US team until the World Cup round-of-16 loss to Belgium in early July 2026.
member_headlines: Pochettino's US contract extension had a release clause that cleared the way to United

headline: Barcelona and Real Madrid chase Brighton's Luka Vuskovic, 46 million pounds in the summer
facts: The 19-year-old centre-back's Brighton contract runs to June 2031.
ESPN says Brighton signed him from Tottenham for 46 million pounds this summer.
Brighton are expected to listen to offers at the end of the season for a substantial fee.
background: Vuskovic is a young Croatian centre-back described in the press as the new Rodri.
member_headlines: Barcelona and Real Madrid chase Brighton's Luka Vuskovic, 46 million pounds in the summer

headline: Vinicius Junior's summer saga: Madrid's club-record 125 million euro signing Diomande now competes with him
facts: Diomande was signed for a club-record 125 million euros and competes with Vinicius for the left wing.
Vinicius was heavily linked with a summer move to Arsenal and has said the offers and contract talks distracted him.
He has one league goal for Madrid this season but five for Brazil in November friendlies, including a hat trick against Singapore.
background: Vinicius is Real Madrid's Brazilian winger; the club coach this season is Jose Mourinho per ESPN.
footage_terms: Vinicius Junior Brazil hat trick Singapore
member_headlines: Vinicius Junior's summer saga: Madrid's club-record 125 million euro signing Diomande now competes with him

headline: Barcelona's Alejandro Balde: wanted by United and Liverpool, 40 million euros mentioned, Deco says no sale
facts: ESPN reports a possible exit at around 40 million euros with Barcelona preferring a permanent sale to a loan; Juventus are keen on a loan.
Deco says Barcelona are not looking to sell unless the player asks to leave.
All five of Balde's appearances this season were as a substitute; Goal says he has 173 appearances since 2021.
background: Balde is a left-back and Barcelona academy graduate.
member_headlines: Barcelona's Alejandro Balde: wanted by United and Liverpool, 40 million euros mentioned, Deco says no sale

headline: Manchester United weigh a 40 million euro bid for Marseille's Hojbjerg
facts: ESPN's roundup says United could offer 40 million euros for the 31-year-old midfielder.
Juventus are also interested, and the United move may depend on whether Weston McKennie goes the other way.
Barcelona are also reported to be revisiting Alejandro Balde as a United target.
background: Hojbjerg, 31, is a Danish midfielder now at Marseille.
member_headlines: Manchester United weigh a 40 million euro bid for Marseille's Hojbjerg

headline: River Plate's Montiel sent off in the Superclasico; ban cut from three to two matches on appeal
facts: Montiel was sent off in the second half of the Superclasico, which River lost; referee Nicolas Ramirez reported a foul on Lautaro Blanco as serious foul play.
The AFA disciplinary tribunal first gave three matches, then cut it to two after appeal; he missed the win over Aldosivi and will miss the Clausura round-of-16 tie against Lanus.
River felt the punishment was excessive and pointed out that Blanco was not sent off for a similar foul on Tobias Andrada.
background: The River-Boca Superclasico is Argentina's biggest fixture, and Montiel is a World Cup winner with Argentina in 2022.
member_headlines: River Plate's Montiel sent off in the Superclasico; ban cut from three to two matches on appeal

headline: NWSL has record money, but stadiums, travel and pay problems persist
facts: Most NWSL teams are tenants in venues controlled by men's teams; Gotham moved a semifinal to 5,000-seat Icahn Stadium due to field conditions, and a college football game disrupted Washington's semifinal at Audi Field.
All but one team has changed owners in six years, and Columbus paid 205 million dollars for expansion, about 100 times the fee six years ago.
Charter travel could cost up to 50 million dollars in the short term, based on the WNBA's estimate.
background: The NWSL expands in 2028 with Atlanta and Columbus, each sharing ownership with an MLS club that controls its venue.
member_headlines: NWSL has record money, but stadiums, travel and pay problems persist

headline: Raya has seven clean sheets in ten games and has not conceded a saveable goal
facts: Raya has kept seven clean sheets in ten Premier League games and is the only keeper yet to concede a saveable goal, per Gradient Sports.
Emiliano Martinez has conceded three saveable goals, Alisson four and Donnarumma five.
He has caught 13 crosses, the most of any keeper, and is a three-time Golden Glove winner.
background: Raya has made 117 Premier League appearances for Arsenal, keeping clean sheets in nearly half of them.
footage_terms: Arsenal goalkeeper Raya best in Premier League
member_headlines: Raya has seven clean sheets in ten games and has not conceded a saveable goal

headline: Arsenal top the table five points clear, with only one defeat this season
facts: Sky says Arsenal have won every game this season except a 3-0 defeat at Brighton in September.
They are five points clear at the top and visit Newcastle on Saturday.
Newcastle have won one of their five home league games.
background: Arsenal are managed by Mikel Arteta and dropped Manchester City from top spot after City's recent defeats.
member_headlines: Arsenal top the table five points clear, with only one defeat this season

headline: Liverpool conceded a record 53 league goals last season; Iraola tries to fix defence
facts: Under Arne Slot Liverpool conceded 53 league goals in 2025-26, their most ever in a 38-game Premier League season.
Iraola replaced Slot in June and Liverpool have conceded from set pieces only twice so far this season.
Since Ronald Araujo moved into defence in September they have conceded only three league goals with 11 men on the pitch.
background: Liverpool won the league in 2024-25 but finished fifth last season, 24 points fewer.
member_headlines: Liverpool conceded a record 53 league goals last season; Iraola tries to fix defence

headline: Bournemouth equal club record with eight straight wins in all competitions
facts: Bournemouth have won four league games in a row and eight in all competitions, equalling a club record.
Marco Rose has been in charge for 16 games.
They host Nottingham Forest on Saturday.
background: Bournemouth were previously managed by Andoni Iraola, who left for Liverpool in the summer.
member_headlines: Bournemouth equal club record with eight straight wins in all competitions

headline: Haaland scores three for Norway in the break while City suffer three straight league defeats
facts: Haaland scored a penalty in Norway's 3-1 win over Wales and a late winner in a 3-2 comeback win over Denmark, sending Norway into the Nations League quarter-finals.
City have lost three straight Premier League games and host Fulham on Saturday.
Maresca named Haaland one of four club captains alongside Ruben Dias, Marc Guehi and Gianluigi Donnarumma.
background: Haaland, 26, is in his fifth season at City after joining from Borussia Dortmund in 2022.
member_headlines: Haaland scores three for Norway in the break while City suffer three straight league defeats

headline: Real Madrid and Barcelona fight for Brighton centre-back Luka Vuskovic, 'the new Rodri'
facts: Goal, citing El Desmarque, says the 19-year-old Croatia centre-back is wanted by both Spanish giants.
Barcelona reportedly tried to sign him; Real Madrid are taking a less direct route.
Brighton are expected to listen to offers at the end of the season and could demand a huge sum.
His Brighton contract runs to June 2031.
background: Vuskovic is a Croatia international centre-back at Brighton, whose contract runs to June 2031.
member_headlines: Real Madrid and Barcelona fight for Brighton centre-back Luka Vuskovic, 'the new Rodri'

headline: Veron says Como's Nico Paz does things he has only seen Messi and Maradona do
facts: In a Gazzetta dello Sport interview, Veron said that at 22 Paz does things he has only seen Messi and Maradona do, though he did not say Paz would reach their level.
Paz has 6 goals and 8 assists in 14 Como games this season and 5 goals in 5 games for Argentina.
Veron warned that comparisons with legends have hurt many young Argentine No. 10s.
He said Paz and Franco Mastantuono could be Argentina's future playmakers.
background: Paz scored 12 goals with 7 assists for Como last season.
footage_terms: Veron interview Nico Paz Messi Maradona
member_headlines: Veron says Como's Nico Paz does things he has only seen Messi and Maradona do

headline: Chelsea's Valentin Barco says he can give 'a lot more' despite limited minutes
facts: The 22-year-old said he believes he has much more to offer and wants to earn playing time at Chelsea.
He has had limited minutes under Xabi Alonso and has struggled to become a regular since joining Chelsea last summer.
He was in Argentina's World Cup squad that finished runners-up to Spain but missed the recent friendlies against Uruguay and Costa Rica.
background: Barco is signed through 2033 after strong performances at Strasbourg; he made only seven appearances at Brighton.
member_headlines: Chelsea's Valentin Barco says he can give 'a lot more' despite limited minutes

headline: What the football world looked like at the last GTA release: peak Messi vs Ronaldo, and now Kane
facts: ESPN's Chris Wright compares the game in 2013, when GTA V came out, with 2026: Messi had four Ballons d'Or to Ronaldo's two then, and now has eight to Ronaldo's five.
Both have now retired from international football; Messi chases a second MLS title at Inter Miami and Ronaldo is nearing 1,000 career goals at Al Nassr.
Manchester United have had seven permanent managers since 2013 and have now appointed Mauricio Pochettino, while Mourinho is back at Real Madrid.
background: GTA V was released in September 2013, a 13-year gap before GTA VI, per ESPN.
member_headlines: What the football world looked like at the last GTA release: peak Messi vs Ronaldo, and now Kane

headline: Gremio and Internacional both stuck in the relegation zone with three rounds left
facts: ESPN's Opta-based odds give Gremio about a 73% and Internacional about a 59% chance of going down, with Gremio on 38 points after a 0-0 home draw with Bahia.
Chapecoense are already relegated and Remo are about 99.98% likely to follow.
Corinthians eased their own danger with a 4-0 win over Botafogo and now carry roughly an 19% relegation chance.
background: Gremio and Internacional are the two big Porto Alegre clubs whose derby is the Gre-Nal; ESPN's headline calls them the 'GreNal duo'.
footage_terms: Vasco Internacional Sao Januario melhores momentos
member_headlines: Gremio and Internacional both stuck in the relegation zone with three rounds left

headline: Libertadores final set: Estudiantes against Palmeiras in Montevideo on 28 November
facts: Palmeiras president Leila Pereira said the club's full focus is the Libertadores and Copa do Brasil, summing it up as 'nothing else matters'.
The Libertadores final against Estudiantes is on 28 November at the Centenario in Montevideo.
Palmeiras reached the final by beating Fluminense 5-3 on penalties after the semifinal finished level on aggregate.
background: Brazilian clubs have won the last seven Libertadores titles; the last non-Brazilian winner was River Plate in the all-Argentine 2018 final.
member_headlines: Libertadores final set: Estudiantes against Palmeiras in Montevideo on 28 November

headline: Botafogo keep Tite after a 4-0 loss but call the Sao Paulo game a final
facts: After the 4-0 home defeat to Corinthians on 18 November the board decided not to sack Tite, though some inside the club reportedly wanted a change.
Leadership, the SAF board, staff and players met at the training ground on 19 November and demanded a 'sense of urgency'.
The home game against Sao Paulo on 23 November is being treated as a final for staying in Serie A and chasing a continental place.
background: Tite is a former Brazil national team coach who now leads Botafogo.
member_headlines: Botafogo keep Tite after a 4-0 loss but call the Sao Paulo game a final

headline: Pochettino leaves the US job to take over 18th-placed Manchester United
facts: Pochettino left his US head coach role during the international break to replace Michael Carrick and says he sleeps only three or four hours a day preparing for the trip to Liverpool.
United are 18th with one win in 10 league games, their lowest total at this stage since 1986-87, and have no clean sheet this season.
He has not won any of his last eight meetings with Liverpool across his spells at Tottenham and Chelsea.
background: Pochettino is an Argentine coach who previously managed Tottenham and Chelsea; Opta gives Liverpool a 57.3% chance in the match.
footage_terms: Liverpool vs Manchester United Pochettino preview
member_headlines: Pochettino leaves the US job to take over 18th-placed Manchester United

headline: Cincinnati knock out Orlando in MLS wild card; Daryl Dike hurt after coming on
facts: FC Cincinnati beat Orlando City 3-1 in the MLS playoff wild card; Martin Ojeda scored first for Orlando, then Evander and Samuel Gidi scored for Cincinnati.
Daryl Dike came on in the 75th minute and was hurt soon after; the interim coach suspected a hamstring problem, and Orlando had no subs left.
Orlando's season ended in Antoine Griezmann's first year at the club; Cincinnati now face Nashville SC in a best-of-three.
background: Dike has a long injury record: a season-ending hamstring injury in 2022 and Achilles ruptures in both legs in 2023 and 2024.
footage_terms: Orlando City vs FC Cincinnati wild card highlights
member_headlines: Cincinnati knock out Orlando in MLS wild card; Daryl Dike hurt after coming on

headline: Real Salt Lake beat Seattle on penalties as keeper Rafael Cabral is the hero
facts: The West wild card ended 1-1 after 90 minutes at Lumen Field, with Albert Rusnak scoring for Seattle and Morgan Guilavogui equalizing for RSL.
RSL won the shootout 4-2; keeper Rafael Cabral saved from Dejan Joveljic and Rusnak, and Philip Quinton scored the winning kick.
RSL, the No. 9 seed, now face No. 1 seed Vancouver Whitecaps in a best-of-three, even after losing their two best players during the season.
background: Seattle Sounders are one of MLS's most decorated clubs and have been regular playoff qualifiers, so an exit in the wild card round is a rare early end.
footage_terms: Real Salt Lake Seattle Sounders penalty shootout highlights
Rafael Cabral saves Seattle wild card
member_headlines: Real Salt Lake beat Seattle on penalties as keeper Rafael Cabral is the hero

headline: NWSL commissioner Berman 'frustrated' by playoff venue chaos
facts: Gotham moved its semifinal to the 5,000-seat Icahn Stadium after deeming its usual home field unsafe.
Washington's semifinal at Audi Field had yellow soccer lines painted over white football lines because of a double booking.
Berman said the league is working on solutions and that teams need more control over their stadiums.
Gotham plans to move to Etihad Park in 2028.
background: The NWSL has grown fast in money and ownership, but many clubs still rent stadiums controlled by MLS clubs or others.
footage_terms: NWSL playoff venue Icahn Stadium Gotham
member_headlines: NWSL commissioner Berman 'frustrated' by playoff venue chaos

headline: Leicester drop crypto-casino shirt sponsor after adult-star ambassador row
facts: Leicester and BC.GAME ended the shirt deal with immediate effect, citing differing commercial priorities.
Fans had objected after BC.GAME named an adult film star as a brand ambassador; the Foxes Trust said 73% of fans felt negative.
Leicester play Huddersfield with no sponsor on the shirt, and replica shirt buyers since 21 October can get a refund.
background: BC.GAME had been on Leicester shirts for about two and a half years, and Leicester are now playing in League One, where they sit 11th.
member_headlines: Leicester drop crypto-casino shirt sponsor after adult-star ambassador row

headline: Mbeumo's GTA VI loading-screen post triggers Goldbridge rant
facts: Mbeumo posted a photo of the GTA VI loading screen with the caption 'Historique' in the early hours of 19 November.
On The United Stand, Goldbridge said players with training next morning should not be gaming late and called for United to sell Mbeumo.
Goldbridge admitted the post might have been scheduled earlier or posted by someone else.
background: Mbeumo is a United forward, and Goldbridge is a well-known United fan-channel presenter.
member_headlines: Mbeumo's GTA VI loading-screen post triggers Goldbridge rant

headline: Pochettino's first Man Utd interview: players must relearn the feeling of winning
facts: Pochettino said his first job is to help players regain the winning feeling, and that it needs concrete changes across the club, not just talk.
He wants players to express their talent and said pressure should create energy rather than weigh them down.
United are 18th with one league win all season, their worst start in 40 years, and he signed a contract until 2029.
background: Pochettino, 54, led Tottenham to the 2019 Champions League final and replaces Michael Carrick, who was sacked after the Bournemouth defeat.
member_headlines: Pochettino's first Man Utd interview: players must relearn the feeling of winning

headline: Kompany returns to the Bayern bench after collapse at training, says he is in good health
facts: Kompany collapsed at a reserve-team training session on 23 October and was treated for meningeal irritation; he returns for the Cologne game on 20 November.
He missed five games, in which assistant Aaron Danks led Bayern to five unbeaten, including a 2-0 win over Atletico Madrid.
He said all test results are clear and that he rethought how he listens to his body after returning for the Arsenal game while fighting a viral infection.
background: Kompany, a former Manchester City captain, took charge of Bayern in 2024 after managing Burnley, and Bayern now lead the Bundesliga level with Dortmund.
member_headlines: Kompany returns to the Bayern bench after collapse at training, says he is in good health

headline: Pochettino tells United players to relearn how to win as club sits 18th
facts: United are 18th with one league win and eight league games without a win.
It is their worst start to a season in 40 years, one point behind 17th-placed Coventry.
Pochettino, 54, said belief must come back through hard work and told players to treat pressure as energy.
background: Pochettino has been named in United talks for ten years; his previous job was national team coach of the United States.
footage_terms: Pochettino Man United players must relearn winning
member_headlines: Pochettino tells United players to relearn how to win as club sits 18th

headline: GTA VI finally lands, and ESPN shows how different football was when GTA V came out in 2013
facts: GTA V launched in September 2013 and GTA VI came out in November 2026, a 13-year wait.
In 2013 Messi had four Ballon d'Ors (now eight) and Ronaldo two (now five); Ronaldo is now near 1,000 career goals at Al Nassr.
United have had seven permanent managers since 2013, the latest being Pochettino.
background: Sir Alex Ferguson retired in 2013 and David Moyes took over a United team that were the reigning Premier League champions. Harry Kane had only just scored his first senior goal for Tottenham.
member_headlines: GTA VI finally lands, and ESPN shows how different football was when GTA V came out in 2013

headline: Spirit and Current meet in NWSL Championship as Rodman chases a full-circle moment
facts: The 13th NWSL Championship is at Audi Field in Washington on Saturday, the Spirit's fifth final, tying a league record.
Rodman called a win a full-circle moment after last year's contract saga; the Spirit won their only title in 2021 when she was a rookie.
The Spirit lost finals in 2024 to Orlando and 2025 to Gotham; Kansas City's only previous final was a 2022 loss to Portland.
background: Audi Field also hosted the Current's 2022 final defeat against the Portland Thorns.
footage_terms: Washington Spirit Kansas City Current NWSL final
member_headlines: Spirit and Current meet in NWSL Championship as Rodman chases a full-circle moment

headline: Saka out about another month with a thigh problem while Saliba is finally fit again
facts: Arteta said Saka needs roughly four more weeks; he hurt his left thigh early in the 21 October Champions League draw with Bayern Munich.
Saliba has been out since the World Cup with a back injury, has played two practice matches and is fit; Arteta plans to build his minutes slowly.
Arsenal lead the Premier League by five points after 10 games.
background: Arsenal won the 2025/26 Premier League title, and Saliba and Gabriel were the centre-back pair in that season, per Sky.
footage_terms: Arteta press conference Saka injury update
member_headlines: Saka out about another month with a thigh problem while Saliba is finally fit again

headline: Joao Pedro still out as Chelsea struggle to score without him
facts: Alonso said Joao Pedro is not fit and is not part of training before the Leeds match on Saturday.
Sky's analysis says Chelsea scored only two goals in the four league games he has missed.
Sky ranked him ninth in its Premier League top 25 and credits him with 20 league goals and 28 goal involvements since the start of last season.
background: Joao Pedro has five goals and three assists in six league starts this season, per Sky.
member_headlines: Joao Pedro still out as Chelsea struggle to score without him

headline: Isak leads Liverpool with seven league goals and is the most-owned Liverpool player in FPL
facts: Isak has seven Premier League goals, the team high, and only one player scored more in the first ten matches.
He is in 25.6% of FPL teams, and 526,590 managers brought him in before the Gameweek 10 deadline.
ESPN also names him Liverpool's second-most important player after Van Dijk.
background: Isak scored in Liverpool's 3-1 win at Crystal Palace on 8 November, and Wirtz and Barcola also scored or assisted in that match.
member_headlines: Isak leads Liverpool with seven league goals and is the most-owned Liverpool player in FPL

headline: Berrada: Fernandes has turned down two contract offers, Pochettino says he stays captain
facts: Sky Sports News reported that Bruno Fernandes has rejected two contract offers and his deal expires at the end of this season; Berrada said talks continue privately.
Pochettino said Fernandes is the captain and a very important player, and deferred questions on a new contract.
ESPN notes United hold an option for a one-year extension to 2028, and that Fernandes had criticised Carrick's tactics in Carrick's final weeks.
background: Fernandes is 32, has been United's captain and top performer, and was ranked No. 1 in Sky Sports' Premier League top 25 in March before sliding to 11th.
member_headlines: Berrada: Fernandes has turned down two contract offers, Pochettino says he stays captain

headline: Berrada admits third coach in under three seasons, 18th place 'unacceptable', £163m spent in summer
facts: Berrada said three permanent managers in less than three seasons (ten Hag, Amorim, Carrick) shows instability, and the third straight season with a mid-season coach change.
