United spent £163m this summer, mainly on midfielders Baleba, Tielemans and Santos; Berrada said a left-back like Newcastle's Lewis Hall was considered but not chased at inflated prices.
He said the Glazer and INEOS co-ownership is working well, and that he had no involvement in Manchester City's alleged wrongdoing from his time there.
background: Berrada was chief operating officer at Manchester City from 2016 and worked at City Football Group until 2024 before joining United.
member_headlines: Berrada admits third coach in under three seasons, 18th place 'unacceptable', £163m spent in summer

headline: Pochettino squad audit: Rashford on £325k a week, Mount with four full league games since 2023
facts: ESPN's Mark Ogden puts Fernandes and Rashford (29, highest earner at £325,000 a week) in the 'go' column; United failed to move Rashford in the last two summers after loans to Aston Villa and Barcelona.
Mount is on contract until 2028 and has completed four 90-minute Premier League games since 2023 with 71 games missed to injury; De Ligt has 343 days out injured since his €45m signing in 2024.
Sesko (€85m) is described as unlikely to recoup his fee; Shaw and Martinez are both out of contract soon.
background: Pochettino inherited a squad built by six previous managers, going back to Louis van Gaal's signing of Luke Shaw in 2014.
member_headlines: Pochettino squad audit: Rashford on £325k a week, Mount with four full league games since 2023

headline: JJ Gabriel, 16, leaving Man Utd amid Real Madrid interest, club annoyed at how he announced it
facts: Berrada said the 16-year-old JJ Gabriel is leaving United amid interest from Real Madrid.
He said the club was unhappy that the player announced his departure without informing United first.
background: United have a history of losing top academy teenagers to bigger clubs, and Berrada is the CEO trying to stabilise recruitment.
member_headlines: JJ Gabriel, 16, leaving Man Utd amid Real Madrid interest, club annoyed at how he announced it

headline: Osimhen reportedly on Man Utd's radar for January under Pochettino, but no release clause
facts: Goal, citing The Sun and Turkish sources, says United are interested again and Osimhen would accept wages close to his current deal.
Osimhen is 27 and under contract at Galatasaray until June 2029 with no release clause; Turkish sources value him at £80m to £100m.
Sesko and Zirkzee have scored four goals combined this season. Neither club has confirmed talks.
background: Osimhen scored 37 goals in his first season after joining Galatasaray permanently and 22 the following season.
member_headlines: Osimhen reportedly on Man Utd's radar for January under Pochettino, but no release clause

headline: Moyes set to pass Harry Catterick's Everton games record at Brentford
facts: Brentford away on Monday 23 November will be Moyes' 593rd match as Everton manager, passing Harry Catterick on the club's all-time list.
Captain James Tarkowski and former midfielder Leon Osman presented Moyes with a signed commemorative frame.
Osman said he doubts the record will ever be beaten.
background: Moyes first managed Everton from 2002 to 2013 and returned in January 2025, when the club were 16th.
footage_terms: David Moyes Everton record press conference
member_headlines: Moyes set to pass Harry Catterick's Everton games record at Brentford

headline: Brentford without Hickey and Collins for weeks as both are hurt on international duty
facts: Aaron Hickey has a hamstring injury and Nathan Collins a knee injury, both picked up on international duty.
Head coach Keith Andrews says both will be out for a number of weeks, with Collins about two weeks.
Brentford host Everton on Monday 23 November at 8pm GMT; Thiago is suspended and Rico Henry and Kaye Furo remain out.
background: Hickey plays for Scotland, and Collins captained Brentford in the Carabao Cup tie at Sunderland.
member_headlines: Brentford without Hickey and Collins for weeks as both are hurt on international duty

headline: Hull beat Middlesbrough in the play-off final after Southampton were thrown out over Spygate
facts: Eckert signed a new Southampton deal to 2029 on 20 November despite the Spygate scandal over secretly filming opponents' training.
Southampton lost four points this season after admitting three breaches of EFL regulations and were removed from the play-off final in May; their appeal failed.
Eckert received a suspended six-week ban and a fine from the FA; Southampton are unbeaten in 17 home league games and five points off the top.
background: Middlesbrough complained to the EFL in May that a Southampton staff member spied on their training; Middlesbrough then lost the final to Hull City.
footage_terms: Hull City play-off final promotion Middlesbrough
member_headlines: Hull beat Middlesbrough in the play-off final after Southampton were thrown out over Spygate

headline: Courtois extends Real Madrid contract to 2028
facts: Real Madrid confirmed Courtois has signed an extension that keeps him at the club until 30 June 2028.
His previous deal was due to expire at the end of the current season.
He is 34 and has been the club's No. 1 since 2018, with 348 appearances.
background: Courtois joined from Chelsea in 2018 and replaced Keylor Navas; he was MVP of the 2022 Champions League final win over Liverpool.
member_headlines: Courtois extends Real Madrid contract to 2028

headline: Rudiger could leave next year, Madrid to discuss his future (Marca via ESPN)
facts: ESPN's transfer roundup, citing Marca, says Rudiger could leave next year.
Real Madrid plan to discuss his future before the summer window.
This is a rumour, not confirmed.
background: Rudiger scored the 90th-minute winner at Roma on 14 October.
member_headlines: Rudiger could leave next year, Madrid to discuss his future (Marca via ESPN)

headline: Teenager Xavi Espart signs a new Barcelona contract to 2030
facts: La Masia graduate Xavi Espart signed a contract extension through 2030 at the Camp Nou offices with president Joan Laporta.
He scored in Paris against PSG in October, his second first-team goal after one at Levante, and wears the number 12 shirt.
He made his debut near the end of a Champions League last-16 game at St James' Park in March, and an injury from the Clasico has slowed his progress.
background: Espart joined La Masia in the summer of 2015 and developed as a midfielder in the youth ranks before becoming a fullback.
member_headlines: Teenager Xavi Espart signs a new Barcelona contract to 2030

headline: Chelsea reportedly approach Betis teenager Jose Antonio Morante
facts: Per TEAMtalk, Chelsea have made an approach for the 19-year-old after a strong start to the season.
Manchester City and Manchester United are also reportedly tracking him.
He scored a stoppage-time goal after coming on at 90' in Betis's 5-2 win over Osasuna in October.
This is a transfer rumour from one report, with no fee given.
background: Betis lost the 2025 Conference League final to Chelsea, so a Chelsea move for one of their youngsters would carry some irony.
member_headlines: Chelsea reportedly approach Betis teenager Jose Antonio Morante

headline: Milan ready to sell Estupinan and Loftus-Cheek and loan out young players in January
facts: Amorim reportedly regrets keeping Estupinan after an Aston Villa move was nearly agreed; Villa are no longer interested and a Fiorentina loan is possible.
Loftus-Cheek's contract ends this season and injuries and poor form make a January sale likely.
Camarda and Christian Comotto are expected to go out on loan; no fees or wages are reported.
background: Milan have lost three of four Europa League games and there is a big gap between the first XI and the rotation squad.
member_headlines: Milan ready to sell Estupinan and Loftus-Cheek and loan out young players in January

headline: Juventus lead the chase for Lazio midfielder Kenneth Taylor
facts: Tuttosport says Juventus are by far the most interested club in Taylor; Newcastle, Bournemouth and Brentford are also reported to be interested.
Lazio could get around 40 million euros, having paid 17 million including bonuses to sign him from Ajax less than a year ago.
Lazio do not want to sell key players in January, according to Tuttosport.
background: Taylor is a 24-year-old Dutch international who has started every Lazio match this season for the team leading Serie A.
member_headlines: Juventus lead the chase for Lazio midfielder Kenneth Taylor

headline: Kean out for months as Como striker's bone problem flares again
facts: Fabregas confirmed Kean will be out for several months after a new scare in which he was taken away by ambulance.
The recurring right leg bone issue goes back to last season; surgery may be the only option.
Kean has not played since 20 September, and Como may need another striker because Douvikas is the only available centre-forward.
background: Kean's tibia problems were reportedly behind a failed Atletico Madrid medical in 2023/24.
member_headlines: Kean out for months as Como striker's bone problem flares again

headline: Lazio top Serie A under Gattuso with the club's best-ever start
facts: Lazio went into the break top after 11 matches, one of two unbeaten sides, having dropped points only twice since the season began.
Gattuso joked that after about six months it feels like 10 years at Lazio.
Frattesi is fit, and Lazio host 14th-placed Lecce on Saturday.
background: Sky said in October that Lazio had their best Serie A start ever; Gattuso took over after Maurizio Sarri left by mutual consent.
member_headlines: Lazio top Serie A under Gattuso with the club's best-ever start

headline: Guardiola praises Kompany and the Bundesliga from his coaching break
facts: Guardiola says he is on a break from coaching and does not know how long it will last.
He calls Kompany destined to coach and says Bayern's attacking, winning style is a joy to watch.
He spends time in Catalonia and Abu Dhabi, plays golf and reads, and watched most of the World Cup from Barcelona.
background: Guardiola coached Bayern for three seasons, winning three Bundesliga titles and two German Cups, before ten years at Manchester City.
member_headlines: Guardiola praises Kompany and the Bundesliga from his coaching break

headline: Bremen and Hamburg prepare for the 111th Nordderby with Fuellkrug on nine goals
facts: The 111th Nordderby is at the Weserstadion on Sunday 22 November; Bremen are sixth, HSV are 11th, three points apart.
Fuellkrug leads the league with nine goals in nine games, six of them from set pieces, and Bremen have seven dead-ball goals, already more than last season.
Bremen are unbeaten at home this season and have won eight of their last nine home meetings with HSV; only three of HSV's 12 points came away from home.
background: HSV are back in the top flight after a seven-year absence, and coaches Daniel Thioune and Merlin Polzin worked together at Osnabrueck, winning promotion to the 2. Bundesliga in 2018/19.
footage_terms: Werder Bremen Hamburger SV Nordderby Highlights
member_headlines: Bremen and Hamburg prepare for the 111th Nordderby with Fuellkrug on nine goals

headline: Nordderby security tightened after pyro fines and toilet vandalism at the last derby
facts: After pyrotechnics and toilet vandalism at the April derby, Werder expanded video surveillance, added fences and nets and plans about 2,000 staff on match day, with dogs searching for pyro.
Police are reinforced from other states; extra police costs at past derbies were between 230,000 and 450,000 euros and this one is expected to cost more.
Bremen's Interior Senator plans to pass part of the bill to the DFL, and Werder was fined 280,000 euros for the pyro at the previous derby.
background: The Bremen city state has been in a long dispute with the DFL about passing high-risk match police costs on to the league.
footage_terms: Werder Bremen Hamburger SV April 2026 Nordderby Highlights
member_headlines: Nordderby security tightened after pyro fines and toilet vandalism at the last derby

headline: Brajan Gruda becomes Leipzig's dribbling machine on loan from Brighton
facts: Gruda has four assists in seven Bundesliga games this season, two of them in the 5-2 win over Augsburg, and the most successful dribbles in the league.
He has no league goal yet this season, but scored in the Champions League and DFB Cup; after returning in February he had three goals and three assists in 13 league games.
His loan from Brighton was extended through the 2026/27 season.
background: Gruda debuted in the Bundesliga at 18 for Mainz against Dortmund in 2023, then moved to Brighton, where he scored four goals in 45 appearances; he is 22.
member_headlines: Brajan Gruda becomes Leipzig's dribbling machine on loan from Brighton

headline: Grischa Promel returns to hometown Stuttgart and scores on his home debut
facts: Promel, 31, born in Bad Cannstatt, joined Stuttgart from Hoffenheim this summer and scored in his first home game against Cologne.
He has played all nine league games, starting six, and says he is adapting to a less attacking role than at Hoffenheim.
Stuttgart have 12 points after nine games, with goals scored and conceded level at 15 each; next up are Schalke away, Frankfurt at home and Elversberg away.
background: Promel earlier played in the Bundesliga for Union Berlin and Hoffenheim; the interview says he is also a keen surfer and traveller.
member_headlines: Grischa Promel returns to hometown Stuttgart and scores on his home debut

headline: Freiburg and Elversberg, the two overachievers, meet on matchday 10
facts: Freiburg are third with 19 points, their best start in the Bundesliga with a club-record 20 goals scored; only Bayern and Leverkusen have beaten them.
Elversberg are seventh with 13 points after wins over Leverkusen (3-2), at Gladbach (4-3), over Augsburg (4-3) and Mainz (4-1); coach Vincent Wagner still says the aim is 40 points.
The hosts play at a ground set to hold 15,000 after renovation, still the lowest capacity in the division.
background: Elversberg come from Spiesen-Elversberg, about 13,000 residents and the smallest town ever to host a Bundesliga club, and had spent only three seasons above the third tier. Freiburg's best finish is third, in 1994/95.
member_headlines: Freiburg and Elversberg, the two overachievers, meet on matchday 10

headline: The El Mala brothers share a flat and are Cologne's best double act
facts: Said El Mala has three Bundesliga goals this season, including the winner against Gladbach in the Rhine derby, and seven goals in his first 16 top-flight games.
Malek El Mala is a year older and about 10 cm taller; the brothers share a flat and have set up each other's goals, the first brother goal combination in the Bundesliga in 20 years.
Said wears Cologne's iconic number 10 shirt and earned his first senior Germany call-up in November 2025.
background: Gladbach released Said as a youngster in 2021; he considered quitting before his brother Malek encouraged him, then rebuilt at TSV Meerbusch and Viktoria Cologne, winning Newcomer of the Season in the 3. Liga in 2024/25.
footage_terms: Said El Mala Tor Koeln Leverkusen Malek Vorlage
Said El Mala Gladbach Derby Siegtor
member_headlines: The El Mala brothers share a flat and are Cologne's best double act

headline: Spurs loanee Mikey Moore has no goals at Cologne and the club has gone 17 away games without a win
facts: Moore, 19, joined Cologne on a season-long loan from Tottenham and has five starts and 16 shots but no goals; only El Mala has more shots for the club.
He says the Bundesliga is as intense as the Premier League and wants to borrow El Mala's goalscoring touch while seeing Harry Kane as a role model.
Cologne are near the bottom and have gone 17 away games without a win, and Moore expects the visit to Bayern on matchday 10 to be the toughest game of his career so far.
background: Moore is a London-born striker who says the Cologne fans were part of the reason he chose the club.
footage_terms: 1. FC Koeln Bayern Muenchen Vorschau Moore
member_headlines: Spurs loanee Mikey Moore has no goals at Cologne and the club has gone 17 away games without a win

headline: Patrik Schick has scored in six straight games for Leverkusen, a club record
facts: Schick scored in each of Leverkusen's first six league games this season, a club record.
He has 87 Bundesliga goals for Leverkusen, the most by any foreign player in club history, and could reach 100 soon.
He says he does not chase records and that scoring in a full stadium is what drives him.
background: Schick was once a more creative forward and chose to become a pure goalscorer around 23 or 24; Xabi Alonso and Florian Wirtz have left, making him the main attacking focus after the 2024 title and cup double.
footage_terms: Patrik Schick Tor Leverkusen Serie Rekord
member_headlines: Patrik Schick has scored in six straight games for Leverkusen, a club record

headline: Gladbach coach Blessin to bench Moritz Nicolas for 35-year-old Daniel Batz before Dortmund
facts: Blessin has reportedly chosen Batz, 35, over Nicolas, 29, for the home game against Dortmund on Saturday at 15:30.
Batz covered for the injured Nicolas in three competitive games and kept a clean sheet in two of them, while Nicolas made mistakes early in the season.
Gladbach are last, and if Nicolas stays on the bench a transfer becomes more likely; Hull City showed interest in him in the summer.
background: Nicolas is a Gladbach academy product with 87 appearances in three seasons; Blessin said only that people should let themselves be surprised.
member_headlines: Gladbach coach Blessin to bench Moritz Nicolas for 35-year-old Daniel Batz before Dortmund

headline: Japan's Kohzo Tashima becomes first challenger to Infantino for the FIFA presidency
facts: Tashima, a FIFA Council member and former JFA president, declared his candidacy on 5 November and is the first Japanese person to run for FIFA president.
He says he is open to joining forces with Diallo, though they have not yet spoken.
The vote is on 18 March; an unofficial AP count puts Infantino at 105 votes, one short of the 106 needed in a two-candidate race.
background: Infantino was expected to win a fourth term unopposed before the World Cup stake-sale row, and the Asian Football Confederation has endorsed him.
member_headlines: Japan's Kohzo Tashima becomes first challenger to Infantino for the FIFA presidency

headline: Harry Kane wins the Ballon d'Or and sets sights on Champions League and an England trophy
facts: Kane won the Ballon d'Or last month ahead of Mbappe and Yamal.
He captained England to third at the World Cup, their best finish since 1966, with six goals in seven games.
He scored 61 goals for Bayern in all competitions, including 36 in the Bundesliga.
He says the Champions League is the main goal this season and still wants a major trophy with England.
background: Kane lost the 2019 Champions League final with Tottenham against Liverpool and has never won a major international trophy.
member_headlines: Harry Kane wins the Ballon d'Or and sets sights on Champions League and an England trophy

headline: Ireland beat Kosovo 3-0 to reach Nations League play-offs, then draw Croatia
facts: Ireland were drawn against Croatia in the promotion play-off: first leg in Dublin on 27 March, second leg away on 30 March.
Ireland beat Kosovo 3-0 at the Aviva, with Troy Parrott scoring twice and Jack Moylan once.
The win secured pot-two seeding for the Euro 2028 qualifying draw, with Ireland as co-hosts.
Other play-offs: Bosnia v Denmark, Hungary v Serbia, Slovenia v Wales.
background: Croatia were 2018 World Cup finalists; the sides last met at Euro 2012, when Croatia won 3-1.
footage_terms: Ireland Croatia Nations League play-off draw
member_headlines: Ireland beat Kosovo 3-0 to reach Nations League play-offs, then draw Croatia

headline: Kosovo fined 42,250 euros after fans whistle Israel's anthem and show discriminatory behaviour
facts: UEFA fined the Kosovan FA 42,250 euros after the goalless Nations League game with Israel in Pristina on 14 November.
Charges included whistling the anthem, racist and discriminatory behaviour, thrown objects and an unsuitable message broadcast.
A partial stadium closure was suspended for two years.
Kosovo had similar fines after home games against Ireland and Austria.
background: Kosovo have repeatedly been sanctioned for fan behaviour in this Nations League campaign.
member_headlines: Kosovo fined 42,250 euros after fans whistle Israel's anthem and show discriminatory behaviour

headline: Valencia sound out Barcelona about Ter Stegen as struggling club eye a goalkeeper swap
facts: Onda Deportiva Valencia reports sporting director Braulio Vazquez has started inquiries about the 34-year-old, now on loan at Ajax.
Barcelona pay 90 percent of his wages on loan and his contract runs to 2028; no formal offer has arrived.
Valencia are second-from-bottom in La Liga, have conceded 20 goals in 12 games, and a US group is reportedly buying 42 percent from Peter Lim's Meriton.
background: Ter Stegen spent over a decade as Barcelona's first-choice goalkeeper before going out on loan.
member_headlines: Valencia sound out Barcelona about Ter Stegen as struggling club eye a goalkeeper swap

headline: Flick asks Barcelona for two January signings amid defensive crisis
facts: Sport reports Flick wants an experienced centre-back and a reliable left-back in January.
The left-back move depends on Balde leaving; Financial Fair Play is the main barrier.
A Balde sale or Liverpool taking up the Araujo option could raise funds.
background: Flick took over Barcelona in 2024. He previously won a treble with Bayern Munich.
member_headlines: Flick asks Barcelona for two January signings amid defensive crisis

headline: Leno says no Bayern contact yet as club eye Neuer successor
facts: The 34-year-old has a Fulham deal to 2027 with a club option.
Bayern expect Neuer to retire at season's end and Leno is a reported candidate.
Leno told Sky Germany nobody from Bayern has contacted him.
background: Leno is a German goalkeeper who previously played for Arsenal.
member_headlines: Leno says no Bayern contact yet as club eye Neuer successor

headline: Man United reportedly plan January move for Leipzig's Antonio Nusa
facts: Di Marzio puts the price at about EUR 70-80m while Transfermarkt values him at EUR 45m.
United are said to want the Sesko-style exceptional offer, with Sesko out until the New Year.
He has 11 goals and assists in nine Bundesliga games; a 2024 Brentford move collapsed.
background: Nusa is a 21-year-old Norway winger who had a strong World Cup.
member_headlines: Man United reportedly plan January move for Leipzig's Antonio Nusa

headline: Arsenal reportedly chase Paraguayan teenager Eduardo Delmas
facts: Deporte Total says Arsenal are seriously pursuing the 19-year-old.
Olimpia president Rodrigo Nogues wants more than 10m pounds.
Real Madrid and PSG are also scouting.
background: Delmas plays for Olimpia in Paraguay; Arsenal scouts reportedly watched him score in the Superclasico.
member_headlines: Arsenal reportedly chase Paraguayan teenager Eduardo Delmas

headline: Monza ask 35 million euros for Gustavo Varela, bought for 2.5 million euros months ago
facts: Monza paid Benfica 2.5 million euros for the Portuguese forward a few months ago and now want a guaranteed 35 million.
Benfica have a match right and 20 percent of the profit on a future sale.
Juventus, Napoli and Tottenham are all reported as interested; Napoli have a strong relationship with his agency.
background: Varela is a Portuguese forward born in 2005 with nine league goals this season and a Portugal call-up.
member_headlines: Monza ask 35 million euros for Gustavo Varela, bought for 2.5 million euros months ago

headline: Leipzig owe Brighton 25 million euros for Brajan Gruda as Bayern watch
facts: Leipzig must pay 25 million euros to make the deal permanent once he plays three Bundesliga games, possibly by mid-January.
Leipzig paid a 1 million euro loan fee in early February 2026.
Leipzig would reportedly only sell next summer for around 100 million euros; the permanent deal would run to 2031 and he has no release clause.
background: Gruda is a German winger who can play on either wing or as a number ten and is on loan at Leipzig from Brighton.
member_headlines: Leipzig owe Brighton 25 million euros for Brajan Gruda as Bayern watch

headline: Barcelona walk away from Manchester United teenager JJ Gabriel over a roughly 10 million euro package
facts: Journalist Sique Rodriguez valued the whole operation at close to 10 million euros, including salary, family payments and intermediary fees.
United would receive only about 350,000 euros in training compensation.
Real Madrid are reportedly close to finalising the move and United are checking whether outside parties approached the 16-year-old while he was registered with them.
background: Gabriel is a 16-year-old United forward who asked to leave in September and confirmed his departure on 17 November.
member_headlines: Barcelona walk away from Manchester United teenager JJ Gabriel over a roughly 10 million euro package

headline: Pochettino's United squad audit lists fees and wages, including Rashford at 325,000 pounds a week
facts: ESPN lists Rashford's wages at 325,000 pounds a week, the club's highest, and says he had failed loan moves in the last two summers.

Reported fees include Sesko 85 million euros from Leipzig, Cunha 62.5 million pounds from Wolves, Baleba 65 million pounds from Brighton, Ugarte 50 million euros from PSG and De Ligt 45 million euros from Bayern.
The audit recommends keeping Sesko and Cunha and moving on Rashford and De Ligt.
background: Pochettino is United's new head coach, hired after Michael Carrick was sacked; Rashford came through United's academy.
member_headlines: Pochettino's United squad audit lists fees and wages, including Rashford at 325,000 pounds a week

headline: Chelsea fined 150,000 pounds by FA over crowd misconduct in FA Cup tie with Charlton
facts: The FA said Chelsea were charged over supporters' conduct referring to religion or belief around the 56th minute of an FA Cup tie against Charlton Athletic.
Chelsea admitted the charge; an independent Regulatory Commission imposed a 150,000 pound fine, an action plan and a warning on future conduct.
Chelsea appealed, but an independent Appeal Board dismissed the appeal, so the original orders stand.
background: Chelsea are coached by Xabi Alonso this season, and the case concerns supporter behaviour at an FA Cup tie against Charlton Athletic.
member_headlines: Chelsea fined 150,000 pounds by FA over crowd misconduct in FA Cup tie with Charlton

headline: Inquest into death of Sheffield United Women midfielder Maddy Cusack resumes in December
facts: The coroner's inquest into the death of 27-year-old Maddy Cusack is due to resume on 7 December for a five-day hearing in Derby, with 11 witnesses expected.
Her family made a written complaint to the club about her treatment under coach Jonathan Morgan; Morgan denies some of the claims.
The inquest was adjourned in July so the club could supply more evidence, including digital records and an audit of health records; an earlier start was postponed because of disclosure delays.
background: Cusack was found unresponsive at her home in Derbyshire on 20 September 2023 while a Sheffield United Women player.
member_headlines: Inquest into death of Sheffield United Women midfielder Maddy Cusack resumes in December

headline: Berrada admits some United fan criticism is fair, says Glazer-INEOS split is 'working'
facts: United CEO Omar Berrada says some criticism of club leadership is fair and some crosses a line, and admits three permanent managers in under three seasons is not the stability the club wants.
He says the dual ownership of the Glazers and INEOS works well, with regular dialogue and aligned goals.
United sacked Michael Carrick in the November break with the team 18th, and the club spent about 163 million pounds this summer, mostly on midfielders.
background: Berrada is a former Manchester City executive who joined United as chief executive under the Ratcliffe-led football restructure.
footage_terms: Pochettino first press conference Manchester United
Man United fan protest Old Trafford
member_headlines: Berrada admits some United fan criticism is fair, says Glazer-INEOS split is 'working'

headline: Liverpool's Anfield crowd under scrutiny as home form slumps before United game
facts: Liverpool have won just one of five Premier League home games this season and 5 of 15 at Anfield in 2026.
The fans' emotional tribute to Diogo Jota at the 20-minute mark of home matches has been debated, and the crowd turned on the team at times last season.
Gravenberch asked supporters to stay behind the team for 90 minutes, while Iraola has praised the atmosphere and the crowd was cited in wins over Atletico Madrid, Villarreal and Brighton.
background: Liverpool have not beaten United at Anfield since a 7-0 win in March 2023.
footage_terms: Iraola press conference Liverpool Anfield crowd
member_headlines: Liverpool's Anfield crowd under scrutiny as home form slumps before United game

headline: Manchester United's eight-game winless league run is worst in Premier League history
facts: ESPN says United are 18th and have failed to win any of their past eight league games, their worst run in Premier League history.
Mauricio Pochettino takes charge for the first time at Liverpool.
Liverpool are fourth in the table but have won only one of five home league games.
background: United won 2-1 at Anfield last season, their first win there in almost a decade.
footage_terms: Pochettino Manchester United press conference Liverpool
Manchester United winless run Premier League
Liverpool vs Manchester United Anfield preview
member_headlines: Manchester United's eight-game winless league run is worst in Premier League history

headline: Rennes 14-year-old Thymeo Hanyurwimana Ferreira Cruz is compared to Messi
facts: Born 5 April 2012, the attacking midfielder trains with Rennes U19s and plays for the U17s.
Rennes signed him to a semi-professional deal starting 1 July 2027; a pro contract the next day would make him the youngest Ligue 1 player at just over 15.
Goal reports interest from Barcelona and Manchester City, but he and his entourage reportedly prefer Rennes.
He signed with Adidas very young, and Goal says the Messi comparisons include the shared kit sponsor.
background: Rennes' academy has produced Ousmane Dembele, Eduardo Camavinga and Desire Doue.
member_headlines: Rennes 14-year-old Thymeo Hanyurwimana Ferreira Cruz is compared to Messi

headline: Barcelona extend La Masia product Xavi Espart to 2030
facts: Barcelona renewed the academy product until 30 June 2030; he signed in Joan Laporta's office at Spotify Camp Nou.
He can play full-back on either flank or in midfield and has mostly played on the left, competing with Joao Cancelo.
Before an ankle injury he had 9 matches, 2 goals and 2 assists; he hurt his right ankle in the Clasico.
background: Espart has been in Barcelona's academy since 2015; Hansi Flick trusts him as a versatile option.
member_headlines: Barcelona extend La Masia product Xavi Espart to 2030

headline: Leipzig loanee Brajan Gruda reportedly worth 100 million euros to Leipzig
facts: Per Bild, Leipzig would only sell for 'completely outrageous' offers of around 100 million euros.
Leipzig's 25 million euro obligation to buy him from Brighton reportedly triggers after three Bundesliga games, possibly by mid-January 2027.
He has 2 goals and 5 assists in his last eight competitive matches and 2 Germany caps, including a goal against Serbia.
Sport Bild reported Bayern's interest; Leipzig coach Martin Demichelis told him to stay grounded.
background: Leipzig borrowed him from Brighton in early February 2026 for a 1 million euro loan fee; his contract runs to 2031.
member_headlines: Leipzig loanee Brajan Gruda reportedly worth 100 million euros to Leipzig

headline: Leipzig winger Antonio Nusa, 21, is Bundesliga's newest star and an Arsenal target
facts: Sky Sports published a best-of video of Nusa's Bundesliga season on 20 November 2026.
A Sky article (Nov 17) says he has 14 goal contributions in 15 games this season.
Arsenal are monitoring him, but Leipzig reportedly will not sell in January, so a summer move looks likelier.
background: Nusa is a 21-year-old Norway winger who plays for RB Leipzig.
member_headlines: Leipzig winger Antonio Nusa, 21, is Bundesliga's newest star and an Arsenal target

headline: Dortmund's Samuele Inacio, 18, out for months with knee injury
facts: Dortmund confirmed on 20 November that the 18-year-old has a meniscus injury needing surgery, out for 'several months'.
He was hurt in Italy U21's 2-2 friendly draw with Belgium and replaced by Seydou Fini.
He won his first senior cap in June; Mancini included him in squads but he was left out in November.
background: Inacio is an Italy talent at Dortmund who earned his first senior cap under interim coach Silvio Baldini.
member_headlines: Dortmund's Samuele Inacio, 18, out for months with knee injury

headline: Milan plan January loans for Francesco Camarda and Christian Comotto
facts: Football Italia says Milan expect to loan out both young players in January.
Genoa are the most advanced in talks for Comotto; Camarda has 'numerous proposals' from Serie A, Serie B and abroad.
Goal.com adds that Monza could use Camarda as an option if Varela leaves, and that Ibrahimovic blocked his move to Monza two years ago.
The same report says Milan may sell Estupinan and Loftus-Cheek.
background: Camarda is a Milan academy forward who has not been a regular first-team starter; Milan now plan to loan him out.
member_headlines: Milan plan January loans for Francesco Camarda and Christian Comotto

headline: Napoli reportedly ready to let De Bruyne go in January, PSV interested
facts: ESPN's rumour roundup, citing Gazzetta dello Sport, says Napoli would let De Bruyne leave in January for an offer of about 7 million euros.
PSV Eindhoven are reported to be interested. An earlier roundup citing De Telegraaf gave a different offer figure, so the numbers are unconfirmed.
De Bruyne is 35.
background: De Bruyne joined Napoli after leaving Manchester City, and he is one of Belgium's all-time greats.
member_headlines: Napoli reportedly ready to let De Bruyne go in January, PSV interested

headline: Flamengo one draw from the Brasileirao title as Palmeiras fans hand back tickets
facts: Flamengo lead Palmeiras by six points with three rounds left and hold the first tiebreaker, so a draw in the Saturday 21 November clash at Nubank Parque would be enough for the title.
Flamengo beat Athletico-PR 2-1 while Palmeiras lost 2-1 to Cruzeiro, and Abel Ferreira effectively conceded the league afterwards.
Some Palmeiras fans cancelled their tickets for the match and ESPN reports some starters may be rested ahead of the Libertadores and Copa do Brasil finals.
background: Flamengo beat Palmeiras 1-0 in the 2025 Copa Libertadores final for their fourth continental title, per ESPN.
footage_terms: Abel Ferreira press conference Flamengo title
member_headlines: Flamengo one draw from the Brasileirao title as Palmeiras fans hand back tickets

headline: Thiago Silva, 42, undecided on retirement as Fluminense clinch a Libertadores place
facts: Interim coach Marcao joined the fans' campaign for Thiago Silva to stay, joking that the 42-year-old could play about three more years.
Silva's contract runs to the end of December 2026 and he has not announced a decision.
A 1-0 win away at Sao Paulo secured Fluminense a Libertadores place; they are fourth with 60 points.
background: ESPN reported last year that Thiago Silva, then 41, was aiming for a place in Brazil's World Cup squad.
member_headlines: Thiago Silva, 42, undecided on retirement as Fluminense clinch a Libertadores place

headline: MLS Round 1 preview: Messi's Miami vs Columbus, Nashville the favorites
facts: The playoff field was cut to 16 after Orlando and Seattle went out in the wild card; Round 1 is best-of-three starting Saturday.
All four ESPN writers pick Inter Miami (No. 2) to beat Columbus Crew (No. 7); Robert Lewandowski's Chicago has slipped since the summer, and LAFC with Son Heung-min has underperformed.
Miami is playing with a largely new attacking group compared with the one that won MLS Cup a year ago.
background: Inter Miami won MLS Cup in 2025 with Messi, who was league MVP that year.
footage_terms: Inter Miami vs Columbus Crew playoffs highlights
Messi Inter Miami MLS Cup 2025 final
member_headlines: MLS Round 1 preview: Messi's Miami vs Columbus, Nashville the favorites

headline: ESPN reviews every eliminated MLS team: Orlando's leaky defense, Austin boycott, D.C. drought
facts: Orlando conceded 78 goals in the regular season, one of the worst defenses in league history, even though Antoine Griezmann scored 14 goals in 18 games after joining in July.
D.C. United missed the playoffs for a seventh straight year; Louis Munteanu did not justify his reported $7 million fee.
Breel Embolo scored four goals in 11 games for Atlanta; LA Galaxy lost Riqui Puig to a knee injury before his season started.
background: Griezmann moved to Orlando from Atletico Madrid in July 2026, where he was a long-time club icon and top scorer.
member_headlines: ESPN reviews every eliminated MLS team: Orlando's leaky defense, Austin boycott, D.C. drought

headline: AFCON 2027 qualifying window: nine teams through, Nigeria on the brink
facts: Nine teams have qualified: Morocco, Mali, Senegal, Cameroon, Benin and Burkina Faso joined co-hosts Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda.
Senegal threw away a two-goal lead against Sudan but drew 2-2 and still qualified; Nigeria lost 3-0 to Guinea-Bissau and drew 0-0 in Tanzania.
Algeria lost 3-0 to Togo and Tunisia are bottom of their group; the last 15 places will be decided in March 2027.
background: AFCON 2027 is hosted by Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda from 19 June to 17 July 2027, the first AFCON in East Africa since 1976.
member_headlines: AFCON 2027 qualifying window: nine teams through, Nigeria on the brink

headline: Kenya coach Benni McCarthy in row over unpaid allowances and booing fans
facts: Kenya drew 2-2 at Orlando Stadium, then lost 2-1 at home to South Africa in the double-header.
McCarthy alleged players refused to train over unpaid allowances and demanded payment for himself, his staff and the squad.
His remarks about booing fans and his own comfortable lifestyle drew criticism and he later apologised.
background: McCarthy is a former South Africa striker who won a domestic title as Orlando Pirates coach; Kenya are already qualified for AFCON 2027 as co-hosts.
member_headlines: Kenya coach Benni McCarthy in row over unpaid allowances and booing fans

headline: Tunisia players walk off in Libya over disputed penalty
facts: Tunisia protested a disputed penalty in Tripoli and several players walked off the pitch; Libya's Ezoo El Maremi scored from the spot.
Captain Ferjani Sassi reportedly objected to fans being present.
Tunisia are preparing a complaint to CAF and sit bottom of Group H with three points from four games.
background: Tunisia are a regular AFCON qualifier and played at the 2026 World Cup, so bottom of the group is a sharp fall.
member_headlines: Tunisia players walk off in Libya over disputed penalty

headline: Ghana's interim coach ends eight-game winless run after Queiroz exit
facts: Carlos Queiroz left Ghana by mutual consent on about 1 October, his second exit in under three months, after a 2-0 loss in Ivory Coast and a 4-2 home loss to Gambia from 2-0 up.
Interim coach Kim Bjorkegren won both games against Somalia in November, ending an eight-match winless run in AFCON qualifying.
Ghana still need to appoint a permanent coach.
background: Ghana reached the 2026 World Cup round of 32 before losing 1-0 to Colombia, then Queiroz returned as coach after that exit.
member_headlines: Ghana's interim coach ends eight-game winless run after Queiroz exit

headline: Osimhen linked with Manchester United while recovering from knee surgery
facts: Goal, citing The Sun, reports Osimhen is open to joining United and willing to match his Galatasaray salary; this is unconfirmed.
He is under contract at Galatasaray until June 2029 with no release clause, valued by Turkish sources at 80-100 million pounds.
ESPN reported separately that he is out for Nigeria after knee surgery.
background: Osimhen joined Galatasaray on loan from Napoli in 2024 and later signed permanently; he scored 37 goals in all competitions in his first season there.
member_headlines: Osimhen linked with Manchester United while recovering from knee surgery

headline: Fulham boss says Bassey is among the world's best defenders amid United link
facts: Fulham manager Alvaro Arbeloa said Bassey is one of the best central defenders in the world and Fulham should not sell him this winter.
British outlets linked Bassey with Manchester United earlier in the week.
Fulham are 15th, two points above 18th-placed United; Bassey's contract runs to mid-2027 with a one-year option.
background: Bassey, a Nigeria defender, moved from Rangers to Ajax for 23 million euros in 2022 and joined Fulham a year later for 22 million.
member_headlines: Fulham boss says Bassey is among the world's best defenders amid United link

headline: Son and Bouanga carry LAFC into MLS playoff series against St. Louis
facts: LAFC, the No. 6 seed, face No. 3 St. Louis City in MLS playoff Round 1 starting Monday.
Son has 7 goals and 6 assists since the World Cup after going without a goal before the tournament.
ESPN says LAFC underperformed for much of 2026; two of four writers pick LAFC, citing Son as due a big game.
background: Son left Tottenham for LAFC in 2025 after a long Spurs career; Bouanga leads LAFC with 18 goals and 9 assists this season.
member_headlines: Son and Bouanga carry LAFC into MLS playoff series against St. Louis

headline: Algeria repays Kansas for World Cup base camp welcome
facts: 38 residents of Lawrence, Kansas visited Algeria from 9 to 15 November, paid for by the Algerian government as thanks for hosting the team at the World Cup.
Algeria used Lawrence as its official base camp, with the University of Kansas band playing its anthem before training.
President Tebboune ordered a twinning agreement between Tipaza and Kansas City.
background: Algeria was one of 50 countries whose visa applicants faced a 10,000 dollar bond requirement, so few Algerian fans could travel to the tournament.
footage_terms: Algeria Lawrence Kansas World Cup base camp
member_headlines: Algeria repays Kansas for World Cup base camp welcome

headline: Washington Spirit host Kansas City Current in the NWSL Championship final
facts: The final is on Saturday at the Spirit's home, Audi Field.
Washington is in its third straight final after losing 1-0 in both 2024 and 2025.
Kansas City has never won the NWSL Championship.
Trinity Rodman has 12 goals and eight assists this season, her best yet.
Croix Bethune, a former Spirit player, broke the NWSL assists record.
background: Washington won its only NWSL title in 2021, and Kansas City lost the 2022 final at the same Audi Field.
footage_terms: Washington Spirit Kansas City Current NWSL final preview
member_headlines: Washington Spirit host Kansas City Current in the NWSL Championship final

headline: Women's Champions League: Barcelona and Lyon through, Chelsea and Bayern close, final matchday set for Dec 16
facts: Barcelona and Lyon have qualified directly for the quarter-finals; Austria Wien are eliminated.
Bayern Munich (3rd) and Chelsea (4th) are best placed to join them in the top four.
The final matchday is Dec 16, with the knockout draw on Dec 17.
The final is on May 29 at the Stadion Narodowy in Warsaw.
Key last-round games include Bayern v Barcelona and Inter v Arsenal.
background: The competition uses a league phase with direct quarter-final places for the top four and playoffs for positions five to twelve.
footage_terms: Women's Champions League 2026-27 league phase highlights
Bayern vs Barcelona Women Champions League preview
member_headlines: Women's Champions League: Barcelona and Lyon through, Chelsea and Bayern close, final matchday set for Dec 16

headline: GTA VI lands: what Premier League clubs spent since GTA V
facts: Between GTA V (17 September 2013) and GTA VI (19 November 2026) Chelsea spent the most of the six big clubs, about 2.9bn pounds.
Tottenham spent about 1.7bn pounds for one major trophy; the article puts that at roughly 1.7bn per trophy.
Man City spent 2.5bn and won 20 major trophies, the lowest cost per trophy of the six.
background: Top-flight clubs have spent over 2bn pounds in each of the last five summer windows, and summer 2026 set a record of 3.56bn.
member_headlines: GTA VI lands: what Premier League clubs spent since GTA V

headline: Neuer photographed on a Vespa in Brazil while injured
facts: Images show Neuer riding a Vespa with an unidentified woman behind him, outside a medical centre in Brazil.
He partly tore a tendon in his right foot on 7 November in Bayern's 2-1 win over Mainz.
Bayern allowed rehab abroad, and sporting director Max Eberl approved the trip.
background: Neuer is Bayern's long-serving captain goalkeeper and a World Cup winner with Germany.
member_headlines: Neuer photographed on a Vespa in Brazil while injured

headline: Man Utd CEO Berrada defends Carrick sacking, club leadership and a Pochettino appointment in Sky interview
facts: Berrada said sacking Carrick after a 3-0 home loss to Bournemouth on 25 October was a very difficult decision, and admitted that some criticism of club leadership is fair.
He noted United have had three permanent managers in under three seasons and spent 163m pounds this summer, mostly on midfielders.
He said contract talks with Bruno Fernandes continue privately and that United were unhappy 16-year-old JJ Gabriel announced his exit for Real Madrid without telling them.
background: Berrada joined United as chief executive in 2024 after working at Manchester City, so he was part of the City side that is now facing the Premier League charges.
footage_terms: Man Utd Pochettino first day Carrington
member_headlines: Man Utd CEO Berrada defends Carrick sacking, club leadership and a Pochettino appointment in Sky interview

headline: Drone video of Pochettino's first Man Utd training session gets millions of views, operator apologises
facts: A drone filmed about 12 minutes of Pochettino's first Carrington session on Thursday and the YouTube channel CC Overview posted it; reposts passed eight million views, according to Sky Sports.
The operator apologised on Friday, called the filming unethical though legal, and removed the video.
ESPN reports sources saying United would take legal action if a similar drone incident happens again.
background: Pochettino managed Tottenham, PSG and Chelsea before the US national team job, and his first match back in club football is at Liverpool.
footage_terms: Man Utd Carrington drone footage Pochettino training
Pochettino Manchester United first training session
member_headlines: Drone video of Pochettino's first Man Utd training session gets millions of views, operator apologises

headline: Iraola says Pochettino's United have a 'small advantage' and calls drone filming of training illegal-worthy
facts: Iraola said United have a small advantage because Liverpool lack reference points for how Pochettino's side will play.
United sit 18th and are eight league games without a win, while Liverpool are fourth and have struggled at Anfield.
Liverpool have not beaten United at Anfield since March 2023; Sky Sports also reports Iraola said drone flights over private training should not be legal.
background: Iraola arrived at Liverpool from Bournemouth, where he built a reputation for intense pressing football, and this is his first Liverpool meeting with United.
footage_terms: Iraola press conference Liverpool Manchester United Pochettino
Liverpool vs Manchester United Anfield highlights
member_headlines: Iraola says Pochettino's United have a 'small advantage' and calls drone filming of training illegal-worthy

headline: Hoeness says Musiala may never return to his old level; Bayern board backs him
facts: Hoeness called the situation a dilemma on BR, said Musiala's illness can be managed with medication but not easily cured, and doubted he would return to his former level.
Sport Bild reports the supervisory board backed Hoeness at its Monday meeting; CEO Dreesen said he hopes Musiala returns.
Kompany said he believes Musiala will return and succeed, and Musiala is expected back against Cologne on Friday.
background: Musiala has had repeated setbacks since a serious injury at the 2025 Club World Cup, and Goal reports a neurological condition causing treatable brief absence seizures.
member_headlines: Hoeness says Musiala may never return to his old level; Bayern board backs him

headline: Zidane says France are not seeking revenge on Spain in Nations League quarter-final
facts: France coach Zidane said the Nations League quarter-final against Spain is not a chance for revenge for the 2026 World Cup semi-final loss.
He called it a different competition and a new group, aiming for the semi-finals and the title.
The first leg is on 25 March 2027, the return in France on 28 March, and the final on 13 June.
background: Zidane won the 1998 World Cup and Ballon d'Or as a player and three Champions Leagues in a row as Real Madrid coach.
footage_terms: Zidane press conference France Spain draw
France Spain World Cup semi-final highlights 2026
member_headlines: Zidane says France are not seeking revenge on Spain in Nations League quarter-final

headline: United CEO Berrada explains why Carrick was sacked after the Bournemouth defeat
facts: Carrick was sacked in the November international break, after a 3-0 home loss to Bournemouth on 25 October raised pressure.
Berrada said the club wanted to judge the team until the break and called the decision very difficult.
He said United spent 163m pounds this summer, mostly on midfielders Baleba, Tielemans and Santos, and defended the lack of defensive signings.
background: Carrick finished third last season and qualified United for the Champions League, which earned him a permanent contract.
member_headlines: United CEO Berrada explains why Carrick was sacked after the Bournemouth defeat

headline: Celtic's Martin O'Neill loses midfielder Mika Baur to a long injury
facts: O'Neill said Baur's injury is a blow because he was on fire.
Baur hurt his ankle in the win over Kilmarnock and faces a long spell out.
No return date was given.
background: O'Neill, 74, was made permanent Celtic manager in June 2026 on a one-year deal after the club sacked Wilfried Nancy 33 days into his job, and he managed Celtic from 2000 to 2005.
member_headlines: Celtic's Martin O'Neill loses midfielder Mika Baur to a long injury

headline: Liverpool host Man United at Anfield with a shaky home record and a 2023 7-0 hangover
facts: Liverpool host United on Sunday in the first meeting of Iraola and Pochettino; Liverpool have one win, two draws and two defeats in five league home games this season.
United are 18th and have not won in eight league games, their worst run in Premier League history.
Liverpool failed to register a shot on target against Arsenal, their first time in 442 league home matches.
background: Liverpool beat United 7-0 at Anfield in March 2023, the biggest win in the fixture's history, but have not beaten them at Anfield since. Klopp's Liverpool once went 68 league home games unbeaten between April 2017 and January 2021.
footage_terms: Pochettino first press conference Manchester United
member_headlines: Liverpool host Man United at Anfield with a shaky home record and a 2023 7-0 hangover

headline: Ballon d'Or winner Kane still hunting a Champions League title after losing the 2019 final
facts: Kane said winning the Champions League is a major goal for him and Bayern, and he also wants a trophy with England.
He won the Ballon d'Or last month and has won two straight Bundesliga titles with Bayern.
Last season he scored 61 goals for Bayern, and PSG knocked Bayern out of the Champions League.
background: Kane lost the 2019 Champions League final 2-0 with Tottenham against Liverpool. Bayern's last Champions League win was in 2020 against PSG.
member_headlines: Ballon d'Or winner Kane still hunting a Champions League title after losing the 2019 final

headline: Seville derby on Saturday: sixth-placed Sevilla host fourth-placed Betis
facts: The derby is on Saturday 21 November at 17:30 at the Ramon Sanchez-Pizjuan.
Sevilla have 18 points from 12 games and are sixth; Betis have 26 points and are fourth.
Sevilla's recent league results include a 3-1 loss at Getafe and a 4-1 loss at Real Madrid.
Betis have won 2-0 at Elche and lost 2-1 at Borussia Dortmund in the Champions League.
background: Sevilla only secured survival in May after a late-season run, while Betis returned to the Champions League this season after 21 years.
member_headlines: Seville derby on Saturday: sixth-placed Sevilla host fourth-placed Betis
